text.cn: 我需要你搭把手，朋友。
text.src: I need your help, friend.

text.cn: 哦？那要我干什么？这回要宰谁？
text.src: Yes? And what am I to do? Who am I going to kill?

text.cn: 这回不用宰人！只需盯住这些|机器人，看它们往哪儿去。
text.src: You don't need to kill anybody! Simply trace where these robots go.

text.cn: 你需要的话，自己跟去。
text.src: You need it, so  trace them youself.

text.cn: 具体点，什么事？
text.src: What in particular?

text.cn: 就那些！
text.src: Those ones!

text.cn: 行，明白了。嗯，这下有热闹瞧了。
text.src: Ok, I see. Yeah. The fat is in the fire.

text.cn: 向你致敬，亲爱的朋友！|就在此时此地！超级赛车比赛！|你有个千载难逢的机会参赛！
text.src: We salute you, dear friend! Right now and right here! Super race! You have a unique chance to take part in it.

text.cn: 奖品是什么？
text.src: What is the prize?

text.cn: 参赛费只要一百，赢了就拿一千。|来吧！
text.src: Due for participation is only hundred, but winnings - 1,000. Come on!

text.cn: 赛车是闲人才玩的，|我可有一堆麻烦事要忙。
text.src: Races are for idlers but I have a world of troubles.

text.cn: 我可没这么多钱。
text.src: I don't have so much money.

text.cn: 比就比！
text.src: Let's go!

text.cn: 预备——开始！
text.src: Ready. Steady. Go!

text.cn: 冲啊！！！
text.src: Let's go!!!

text.cn: 比赛结束了。
text.src: Race is over.

text.cn: 好！奖金归我了，对吧？
text.src: Good! Prize is mine, isn't it?

text.cn: 其实，你要是看到这段话——|说明游戏出了岔子！|你居然能赢过程序。祝你玩得愉快！
text.src: Actually, if you read this text - means in game there was a mistake! You could win the program. Pleasant game!

text.cn: 我赢了程序！
text.src: I have won the program!

text.cn: 你凭什么这么说？你差点就垫底了！
text.src: Why do you think so? You have finished almost the last one!

text.cn: 该死！
text.src: Shit!

text.cn: 没错，你赢了！
text.src: Yes you have won it!

text.cn: 那是自然！
text.src: Of course!

text.cn: 帮帮我，亲爱的朋友！
text.src: Help me, dear friend!

text.cn: 凭什么觉得我会帮你？
text.src: Why do you think I'm going to?

text.cn: 我骨头缝里就有这直觉。|我的车抛锚了，手头又没零配件修。
text.src: I feel it in my bones. My vehicle has broken. And I don't have spare parts to repair it.

text.cn: 具体是什么坏了？你要什么配件？
text.src: What thing has broken in particular? What spares do you need?

text.cn: 唉，说哪个没坏还快些。|方向盘倒是好的，其他全趴窝了。|所以你能找到什么配件我都要，|拉来多少我收多少。
text.src: Ur, it's easier to say what hasn't broken. My steering wheel is all right. But everything other has broken. So I need all spares you can find. I will take everything you bring me.

text.cn: 想得美，我才不会扔下一切|满世界给你找配件呢！
text.src: Yeah, I'm not going to give up everything to search for your spares!

text.cn: 我这儿正好有些。收吗？
text.src: I have some. Will you take them?

text.cn: 当然收，亲爱的朋友，我全买！|钱给你。
text.src: Of course, dear friend, I buy them! Here is your money.

text.cn: 好极了。
text.src: Excellent.

text.cn: 行，你待这儿别乱跑。|我这就进村去取，马上回来。|麻利点儿的。
text.src: Ok, stay here and don't go away. I will go to the village and return soon. Chop-chop.

text.cn: 配件给我带来了吗？
text.src: Have you bring me the spares?

text.cn: 抱歉，配件还没给你弄到。|我实在腾不出工夫。|不过你等着，货肯定给你送到。
text.src: Sorry, but I haven't brought you spares yet. I don't have time. But I will bring them, wait and everything will be ok.

text.cn: 喏，接着。
text.src: Here it is, take it.

text.cn: 多谢了，亲爱的朋友。钱给你。
text.src: Thank you, dear freind. Here is your money.

text.cn: 随时效劳。
text.src: I'm at your disposal.

text.cn: 能捎我一程吗？
text.src: Will you give me a lift?

text.cn: 去哪儿？
text.src: Where?

text.cn: 去奥特诺。
text.src: To Otno.

text.cn: 不了。
text.src: No.

text.cn: 行，我答应你。
text.src: Ok, I agree.

text.cn: 一路顺风。
text.src: Nice ride.

text.cn: 嗯，还算不赖。
text.src: Yes, not bad.

text.cn: 钱给你。
text.src: Here is money.

text.cn: 好极了。
text.src: Excellent.

text.cn: 田里出了怪事……|我们不敢去看，城里人|却对这事儿特别来劲。|你能替大伙儿去看看怎么回事吗？
text.src: Something strange happened at the fields... We are afraid to go there, but in the city this situation has aroused public interest. Will you describe it for citizen?

text.cn: 不了。
text.src: No.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Yes.

text.cn: 打听到什么了吗？
text.src: Have you found out anything?

text.cn: 我把你家田地看了一遍。|给——笔记本里是完整的报告，|附图和图表都在。
text.src: I looked over your fields. Here you are, the notebook with full report, drawings and charts.

text.cn: 多谢。这是你冒着天大风险|应得的报酬。
text.src: Thank you. Take your reward for the huge risk which you have run through.

text.cn: 是啊，真够悬的，|这钱算对得起那份风险。
text.src: Yes, it was a real danger and the money will compensate it.

text.cn: 想参加赛车吗？
text.src: Do you want to take part in races?

text.cn: 赛车？！
text.src: Race?!

text.cn: 对，赛车。看谁第一个开到城里。|报名费五千，奖金三倍。
text.src: Yeah, race. Who will be the first to reach the city. Participant due - 5,000. The winnings is three times bigger.

text.cn: 我不感兴趣。
text.src: It is not interesting for me.

text.cn: 行，我参加。
text.src: Ok, I will take part.

text.cn: 好心人，帮帮我吧。我的孩子丢了。
text.src: Good man, help me. I've lost my child.

text.cn: 这跟我有什么关系？
text.src: It is not my business?

text.cn: 人人都这么说，谁也不肯帮我——|连我丈夫查尔斯都不肯！
text.src: Everyone says so and nobody wants to help me, even my husband, Charles!

text.cn: 连丈夫都不肯帮忙，|那我就更没必要瞎掺和了。
text.src: Well even if the husband rejected to help, so I don't need to poke my nose in it.

text.cn: 行吧，我帮你试试。
text.src: Ok, I'll try to help.

text.cn: 太感谢了，大好人！
text.src: Thank you very much, good man!

text.cn: 不客气。让我看看能做点什么。|首先我得跟你丈夫谈谈。
text.src: Not at all. Let's see what I can do. At first I need to talk to your husband.

text.cn: 那个倒霉蛋查尔斯跟你说什么了？
text.src: What has this unlucky fellow, Charles, told you?

text.cn: 你丈夫的举动相当古怪。|不过他倒帮我弄明白了一件事。|你最后一次见到孩子是什么时候？
text.src: The behavior of your husband is rather strange. But he helped me understand one thing. How long ago did you see your child?

text.cn: 我不知道，这很难说清。|我只记得他才几个月大，|我把他抱在怀里。|他那么小，那么惹人疼……
text.src: I don't know. This is hard to measure. I remember one thing he was only several months old and I hold him in my hands. He was so small and cute...

text.cn: 嗯……你确定你有过孩子？|说不定压根儿就没有孩子？
text.src: Umph, are you sure that you had a child? May be there is no child at all?

text.cn: 什么？！！！你是想|说我疯了吗？！！！滚出去！！！
text.src: What?!!! Are you going to tell me that I'm insane?!!! Go away!!!

text.cn: 那赏金呢？……
text.src: What about money?..

text.cn: 你丈夫也是这么说的。|这可真够怪的。
text.src: Your husband told me the same thing. This is rather strange.

text.cn: 听着，我本不想说，|可他迷上了某种'东西'。|你明白我什么意思。
text.src: Look, I didn't want to tell you but he addicted to some kind of stuff. You understand what I mean.

text.cn: 行。我再去跟他谈一次。
text.src: Ok. I go and talk to him once again.

text.cn: 有眉目了吗？
text.src: Have you find out anything?

text.cn: 唉，这话不好听，但你听我说。|我就是个流浪汉，|走过的城镇村落没有一百也有八十。|可我这么久以来就没见过一个|孩子……恐怕你永远也找|不到你的孩子了。
text.src: Umph, it's hard to believe in, but listen to me. I'm just a vagrant and I have visited a lot of cities and villages. But I haven't seen children for the long time... I'm afraid that you will never find your child.

text.cn: 唉，我命好苦！钱拿去吧，|我现在用不着了。
text.src: O, poor me! Here is your money I don't need it now.

text.cn: 多谢，不过这钱我要。
text.src: Thank you but I need it.

text.cn: 有话快说，我忙着呢。|我正听美妙的音乐呢。
text.src: Talk fast that you want I'm busy. I listen to wonderful music.

text.cn: 音乐？！我怎么没听见什么音乐，|还美妙的呢。我想问问丢孩子的事，|你老婆正为这事着急呢。|孩子上哪儿去了？
text.src: Music?! I didn't near any music, moreover wonderful. I'd like to know about lost child, your wife worries about him. Where did he disappear?

text.cn: 音乐在我脑子里，我听得见。|我一直在听。孩子的事我一概不知。|我只记得他才几个月大，|我把他抱在怀里。|他那么小，那么惹人疼……
text.src: The music is in my head and I can hear it. I'm listening to it. I don't know anything about the child. I remember one thing, he was only several months old and I hold him in my hands. He was so small and cute...

text.cn: 你真该去看看大夫了。
text.src: You really need to go to see the doctor.

text.cn: 我不想跟你说话了。
text.src: I don't want to talk to you anymore.

text.cn: 我也说不上打听出了什么有用的。
text.src: I can't tell that I have find out something useful.

text.cn: 这就是你对他最后的记忆了？|那是多久前的事？
text.src: Is this your last memoirs about him? How long ago was it?

text.cn: 不知道，我很久没感受过时间了。|时间……时间在森林里停住了。|我那块怀表现在还停在2月|18日早上6点35分。
text.src: I don't know, I haven't feel time for a long time. Time... Time has stopped in the forests. On my personal watch now is February, 18 6:35 am.

text.cn: 我的表也是这个时间。
text.src: My watch shows the same.

text.cn: 你撒谎，你根本没表。|走开。不，还是我自己走吧。
text.src: You lie, you don't have any watch. Go away. No, I better go.

text.cn: 唉，真晦气，让他化油器堵死去吧。
text.src: Yeah, tough luck, drill his carburetor.

text.cn: 你有没有想过，是你的表不走了？
text.src: Don't you think that your watch isn't working?

text.cn: 它当然不走了——|你上回见到还走字儿的表是|什么时候的事？咱们在这儿聊着，|外头说不定已经过了好几个钟头，|甚至好几天。你就没琢磨过这事儿？
text.src: Of course, it doesn't work, when did you see working watch for the last time? We are talking here and at the same time many hours or may be days have passed. Don't you think about it?

text.cn: 你待在这儿别走，|我去跟凯特商量一下再回来。
text.src: Stay here and don't go away, I'll discuss it with Kate and go back.

text.cn: 咱们是不是在哪儿见过？
text.src: Haven't we met anywhere before?

text.cn: 我十五分钟前刚跟他说过话。|那个'瘾'是怎么回事？
text.src: I talked to him 15 minutes ago. What about drug addiction?

text.cn: 毒品？'迷梦菇'可不算毒品……|好吧，被你逮着了。|我全招——但有个条件：|不许把我这毛病告诉任何人。|镇上的人不会理解我的。|听着，时间这东西的感觉特别古怪。|照我自己的感觉，|我见到那孩子是很久以前的事了。|说不定都过去好几十年了。|可我老婆不肯听这些。
text.src: Drugs? Pipe dream mushrooms are not drugs... Ok, you've caught me. I'll tell you everything but on condition that you won't tell anybody about my mania. People from community won't understand me. Listen the feeling of time is very strange. According to my feelings I saw the child long ago. May be even some decades ago. But my wife don't want to listen to it.

text.cn: 啊哈！这才是实话。|凯特听了肯定感兴趣。
text.src: Aha! That is the truth. It will be interesting to Kate to know it.

text.cn: 那个……
text.src: Say...

text.cn: 早上好！
text.src: Good morning!

text.cn: 你自己觉得这天好，它就是好的。
text.src: If this day is good for you it is good.

text.cn: 是吗？也许吧。你知道那辆|飞行器是谁的吗？
text.src: Yes? May be. Do you know whom this flying vehicle belongs to?

text.cn: 这没什么好保密的。|这辆生来就会飞的飞行器，|属于住在迷失森林里的部落。
text.src: There is no secret about it. This vehicle born to fly belongs to the tribe which lives in the Forest of Lost.

text.cn: 我怎么才能去那片森林？
text.src: How can I go to this forest?

text.cn: 沿着大路走，路自然会把你带过去。
text.src: Follow the road and it will lead you to it.

text.cn: 你搞什么？！拿我开涮呢？！|我知道去哪儿都得沿着路走。|我问你的是，具体走哪条路？
text.src: What are you doing?! Areyou goofing on me?! I know that to go somewhere you need to go along the road. I ask you, what particular road?

text.cn: 可有些地方，光靠路是到不了的。
text.src: But some places you can't reach along the road.

text.cn: 行了！给我指个去森林的道儿，|就这么简单，行不行？
text.src: Listen! Show me the way to this forest and that's all, ok?

text.cn: 我可以给你指路，|但那可不是你想要的那种'路'。
text.src: I will show you the way but it is not the road you need.

text.cn: 你只管指，剩下的我自己会判断，|行了吧？
text.src: You just show me and all other things I can judge on my own?

text.cn: 你想明白你活着为了什么吗？|你要去哪儿，又为什么去？你是谁？|我又是谁？留下来吧，|咱们一起琢磨琢磨这些难题……
text.src: Do you realize the aim of your life? Where do you go and why? Who are you? And who am I? Stay here and we will try to answer these difficult questions together...

text.cn: 行了，全明白了。我走了。
text.src: Ok, everything is clear. I 'm off.

text.cn: 机器人把我们从工厂里赶了出来。|工厂就是我们的命根子。|好在还找到了这座矿井。
text.src: Robots expel us from the factory. Factory is our life. It's good we manage to find this mine.

text.cn: 你们挖什么矿？
text.src: And what do you mine?

text.cn: 呃……这个……这不重要。|工厂的事我心里已经不难受了，|所以不想跟你多聊。
text.src: Yah ....This... This is not important I'm not sorry about the factory so I don't want to talk to you.

text.cn: 那我不打扰了。
text.src: I won't disturb you.

text.cn: 工厂解放了！我们的日子又有|奔头了！堵住工厂道路的烂|木头已经清掉了，|就剩把工厂大门修好这一件事了。
text.src: Factory is free! And our life is not aimless again! The logjam blocked the road to the factory we have already cleared one thing is left to repair the factory main entrance.

text.cn: 那你们挖什么矿？
text.src: Ok, what do you mine?

text.cn: 不知道！我刚来这村子没多久。
text.src: I don't know! I came to this village not long ago.

text.cn: 行，现在我全明白了。
text.src: Ok, now everything is clear to me.

text.cn: 什么风把你吹到我们这儿来了，|外乡人？
text.src: What thing have brought you to us, stranger?

text.cn: 一股想给人添堵的强烈愿望。
text.src: Great desire to embitter somebody's life.

text.cn: 那你为什么上我们部落来？|我们可是安分守己的居民。
text.src: And why did you come to our tribe? We are peaceful dwellers.

text.cn: 为什么？你们不是用那飞行|器朝我开过火吗？
text.src: Why? Haven't you shot at me from your flying vehicle?

text.cn: 抱歉，外乡人。那是个误会。
text.src: Sorry, stranger. But this is a mistake.

text.cn: 你是想说，你们是失手打着我的？
text.src: You are going to say that you have shot at me accidentally?

text.cn: 不是，关键是——|我们压根儿就没朝你开过火。|我们的飞行器早就飞不起来了。|部落里好几代人都想修好它，|都没成。我看啊，是修不好了。
text.src: No, the case is that we haven't shot at you at all. Our flying vehicle can't fly for a long time yet. Many generations of our tribe tried to repair it, but unsuccessfully. Now I think it is impossible.

text.cn: 是吗？为什么修不好？
text.src: Yes? Why?

text.cn: 我们没有能让它重新上天的零件！|早先我们还能从山里的工厂|弄到需要的部件，|可机器人一来，就全完了。
text.src: We don't have spares to make it fly in the sky again! Earlier we received the required parts from the Factory in the hills but when robots came everything was over.

text.cn: 机器人？
text.src: Robots?

text.cn: 那些铁疙瘩见什么毁什么。|领头的家伙也有辆飞行器——|不过跟咱们这种飞法不一样。
text.src: These iron creatures destroy everything on the road. They are ruled by a man who has flying vehicle but it does not fly like ours.

text.cn: 那你们这辆能飞？
text.src: And does your vehicle fly?

text.cn: 现在不能，但它本来可以。|只要我们能凑齐所有零件。
text.src: No but it could. If we managed to get all the spares.

text.cn: 那个带机器人来的家伙，|他的飞行器是不是噪声很大、|能悬在半空中？
text.src: Does the vehicle of the man who brings robot have loud noise and can hang in the air?

text.cn: 正是。
text.src: That's right.

text.cn: 麻烦了！！就是那种飞行器|朝我开的火。你知道我上哪|儿能找到它吗？它总不能永|远在天上飞，早晚得落地加油。
text.src: That's tough!! A vehicle like that shot at me. Do you know how can I find this flying vehicle? It can't fly forever it must be fueled somewhere from time to time.

text.cn: 兴许吧。去问问山里工厂的人。|他们的地盘是最先被机器人占的。|关于机器人和它们主人的事，|他们知道的兴许比我们多。
text.src: Maybe. Ask people from the Factory in the hills. Their lands were occupied by robots at first time. Maybe they can tell you about robots and their master more than we can.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Ok.

text.cn: 欢迎你。有传言说，|多亏了你，那伙可恶的机器|人才被清理干净。
text.src: We welcome you. Rumors come to us that we are obliged to you for the liquidation of terrible robots.

text.cn: 没错，是我。
text.src: That's true.

text.cn: 我们该怎么报答你？
text.src: How can we acknowledge you?

text.cn: 有个特别简单的法子！|我知道你们把渡船上的发动|机拆下来了。是真的吗？
text.src: There is one very easy way! I know that you have removed the engine from the ferry. Is that true?

text.cn: 是有这么回事。它和其他配|件一起放在棚子里。|可惜对我们没用。
text.src: That is it. It is in the shed with other spares. Unfortunately it hasn't suited us.

text.cn: 太好了！既然用不上，|那不如把它让给我？
text.src: Excellent! If it hasn't suited you maybe you give it to me?

text.cn: 抱歉，这不可能。|凡是可能用得上我们圣物飞|行器的东西，都得留在这儿。|要不……我们可以拿它换点别的。
text.src: Sorry, but it is impossible. Everything that can be useful for our relic vehicle must stay here. Maybe we wil exchange it for something else.

text.cn: 我出钱买行不行？|拿着钱想买什么不是更方便？
text.src: I can pay for it? It can be easier for you to buy something for money.

text.cn: 你这话说得也在理，|不过价钱可不小——十万。
text.src: You words are not senseless but the price is high 100,000.

text.cn: 对一台旧发动机来说这价够黑的了，|不过我赶时间。
text.src: It is rather a high price for old engine but I'm short of time.

text.cn: 你疯了吧，这钱都够买辆新车了！
text.src: You are crazy, you can buy a new vehicle for that money!

text.cn: 钱凑够了吗？
text.src: Have you found money?

text.cn: 我们心里总有种说不清的感觉，|拽着我们往天上去。|谁也不知道为什么？|可那辆飞行器本可以帮我们找到答|案的。
text.src: Some strange feelings inside pull us to the sky. Nobody knows why? But the flying vehicle could have helped us to find answers.

text.cn: 这种念头我早压下去了。
text.src: I suppressed such kind of feelings.

text.cn: 你是谁？
text.src: Who are you?

text.cn: 早上好。听说这儿收土匪的人|头换钱。伊森的人头，你能给多少？
text.src: Good morning. I am told that here heads of bandits are exchanged for money. How much will you give me for Ethan's head?

text.cn: 你该不会以为我会先付钱吧？
text.src: Don't you think I will pay you in advance?

text.cn: 什么叫先付？伊森已经|死在我手上了。你知道的，|往他化油器里灌了把沙子——|他还想让我交出全部钱财货色，|换他饶我一命呢。
text.src: Why in advance? I killed Ethan. You know, sand to his carburetor, he suggested that I give him all money and goods to leave me alive.

text.cn: 这倒像伊森的做派。那你怎么回的？
text.src: It's Ethan's style. What did you do?

text.cn: 我们互相问候了对方祖宗一阵子。|然后他就气炸了。
text.src: We offend each over for some time. And then he burst with anger.

text.cn: 行，我信了。你叫什么名字？
text.src: Ok, I trust you. What's your name?

text.cn: 我叫瓦根特。
text.src: My name is Vargant.

text.cn: 认不出我了？
text.src: Don't you recognize me?

text.cn: 认不出，我有这个义务吗？
text.src: No, do I have to?

text.cn: 你跟我一位老朋友长得太像了，|我都有多少年没见过他了。|看着你，我打定主意——|正好解决我一个难题。
text.src: You are very similar to my old friend I haven't seen him for ages. Looking at you I have decided that I can solve one of my problems.

text.cn: 让电瓶火花劈死我吧！|解决麻烦就是我的老本行！|只有一个问题——价钱。
text.src: Strike me dead by accumulator spark! To solve problems is my job! There is only one question - money.

text.cn: 拆了我的变速箱！咱们是不是见过？
text.src: Break down my gear set! Haven't we met before?

text.cn: 啊哈。那会儿你还管我这'|独眼破车'来着。
text.src: Aha. You call my one-eyed crock that time.

text.cn: 独眼！没错！那时候你还把我的卡|车撞得够呛呢。这可真是缘分！|多少年没见了！真后悔当初|离开了你。话说，|你那山间小屋的梦想怎么样了？
text.src: One-eye! That's right! You heavily broke my truck at that time. What a meeting! Haven't seen you for ages! I regret that I have left you. But what about your dream of a small house on hill?

text.cn: 我现在就住在山坡上的房子里了。|你不喜欢这栋吗？|咱们能重逢，可是天大的运气。
text.src: But I have already lived in the house on the hill. Why don't you like this one? It's great luck that we have met.

text.cn: 那这奖金是不是也该涨涨了？
text.src: Isn't this a cause to increase my reward?

text.cn: 不，赏金还是照原来说好的。|不过，能再帮我办件事吗？|当然，事成之后另有酬谢。
text.src: No your reward will be as agreed before. But can you do one thing for me? Of course, there will be a reward.

text.cn: 我愿意免费帮你。
text.src: I'm ready to help you for free.

text.cn: 为您我什么都干！|尤其是报酬丰厚的时候。
text.src: I can do anything for you! Especially for good payment.

text.cn: 祝你马到成功。不久前，|我的金库丢了一件东西。|说实话，丢的东西本身我不心疼，|可这事竟然能发生，这才是要命的。|我怀疑是我的哪位队长起了二心。|我会把你安插进此人的队伍，|一旦发现可疑之处，立刻向我报告。
text.src: I hope you will be a success. Not long ago one thing was stolen from my treasury. To tell the truth I'm not angry about the stolen thing but the fact is that it was possible to do. I suspect treason from one of my captains. You will be appointed in the squad of this man and if you notice something suspicious let me know immediately.

text.cn: 这活儿没我想的那么难，|但也没那么容易！行，我接了。
text.src: It is not going to be so hard as I have expected but not so easy! Ok, I'll do it.

text.cn: 多谢。去找阿梅里戈队长，|告诉他你被编入了他的队伍。|眼睛放亮些。
text.src: Thank you. Find Capitan Amerigo and tell him that you are appointed to his squad. Keep your eyes open.

text.cn: 放心！
text.src: Sure!

text.cn: 你是知道的，我们一直努力|按规矩过日子，就像从前那样。|我们的目标是唤醒被遗忘的规矩，|重建失落的文明。
text.src: You know, we are trying to live according to the rules, as we did before. Our aim is to revive forgotten rules and restore the lost civilization.

text.cn: 这我明白。那你们干的事|怎么跟别人一个路数？|干起脏活儿来，你们也不害臊，|是吧？
text.src: That's clear. So, why did you act like others, you don't get embarrassed to take part in dirty business, do you?

text.cn: 唉，正道哪有那么好走。|我们偶尔也会偏航。|等等，你不是还有别的正事吗？！
text.src: Eh, it's hard to follow the right way. We also stray from the way sometimes. Stop, don't you have any other business?!

text.cn: 啊……对，当然。
text.src: A... of course.

text.cn: 向您致敬，尊敬的先生。
text.src: My respect, dear sir.

text.cn: 你就是破布客？
text.src: Are you Ragman?

text.cn: 正是在下。想买点什么？还是想卖？|信我的，我这儿的价钱最实在。
text.src: Yes, that's me. Do you want to buy anything? Or maybe sell? Trust me, here my prices are the most real.

text.cn: 先告诉我这玩意儿是干什么用的，|然后咱们再谈价钱。
text.src: At first tell me what is this thing needed for? Then we speak about the price.

text.cn: 这么件古物，您是从哪儿弄来的，|尊敬的先生？
text.src: Where did you get such an artifact, dear sir?

text.cn: 实话实说，路上捡的。
text.src: To tell the truth I found it on the road.

text.cn: 路上捡的，尊敬的先生？|这可不大像实话。|我捡过的每样东西，|直到最后一道划痕我都记得|清清楚楚。这个盒子是我多|年前在老废墟里发现的，|后来卖给了本地总督。|听说她金库最近被抢了！|抢匪的人头悬赏一万块。|尊敬的先生，现在您还有|什么要说的？
text.src: You say on the road, dear sir? It does not sound like the truth. Everything I found I remember to the last scratch. I found this box many years ago on the old ruins and sold it to the local governor. I heard that her treasury has been robbed recently! For the head of the robber 10,000 dollars were set. What would you tell me now, dear sir?

text.cn: 你不会觉得是我干的吧？
text.src: Don't you think it was me?

text.cn: 这用不着想。东西被偷了，|然后一个外乡人拿着它上门，|还说是捡的。不过嘛——|只要您付我500块，|尊敬的先生，我就当什么都没看见。
text.src: It doesn't need to think here. This thing was stolen and then here comes the stranger with it and tells me that he found it. But I won't tell anybody if you pay me, dear sir, 500 dollars.

text.cn: 要不我干脆做点什么，|让你永远闭嘴？
text.src: Maybe I should do something to make you silent forever?

text.cn: 我看你有点自不量力啊，小子。|就你，还想从我这儿讨到便宜？
text.src: I think that you are taking too much upon you, kid. Can you get a piece of me?

text.cn: 我正打算做道养生菜——|原汤炖子弹填破布客。
text.src: I'm going to cook the dietetic dish - Ragman stuffed with bullets in own juice.

text.cn: 行，钱给你。
text.src: Ok, here is your money.

text.cn: 跟您做生意真痛快。|随时都能找到我。
text.src: It's nice to deal with you. You can find me anytime.

text.cn: 记住了。
text.src: I'll keep it in mind.

text.cn: 先生，有何吩咐？
text.src: How can I help you, sir?

text.cn: 跟我说说，老兄……|你们这儿有没有两个司机非|打到分出生死不可的规矩？|我来的时候撞见了一处战斗的痕迹，|车辆只剩下残骸了。
text.src: Tell me, man... Do you have custom here between two drivers to fight to a finish? When I came here I stumbled upon traces of battle. Only wreckages have left after the vehicles.

text.cn: 没有的事，先生！|这儿的人可安分了。|我不知道该跟您说什么。
text.src: No, sir! People here are very peaceful. I don't know what to tell you.

text.cn: 你觉得一件独一无二又特别|值钱的东西，会不会就是那场|恶斗的起因？
text.src: Do you think a unique and very expensive thing can be the reason for the battle?

text.cn: 这谁知道呢，先生？|您该不是担心这种事儿在这儿|不算稀奇吧？其实很少发生。|倒是护卫的活儿挺抢手。|您随便去哪座城找个酒保打听打听。
text.src: Who knows, sir? Maybe you are afraid that such things are not rare here? They happened not very often. But guards are in demand. You can ask any barman in any city.

text.cn: 我对当护卫没兴趣。|我搞的是古物收藏。
text.src: I'm not interested in guard work. I collect artifacts.

text.cn: 先生，这我就不知道说什么好了。|古物我不在行……我是土豆专家。|您还是去跟商人聊聊吧。|前阵子就有个商人把我的土|豆收割机买走了。
text.src: I don't know what to tell you, sir. I'm not an expert in artifacts... I'm a potato expert. You'd better to talk to merchants. One of them has sold my potato combine recently.

text.cn: 圣油啊！你那些神经病商|人我才懒得理会！
text.src: Holy fuel! I don't care about your nut merchants!

text.cn: 说实话，土豆我也不感兴趣。
text.src: I'm not interested in potato really.

text.cn: 您误会我了。我们这儿有个|跑江湖的商贩，大家顺口|叫他破布客。人家不收土豆|不收木柴，专倒腾些老物件。|他成天在城和垃圾场之间来回打转。|不过时不时的，还真能淘到有|用的东西。要说古物行家，|您最好去找他聊。
text.src: You have misunderstood me. We have here one vagrant merchant. We call him Ragman for fun. Instead of buying potato and timber he trades some old things. He yo-yos back and forth between cities and dumps. But from time to time one can buy a useful thing. So he is an expert in artifacts you'd better to talk to him.

text.cn: 破布客？行，我去找找他。
text.src: Ragman? Ok, I'll try to find him.

text.cn: 我在残骸堆里找到了这个盒子。|我想弄清楚它到底是什么。
text.src: Between the wreckage I have found this box. I'd like to find out what is this.

text.cn: 恐怕我帮不上忙，先生。
text.src: I'm afraid I can't help you,sir.

text.cn: 要不这点钱能帮您把记忆捋清楚？
text.src: Maybe some money will refresh your memory?

text.cn: 先生？您还是先把您那辆车修修吧！|都快散架了，亲爱的。|这车正好够格进破布客的收藏。|他专收这类老古董，|说不定会把这辆老爷车收了。
text.src: Sir? You'd better repair your car at first! It's almost falling apart, dear. It right suits for the collection of Ragman. He collects all this ancient stuff. Maybe he will buy this jitney.

text.cn: 老古董，有意思……|他那铺子开在哪儿？
text.src: Ancient stuff, it's interesting?  Where is his shop situated?

text.cn: 破布客从不在一个地方落脚，|成天来来回回地跑。|您在城四周找找吧。|只要您那辆破车别半道散架，|他兴许还能给您个不错的价。|拿着这点钱，先生，|把车稍微拾掇拾掇。
text.src: Ragman doesn't sit at one place. He yo-yos back and forth. Look for him around the city. If your shandrydan doesn't fall apart he can give you a good price. Take some money, sir, and repair it a little.

text.cn: 你倒会说'破车'，|也不看看你自己那辆！
text.src: You say Shandrydan, I see. Look at your own car!

text.cn: 两个人为了这盒子把命都搭上了，|你就连猜都猜不出它是什么？
text.src: Two guys killed each other because of this box and you can't even suppose what it can be?

text.cn: 我真是不知道……|去找破布客吧。他是个跑江|湖的商贩，在城与城之间来回跑，|倒腾古代器物。说不定他能帮上您。
text.src: I don't even know... Try to find Ragman. He is a vargant merchant he travels between the cities and trades ancient artifacts. Maybe he could help you.

text.cn: 行！祝您愉快，土老帽——|三个气缸卡您嗓子眼儿里！
text.src: Ok! Have a good time, country bumpkin, three cylinders in your throat.

text.cn: 多谢，老伙计！
text.src: Thank you, old chap!

text.cn: 哦，是您啊，尊敬的先生！|找到破布客了吗？
text.src: Oh, it is you, dear sir! Have you found Ragman?

text.cn: 你那位破布客可真是个奸商。
text.src: Your Ragman is a real speculator.

text.cn: 找到了。愿他安息。
text.src: Yes, I've found him. R.I.P.

text.cn: 先生，事情办得如何？
text.src: How is your searching, sir?

text.cn: 事情嘛，有点不得劲。
text.src: Business is a bit groggy.

text.cn: 看您这眼神，离目标还远着呢吧？
text.src: In your eyes I see that you are far away from your aim?

text.cn: 唉，可不是。
text.src: Aha.

text.cn: 听着，外乡人，我这儿有笔|赚钱的买卖给你。
text.src: Listen, stranger, I have a profitable deal for you.

text.cn: 我忙着呢。
text.src: I'm busy.

text.cn: 这回要放干谁的油箱？
text.src: Whose fuel tank am I going to empty?

text.cn: 事情还挺正经的。|我有个叔叔，家底非常殷实。|他却扔下我们全家在穷坑里|自生自灭。
text.src: Everything is rather serious. I have an uncle he is a very prosperous man. He left our family to vegetate in the grip of poverty.

text.cn: 真是个催人泪下的故事！
text.src: That a pitiful story!

text.cn: 帮我摆脱这个狠心的吸血鬼！|我会付你钱，别怕。
text.src: Help me get rid of this ruthless bloodsucker! I'll pay you, never fear.

text.cn: 你还是哪儿凉快哪儿待着去吧。|瞧你，装得跟个穷苦受害者似的。
text.src: You'd better go away. Look at him the povetry victim.

text.cn: 哟，你真是个狠角色，|炸了你的化油器吧。|我的收费可是很贵的，给我记住了。
text.src: Oh, you are a real villain, blow up your carburetor. My services are very expensive, keep it in mind.

text.cn: 倒不是价钱的问题——|不过你得当心，我叔叔的护|卫可不是吃素的。
text.src: It is not the question of price, but be careful, my uncle has good guards.

text.cn: 摊上这种亲戚，早晚能想通。
text.src: With such kind of relatives one may dawn upon it.

text.cn: 多谢你帮了大忙。
text.src: Thank you for your help.

text.cn: 小意思。
text.src: No problems.

text.cn: 我什么都不需要了。|没你帮忙，我自己也把事儿办完了。
text.src: I don't need anything. I've done everything without your help.

text.cn: 多谢。
text.src: Thank you.

text.cn: 你到底什么时候才把事办完？
text.src: Whenever will you perform the task?

text.cn: 别担心，一切尽在掌握。
text.src: Don't worry, everything is under control.

text.cn: 我巴不得我叔叔这会儿就已|经不在这世上了。
text.src: I cannot wait until my uncle go out of the world.

text.cn: 再等等，很快就会办妥的。
text.src: Wait a little and everything is going to be ok.

text.cn: 听着，我知道你是专杀土匪的狠人。|路上的土匪让你拧着屁股教|训得那叫一个惨。想赚点钱吗？
text.src: Listen, I know you are a bandit killer. I see how famously you have griped the bandit ass on the road. Do you want to get money?

text.cn: 什么麻烦事？
text.src: What's the problem?

text.cn: 麻烦是我兄弟麦克斯韦。|我们是双胞胎，懂吗？|打小他就跟我形影不离。|我走到哪儿，每面镜子里都能|看见他。我受够了。|帮我把他从我的世界里除掉。
text.src: The problem is my brother Maxwell. We are twins, understand? Since childhood he has been following me. Wherever I go in every mirror I can see him. I'm tired of it. Free me from his presence.

text.cn: 不，现在不行。
text.src: No, not right now.

text.cn: 等我做完这单，希望你别后悔。
text.src: I hope you will regret it when I finish the mission.

text.cn: 想听个秘密吗？
text.src: Do you want to hear one secret?

text.cn: 想，我最爱听秘密了。
text.src: Yes, I like secrets.

text.cn: 这个秘密值500金币。
text.src: This secret costs 500 coins.

text.cn: 我没钱。
text.src: I don't have money.

text.cn: 不用了，谢谢。
text.src: No, thanks.

text.cn: 成交！
text.src: Go it!

text.cn: 多谢。秘密很简单。|我会在你地图上标出一个地方——|土匪把赃物藏在那儿。|只要你肯下功夫，就能找到。|不过，我跟那帮土匪的交情，|你就别打听了。
text.src: Thank you. The secret is simple. On your map I'll mark one place where bandits have hidden the stolen goods. You can find it if you try your best. But don't ask me about my relations with the bandits.

text.cn: 我没兴趣。
text.src: I'm not interested.

text.cn: 这宝贝就值100金币？|行吧，我倒要去瞧瞧。
text.src: It is interesting to know that this treasure is only 100 coins. Ok, I'll go and see it.

text.cn: 你好，外乡人。想参加赛车吗？|报名费100金币。
text.src: Hello, stranger. Do you want to take part in the races? Participation due - 100 coins.

text.cn: 没这闲工夫。改天吧。
text.src: I don't have time for this. Maybe another time.

text.cn: 我没钱。
text.src: I don't have money.

text.cn: 嗯……行吧。赛程怎么走？
text.src: Yeah... All right. What is the route?

text.cn: 起点在这儿，终点在墨西哥村。|赢家通吃。
text.src: Start is here. Finish is in a Mexico village. The winner gets everything.

text.cn: 太远了，我不去。
text.src: It's too far I won't go.

text.cn: 行。比赛什么时候开始？
text.src: Ok. When does the race start?

text.cn: 时间到，走你！
text.src: Time goes!
Go!!!

text.cn: 你总算到了。
text.src: Here you are.

text.cn: 我拿了第几？
text.src: What is my place?

text.cn: 你输了。
text.src: You have lost.

text.cn: 爆我的轮胎！真倒霉！|行吧，今天不算我的日子。
text.src: Blow out my tires! It's a tough break! Okay, it was not my day.

text.cn: 第一名。奖金归你了。
text.src: Firat place. The prize is yours.

text.cn: 好极了！！！
text.src: Excellent!!!

text.cn: 阳光洒在我脸上，|多少年没听过鸟叫了。|什么风把你吹到我们的地界来了，|外乡人？
text.src: The stream of sun lights up my face for many years I haven't heard the birdsong. What thing have brought you to our lands, stranger?

text.cn: 你好，酋长！听说过埃德蒙顿吗？
text.src: Hello, chief! Have you heard anything about Edmonton?

text.cn: 聪明的鸟儿不会跑到蛮荒之|地碰运气。这城我听说过。
text.src: Sagacious bird doesn't seek fortune in the outlands. I heard about this city.

text.cn: 你知道有谁能帮我吗？|最好还能搞到张地图。
text.src: Do you know anybody who could help me? It will be good to find the map also.

text.cn: 不是每张地图都能通向你要|去的地方。离这儿不远住着个人，|人称万事通。传言他是地图|方面的行家，不过他自己死不承认。
text.src: Not every map leads to the aim. Not far away from here lives one man called Wiseguy. There are rumors that he is an expert in maps but he doesn't tell anybody about it.

text.cn: 万事通是谁？我上哪儿找他？
text.src: Who is Wiseguy? Where I can find him?

text.cn: 伟大的力量就藏在旧时的知识里。|他住得离这儿不远，|在一栋荒废的屋子里。|他的真名叫杰克·诺瓦尔。
text.src: Great power is hidden in the knowledge of the past. He lives not far away from here in the forsaken house. His real name is Jack Noval.

text.cn: 多谢，老哥。
text.src: Thank you, buddy.

text.cn: 你们这些家伙，答复就俩字——|没门，想都别想。
text.src: You guys, answer's a lemon, not even try it.

text.cn: 你指谁？
text.src: Who do you mean?

text.cn: 你，还有萨姆！明白吗？！
text.src: You and Sam! Understand?!

text.cn: 圣油保佑！你嚷嚷什么？
text.src: Holy fuel! Why are you shouting?

text.cn: 跟你们这种家伙说话，|就得这副腔调。滚吧！
text.src: This is the only way to talk to such guys as you are. Piss off!

text.cn: 我看你脑子有点毛病。|我该怎么跟萨姆回话？
text.src: I think you are nut a little. What should I tell Sam?

text.cn: 让他往自己排气管里塞个大|土豆去吧！
text.src: Tell him to put a big potato in the exhaust pipe!

text.cn: 随你的便。
text.src: As you want.

text.cn: 你好。想玩两把带彩头的牌吗？
text.src: Hello. Do you want to play a card game for money?

text.cn: 我不赌钱。
text.src: I'm not a player.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Ok.

text.cn: 先下注。赢了，彩金翻三倍。
text.src: Make a bet before. If you win you will have three times bigger winning.
450 dollars.
150 dollars.
50 dollars.

text.cn: 整副牌我就留了四张，|所以规矩特别简单。|妙就妙在这四张花色各不相同。|哈哈。我从中抽一张，|你的任务就是猜出它是哪张。
text.src: I have only four cards from the whole pack, so the rules are very simple. It's good that cards are of different suits. Ha-ha. I will pull one card for you. Your task is to guess what it is.

text.cn: 梅花J。
text.src: Jack clubs.

text.cn: 方块6。
text.src: Six diamonds.

text.cn: 黑桃A。
text.src: Ace spade.

text.cn: 红桃10。
text.src: Ten hearts.

text.cn: 猜错了！不是这张！
text.src: You have missed! It was another card!

text.cn: 唉，我有预感。
text.src: Eh, I feel it.

text.cn: 哎呀，见鬼了！！你猜对了！|彩金拿去。
text.src: Oh, strike me pink!! You are right! Here is your winning.

text.cn: 多谢！我真是走运。
text.src: Thank you! I'm a lucky beggar.

text.cn: 欢迎你，外乡人。|看你身强力壮，脑子也灵光。|能帮我挖点东西吗？
text.src: I welcome you, stranger. I see that you are strong and smart enough. Could you help me with diggings?

text.cn: 圣油保佑！不干！我忙得很。
text.src: Holy fuel! No! I'm busy enough.

text.cn: 看看再说。把要做的事详细说说。
text.src: We'll see. Tell me in details what to do.

text.cn: 这一带村子里埋着不少宝贝。|其中一样是禁书。|你要是走运能挖到，|我绝不会亏待你。
text.src: There are a lot of treasures in these villages. One of them is Forbidden books. If you have luck and you will find them I'll make it worth while.

text.cn: 听着就可疑。你另请高明吧。
text.src: It looks suspicious. Look for another fool.

text.cn: 这有什么难的。
text.src: There is nothing difficult here.

text.cn: 多少人挖过这批窖藏。|随便哪个本地人都会告诉你，|它就埋在管道交错的什么地方。|这片管道里里外外都被翻了个遍，|全都白忙活。
text.src: Many people dug to get this buried treasure. Any local resident will say you that it is somewhere near the pipes plexus. These pipes were explored through the length and breadth, and everything was in vain.

text.cn: 走着瞧吧，说不定我的运气更旺。
text.src: We'll see maybe I have more luck.

text.cn: 太好了！正是那几本书！|但愿你没偷看——不然的话……|等等，拿着吧。你凭本事挣|来了拥有它的权利。
text.src: Excellent! These are the very same books! I hope you didn't read them otherwise... But wait - take it. You have honestly deserved the right to own this thing.

text.cn: 多谢，可这是什么玩意儿？
text.src: Thank you, but what is this?

text.cn: 这是寻宝探测器！|在普通人手里它就是个玩具，|但对寻宝猎人来说，|这可是独一无二的宝贝。
text.src: This is a treasure detector! For the common people it is just a toy but for the hunter for ancient treasures it's a unique thing.

text.cn: 太好了，爆你的轮胎！
text.src: Excellent, blow out your tires.

text.cn: 你好，老弟。我这儿有份活儿给你。
text.src: Hello, buddy. I've got a job for you.

text.cn: 行，你说。
text.src: Yeah, I listen.

text.cn: 需要抢在对手前头，|把包裹送到萨姆手里。|记住，赢家通吃。
text.src: It needs to deliver package to Sam faster than our competitors. But keep in mind the winner gets everything.

text.cn: 不感兴趣。
text.src: It's not interesting.

text.cn: 没问题。包裹拿来。
text.src: No problems. Give me the package.

text.cn: 你好。我这儿有笔稳当的买|卖想跟你做。
text.src: Hello. I have a safe business proposition for you.

text.cn: 我看没那么稳当。
text.src: I think it is not safe enough.

text.cn: 报酬多少？
text.src: What is the reward?

text.cn: 够买一台新发动机的。
text.src: It will be enough to buy new engine.

text.cn: 行。要我做什么？
text.src: Ok. What I should do?

text.cn: 非常轻松的活儿。|把包裹送到宾夕万斯克我朋|友那儿就行。
text.src: It is a very easy job. You should deliver the package to my friend in Pelsyvansk.

text.cn: 这种鬼鬼祟祟的买卖，我没兴趣。
text.src: I'm not interested in so hanky-panky business.

text.cn: 行，我接了。这活儿确实轻松。
text.src: Ok, I'll do it. It is really an easy job.

text.cn: 听着！
text.src: Listen!

text.cn: 这儿有位老兄托你把包裹送出去。
text.src: One man here asks you to deliver the package.

text.cn: 什么包裹？我什么都不知道。
text.src: What package? I don't know anything about it.

text.cn: 嘿，老兄，你要是想告诉我，|我在这儿纯属浪费时间，|那我会非常失望的。明白吗？
text.src: Hey, buddy, if you are going to tell me that I'm wasting my time here I will be very disappointed. Do you understand?

text.cn: 你是个明白人。我看咱们能|做成这单买卖。说吧。
text.src: You are a sharp fellow. I think we'll make deal. Tell me.

text.cn: 我还说什么？埃科先生告诉我，|你会把货给我，然后告|诉我送到哪儿。
text.src: What should I tell you? Mister Eco has told me that you give me cargo and tell where to deliver it.

text.cn: 对，都没错。我把货装你车上。|送到小苹果城去。路上当心！
text.src: Yes, everything is correct. I will put it in your vehicle. Deliver it to Small Apple. Watch out!

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Ok.

text.cn: '我不知道'是什么意思？|你跟我编什么鬼话呢？
text.src: What do you mean 'I don't know'? What the cock-and-bull stories are you telling me?

text.cn: 什么意思？编故事的是你，|可不是我。
text.src: What do you mean? You are a storyteller, not me.

text.cn: 我没编故事！！！
text.src: I don't tell stories!!!

text.cn: 嘿，老兄，趁还没出事，|你最好赶紧走。
text.src: Hey, dude, you'd better go until something has happened.

text.cn: 哇，你可真吓人，我好怕怕哦！
text.src: Wow, you are so terrifying, I'm so afraid!

text.cn: 有什么事？
text.src: What do you want?

text.cn: 有个包裹要交给你。
text.src: I've got a package for you.

text.cn: 怎么不邮寄？
text.src: Why not by mail?

text.cn: 因为邮政都快瘫了200年了。|这可是十万火急的重要货。
text.src: Because the mail hadn't worked for almost 200 years. Very urgent and important cargo.

text.cn: 希望没有尾巴跟着你吧？！|行，运费我该付你多少？
text.src: I hope there were no tails after you?! Ok, how much do I owe you for delivery?

text.cn: 老规矩。
text.src: As usual.

text.cn: 拿去吧。祝你好运。
text.src: Take it. Good luck.

text.cn: 回见。
text.src: Bye.

text.cn: 我在找一个会使枪的正派人。
text.src: I look for an honest man who can handle with weapon.

text.cn: 干什么？
text.src: For what?

text.cn: 能帮我们的聚落除掉一个土|匪走私犯吗？
text.src: Can you free our settlement from one bandit smuggler?

text.cn: 报酬给足，为什么不行？
text.src: For good payment, why not?

text.cn: 太好了，就指望你了。
text.src: Excellent, we reckon on you.

text.cn: 不过，你还是另请高明吧。
text.src: Nevertheless, expect for somebody another better.

text.cn: 最好先把我的报酬定好。|不管他是不是土匪，|弹药可都是要钱的。
text.src: You'd better think over my payment. Wheteher he is a bandit or not but ammunition costs a lot.

text.cn: 祝你一路平安，旅行者！
text.src: I wish you a safe road, Traveller!

text.cn: 我这儿有个包裹要交给乔。|认识他吗？
text.src: I've got a package for Joe. Know him?

text.cn: 老乔谁不认识。巧了，正是在下。
text.src: Everyone knows old Joe. In fact, that's me.

text.cn: 运费您得付。
text.src: You've got to pay for the delivery.

text.cn: 乔的账从来不欠。|这是你的500块。
text.src: Joe always pays his bills. Here's your $500.

text.cn: 跟我说说，乔，上哪儿能找到丑角？
text.src: Tell me, Joe, where can I find Harlequin?

text.cn: 乔这就告诉你。城的这一片归狗帮。|把车停下，你自然能听见丑|角的笑声。
text.src: Joe will tell you where to find him. This part of the town belongs to Dogs. Stop the car and you'll hear Harlequin's laughter.

text.cn: 多谢，乔。
text.src: Thanks, Joe.

text.cn: 你好呀，小帅哥。
text.src: Hello, cutey.

text.cn: 有机械师吗？
text.src: Is there a mechanic?

text.cn: 在这儿你的卡车可加不了油。
text.src: You can't refuel your truck here.

text.cn: 丑角？
text.src: Harlequin?

text.cn: 他曾经是狗帮老大斗牛犬的左右手。|这儿没人会帮狗帮的敌人。
text.src: He used to be the right hand of Dog's Boss - Bulldog. No one here will help a Dogs' enemy.

text.cn: 看来没别的辙了，|只能夜里去偷卡车的零件和汽油。
text.src: There seems to be no other way, but to steal truck parts and petrol at night.

text.cn: 要么，你就去给加菲尔德的猫|帮干活。给加菲尔德卖命，|你就有钱有油。加菲尔|德就在别墅里。告诉他，|是凯蒂介绍来的。
text.src: That or you can work for Garfield's Cats. If you work for Garfield, you'll have money and petrol. You can find Garfield at the Villa. Tell him, you are from Kitty.

text.cn: 多谢。
text.src: Thanks.

text.cn: 不客气。你的卡车别担心，|会被洗得干干净净、油加得满满的。|就当自己家，别拘束。
text.src: You're welcome. Don't worry about your truck. It will be washed and refueled. Feel at home.

text.cn: 多谢，老板。我是来谈活儿的。|凯蒂说您这儿正招人。
text.src: Thank you, Sir. I came to talk about a job. Kitty said you're hiring people.

text.cn: 没错。听说你就是在正面决|斗中干掉丑角的那位。|你的身手肯定没得说，我雇你了。
text.src: Yes, that's right. I've heard you are the one who killed Harlequin in a just combat. You must be really good, so I'm hiring you.

text.cn: 多谢，老板。
text.src: Thank you, Sir.

text.cn: 给你派个活儿。有一支车队|正给狗帮运货。护卫里我们买|通了一些，但没全买通。|你得赶过去，把护卫队长干掉。|祝你好运！
text.src: I'll give you a task. A caravan delivers some cargo to the Dogs. We bribed some of the guards, but not all of them. You've got to get there and kill the Chief Guard. Good luck!

text.cn: 我这就去办，老板。
text.src: I'll do it, Sir.

text.cn: 有何贵干，袭击者？
text.src: What do you want, Raider?

text.cn: 出什么事了？这是怎么了？
text.src: What's up? What's going on?

text.cn: 你走之后，利己者那头猪对老|娘的卡车下了黑手。|现在车成了一堆废铁。
text.src: That pig Egoist had a go at my truck after you left. The truck is a heap of junk now.

text.cn: 每一道刮痕他都得还账。|他现在在哪儿？
text.src: He'll pay for each and every scratch. Where is he now?

text.cn: 他过桥去圣拉斐尔撒野去了。|想不想去宰了他？
text.src: He's gone to paint the town red to Saint-Rafael, over the bridge. Want to kill him?

text.cn: 我有个更好的主意。
text.src: I have a better idea.

text.cn: 你疯了吗？来这儿干什么？
text.src: Are you crazy? Why did you come?

text.cn: 我不想给猫帮卖命。|我想入你这一伙。
text.src: I don't like working for the Cats. I want to join your gang.

text.cn: 你以为就这么简单？|你可杀了我最得力的人。
text.src: Do you think it's all that simple? You've killed my best man.

text.cn: 我要能杀了他，就说明他不|是最强的。
text.src: He wasn't the best if I killed him.

text.cn: 不管怎么说，我得看到点你的投|名状。
text.src: Anyway, I need some proof of your loyalty.

text.cn: 我知道利己者现在在哪儿。|他在圣拉斐尔，身边就带几个护卫。
text.src: I know where Egoist is now. He is in Saint-Rafael, with only a few guards.

text.cn: 鬼才信！你想让我过去自投罗网？|你要觉得我会信，那你就太蠢了。
text.src: Like hell he is! You want me to go there and end up in a trap? You're a fool if you think I'm buying it.

text.cn: 我去把他提来。
text.src: I'll go fetch him.

text.cn: 很高兴又见到你，旅行者。
text.src: Good to see you again, traveller.

text.cn: 我需要帮助。
text.src: I need help.

text.cn: 你可来对地方了。
text.src: You've come to the right place.

text.cn: 我得翻过这道山岭。
text.src: I need to get over the ridge.

text.cn: 有一条隧道通到山那头。|只要对这座山心存敬意，|它自会放你过去。
text.src: There is a tunnel that leads to the other side. Just show the mountain your respect and it'll let you pass.

text.cn: 就这么多？
text.src: Is that all you can say?

text.cn: 这已经足够了。
text.src: That's more than enough.

text.cn: 多谢，牧师。
text.src: Thank you, Reverend.

text.cn: 求你别杀我。
text.src: Please, don't kill me.

text.cn: 你活着更值钱。跟我去见波恩。
text.src: You are worth more alive. You'll come with me to Borne.

text.cn: 只要留我一条命……
text.src: Just let me live...

text.cn: 你手里应该有通关证。交出来。
text.src: You've got to have the customs pass. Give it to me.

text.cn: 事情办得怎么样了？
text.src: So, how is it going?

text.cn: 他捆结实了，就在卡车里。
text.src: He is tied, he is in the truck..

text.cn: 我跟猫帮约好在老路口见面。|把人带到那儿去。
text.src: I arranged to meet the Cats at the crossroads. Bring him there.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Ok.

text.cn: 喂，离远点。信不信老|娘把你眼珠子挠出来，癞蛤蟆。
text.src: A-hey, keep off. I'll scratch your eyes out, toad.

text.cn: 别激动，别激动。|我是来放你出去的。
text.src: Easy, easy. I came here to set you free.

text.cn: 多谢！
text.src: Thanks a lot!

text.cn: 你现在就走吧。我来等狗帮。
text.src: You'd better go now. I'll wait for the Dogs.

text.cn: 是你吗？乔多谢你救了他这条命。
text.src: Is that you? Joe is grateful to you for saving his life.

text.cn: 顺手而已。我本是来找波恩算账的，|可惜没找着。所以我要走了。|走之前去跟牧师道个别。
text.src: I had to. I came here to kill Borne, but I couldn't find him. So, I'm leaving. I'll go say good bye to Reverend.

text.cn: 乔祝你汽油永远纯净！
text.src: Joe wishes you pure petrol!

text.cn: 你也一样，乔！
text.src: Same to you, Joe!

text.cn: 你已经走到'路'的尽头了，|旅行者。
text.src: You've reached the end of the Road, Traveller.

text.cn: 接下来我该怎么办，牧师？
text.src: What am I to do next, Reverend?

text.cn: 这得由你自己决定。|定下你的目标吧。|朋友若是帮不上你，|兴许敌人会为你指路。
text.src: It's up to you to decide. Set your goal. Perhaps your enemy will show you the way, if your friend fails.

text.cn: 你知道上哪儿能找到他吗？
text.src: Do you know where to find him?

text.cn: 一切会在它开始的地方结束。
text.src: It will all end where it started.

text.cn: 多谢，牧师。
text.src: Thank you, Reverend.

text.cn: 干得漂亮！没有你，我们成不了事。
text.src: Good job! We wouldn't have made it without you.

text.cn: 战斗里我看见凯蒂的卡车了。|她怎么样？
text.src: I saw Kitty's truck in the battle. How is she?

text.cn: 放心，她安然无恙。|我的人把她押到老农场去了。|老加菲尔德得为她的自由掏腰包。|这期间，我们会把她面罩一|片片剪下来寄给他。
text.src: Don't worry, she is allright. My men brought her to the old farm. The old Cat will have to pay for her freedom. In the meantime we'll be cutting pieces off her mask and sending them to him.

text.cn: 我还是去检查一下你的人看|没看好她吧。猫帮肯定都气疯了！
text.src: I'd better check if your men are guarding her well. The Cats must be furious!

text.cn: 查一查也无妨。去吧。
text.src: There's no harm in checking. Go and do it.

text.cn: 好的，老大。
text.src: Ok, Boss.

text.cn: 这里很危险。让我带你离开这里。
text.src: It’s a dangerous place. Let’s get you out of here.

text.cn: 你是谁？！外面有那么多劫匪！|还有更多卡车不断涌来！
text.src: Who are you?! There so many bandits out there! And more trucks keep arriving!

text.cn: 我们得继续前进了。|你跟我们一起吗？
text.src: We’ve got to move on. Are you with us?

text.cn: 好的！我留在这里会被杀的……
text.src: Yes! They’ll kill me if I stay…

text.cn: 不杀光他们我不走。他们是杀人犯！
text.src: I’m not leaving this place until we kill them all. They are murderers!

text.cn: 我们打不过他们。|想活命就跟着我们。
text.src: We stand no chance against them. Follow us if you want to live.

text.cn: 哼。我会回来的！
text.src: Hrrr. I’ll be back!

text.cn: 你差点就被杀了。|我的人及时赶到了。
text.src: You were this close to getting killed. My people arrived just on time.

text.cn: 你是谁？为什么要帮我？
text.src: Who are you and why did you help me?

text.cn: 我们帮助所有需要帮助的人。
text.src: We help all people in need.

text.cn: 你还没回答我的问题！
text.src: You haven’t answered my question!

text.cn: 世界上最勇敢、最聪明的人被召|唤吸引到这里来。|但大多数都在这里找到了归宿……|我告诉他们这些，他们就是不听。
text.src: The bravest and the smartest people from all over the world come here lured by the Call. But most of them find their end here… And they wouldn’t listen to me when I tell them that.

text.cn: 我必须找到伊万·戈。|我走了这么远的路——|现在不会停下来。
text.src: I’ve got to find Ivan Go. I’ve gone such a long way – I’m not going to stop now.

text.cn: 我记得我遇见的每一个人。|我知道你说的人。他走得太远了。
text.src: I remember everyone I meet. I know the man you are talking about. He’s gone too far.

text.cn: 伊万死了吗？
text.src: Is Ivan dead?

text.cn: 发生在他身上的事比死亡更可怕。|而且同样不可逆转。
text.src: The thing that happened to him is worse than death. But it’s just as irreversible.

text.cn: 别卖关子了。告诉我他在哪里。
text.src: Stop talking mysteries. Tell me, where he is.

text.cn: 你见到他之前不会明白的，|但那时就太晚了。|如果你一定要去，就去追他吧。|等你回来我们再谈。
text.src: You won’t understand until you see him, but then it’ll be too late. Go after him, if you have to. We’ll talk again after you come back.

text.cn: 好的
text.src: OK

text.cn: 你的意志力令人钦佩！|你居然能抵抗天籁之音。
text.src: Your willpower is impressive! You could resist the voice of heaven.

text.cn: 我不知道你在说什么。
text.src: I don’t know what you are talking about.

text.cn: 很少有人有足够的力量从源点返回。|我们等了你好多年。
text.src: Few find enough strength to return from the Source. For years we’ve been waiting for you to come.

text.cn: 说正事吧。
text.src: Let’s get to the point.

text.cn: 你命中注定要阻止那些陷入|疯狂的人。
text.src: You are destined to stop the madness that seized all those people.

text.cn: 我会尽力的。但先告诉我，|这里发生了什么？
text.src: I’ll do what I can. But tell me first, what happened here?

text.cn: 很多年前，我们的世界完全不同。|有庞大的国家，住着数百万|人的城市，还有能替你干|活的聪明机器！一切都很简单。|但突然间世界崩溃了。
text.src: Years ago our world was different. There were huge countries, cities with millions of dwellers, clever machines that did your work for you! Everything was simple. But suddenly the world collapsed.

text.cn: 聪明的机器？我才不信……|发生了什么？
text.src: Clever machines? I wouldn’t trust them… What happened?

text.cn: 军队发现了一个不明飞行物，|并立即将其击落。|你在路上看到了它。|我是被派去调查这个神秘物|体的小组成员之一。|当时国家处于战争边缘。|我们是仅存的几个研究这个|UFO的科学家。|难怪我们太急太不小心了。
text.src: Military forces spotted an unidentified flying object, which was immediately brought down. You saw it on your way. I was part of the group that was sent to examine the mysterious object. The country was on the verge of war. We were the only scientists left studying this UFO. Little wonder we were in hurry and a bit careless.

text.cn: 我听不太懂，但继续吧……
text.src: It all makes little sense to me, but go on…

text.cn: 当我们登上飞船——|那是一艘飞船，毫无疑问——|我们欣喜若狂。我们想到了无|限的可能：新药物、|超强材料、革命性技术……|但我们找到的却是死亡：|几个科学家被机器压死了，|我的三个同事自杀了。|最可怕的事发生在我们打|开中央舱的一个密封舱时……
text.src: When we got on board the ship – it was a ship, no doubt – we were ecstatic. We thought of the endless opportunities: new medicine, ultrastrong materials, revolutionary technologies… But we found death instead: several scientists got crushed by the machines, 3 of my colleagues committed suicide.  But the worst thing happened when we opened a sealed cell in the central tank…

text.cn: 你不该这么做的……|怎么能无视那些警告标志？
text.src: You shouldn’t have done it… How could you ignore all those warning signs?

text.cn: 但我们是科学家！我们不信迷信。|不管怎样，打开那扇门的一刻，|一切都失控了。我的同事们……|他们的身体爆炸了……|然后我听到脑海里有一个奇|怪的声音……我昏了过去，|醒来时已经在外面飞船旁|边的营地里了。我呼叫救援，|但没人来。无线电一片寂静。|我意识到灾难降临了。
text.src: But we are scientists! We don’t believe in superstition. Anyway, the moment we opened that door, all hell broke loose. My colleagues… their bodies exploded… and I heard this strange voice inside my head… I blacked out and when I woke up, I was outside the ship, in the camp. I called for help, but nobody came. The radio was silent. I realized that there was a catastrophe.

text.cn: 所以，你为了满足好奇心而毁|灭了世界！
text.src: So, you’ve destroyed the world to satisfy your curiosity!

text.cn: 是的。这让我痛不欲生。|我应该受到惩罚，|但我感觉不到痛苦。|天知道我试过多少次自杀，|但都无济于事——我死不了！|太可怕了。我以为我是唯|一的幸存者，但越来越多的人|开始出现。当我看到他们变|异得那么厉害时，我吓坏了……|看看我，或者看看你自己！|我都不敢想你的面具下面是|什么样子……
text.src: Yes. And it’s killing me. I’ve got to be punished, but I don’t feel pain. God knows how many times I tried to kill myself, but all in vain – I can’t die! It was terrible. I thought I was the only survivor, but more people started to arrive. I was horrified when I saw how much they mutated… Just look at me or at yourself! I dread to think what’s under your mask...

text.cn: 你在说什么？我们戴面具|是因为空气被污染了！
text.src: What are you talking about? We are wearing masks because the air is contaminated!

text.cn: 随你怎么说。就当是空气吧。|重要的是那个设备还在运作，|不断污染大气层。
text.src: Whatever. Let it be the air. What matters now is that the device is still working and it keeps contaminating the atmosphere.

text.cn: 如果我们关掉它，|人们会恢复正常吗？|你为什么不回去关掉设备？
text.src: If we turn it off, are people going to be normal again? Why didn’t you go back and stop the device?

text.cn: 我既无法靠近设备，|也无法离开这里。|我注定要留在这里看着。|我唯一能做的就是求人去毁|掉那个该死的东西。|不过到目前为止还没人成功过……
text.src: I can neither come close to the device, nor leave this place. I am doomed to stay here and watch. All I can do is ask people to destroy the damn thing. Not that anyone succeeded...

text.cn: 你给人类带来了太多伤害。|我要把你和这里一起炸掉！
text.src: You’ve done the humanity so much harm. I’m gonna blow up this place along with you!

text.cn: 这已经是我不敢奢望的了。|我们已经把样本送到了西北|方的军事基地。他们现在可|能已经有结果了，|会告诉你如何摧毁源点。|就算人都死了，基地的人工|智能应该还在运行。
text.src: It’s more than I could ask. We’ve taken samples to the north-western military complex. They’ve probably got the results now and will tell you how to destroy the Source. Even if the people are dead, the AI of the complex should be still functioning.

text.cn: 我去过那里，对你们的人工|智能很了解。它自称为神谕。
text.src: I’ve been there and I know this AI of yours pretty well. It calls itself the Oracle.

text.cn: 祝你好运。希望你能在别人|失败的地方成功。
text.src: Good luck to you. I hope you will succeed where other people failed.

text.cn: 再见。我想我不会再见到你了。
text.src: Good bye. I don’t think I’ll see you again.

text.cn: 我必须拯救那些人。|一定有办法不用太靠近就能|关掉机器。
text.src: I’ve got to save all those people. There must be a way to turn the machine off without getting too close.

text.cn: 伊万·戈曾说过天空中有奇怪的光。|当他看到飞船时并不怎么惊讶。|他可能早就见过了。
text.src: Ivan Go talked about strange lights in the sky. And he wasn’t all that surprised when he saw the space ship. He’s probably seen it already.

text.cn: 他的朋友本·斯罗特尔可能|知道些什么。我必须和他谈谈。
text.src: His friend Ben Throttle might know something about it. I must talk to him.

text.cn: 去吧，愿好运伴随你。
text.src: Off you go and may luck be with you.

text.cn: 我需要好运。
text.src: I’ll need it.

text.cn: 我帮不了你什么。|去做你该做的事吧。
text.src: There’s nothing I can do for you. Go and do what you have to do.

text.cn: 不容易，但我会做到的。
text.src: It won’t be easy, but I’ll make it.

text.cn: 你抵抗住了伟大的召唤，陌生人。|让我给你这个。
text.src: You resisted the Great Call, stranger. Let me give you this.

text.cn: 什么召唤？！
text.src: What call are you talking about?!

text.cn: 嘘，他们在监视我们。|这是最后一本书的副本，|告诉你我们的世界发生了什么。
text.src: Hush, they are watching us. This is the last copy of the book that tells you what happened to our world.

text.cn: 嘿，你去哪？他走得急匆匆的……
text.src: Hey, where are you going? He left in a hurry...

text.cn: 今天是比赛日！谁都可以参加！
text.src: Today is the race day! Anyone can take part in it!

text.cn: 不感兴趣。
text.src: Not interested.

text.cn: 算我一个。
text.src: Count me in.

text.cn: 你需要交5000金币参赛|费加上5000金币保险费。
text.src: You’ve got to pay the participant’s fee of 5,000 coins + 5,000 the insurance cost.

text.cn: 我有保险了，所以不用给我那辆车。
text.src: I have insurance, so I’m not giving you that car.

text.cn: 说得对。
text.src: Fair enough.

text.cn: 什么车？你在说什么？
text.src: What car? What are you talking about?

text.cn: 赛车是很贵的车。|如果你弄坏了，得赔偿。
text.src: The bolide is an expensive car. You’ll have to compensate its cost if you break it.

text.cn: 我没那么多钱！
text.src: I don’t have so much money!

text.cn: 算了，我走了。
text.src: Nah, I’m out of here.

text.cn: 成交。规则是什么？
text.src: It’s a deal. What are the rules?

text.cn: 规则很简单：抢跑或撞坏车就出局。|第一名奖金40000，|第二名20000，|第三名10000。|修理费会从保险费里扣除，|所以你可能拿不回全部的5000。
text.src: The rules are simple: you lose if you make a false start or if you crush the car. 1st prize is 40,000, 2nd – 20,000, 3rd – 10,000. The repair works will be extracted from the insurance cost, so you might not get all of your 5,000 back.

text.cn: 明白了。来吧！
text.src: I see. Come on!

text.cn: 你可以试试运气和车技，赢取大奖！
text.src: You can try your luck and your driving skill and win the main prize!

text.cn: 我要做什么？
text.src: What do I need to do?

text.cn: 穿过布满陷阱的迷宫。|很危险，但刺激得很！
text.src: Go through the maze full of traps. It’s dangerous, but the adrenaline is worth it!

text.cn: 这不是我的乐趣所在。
text.src: It’s not my idea of fun.

text.cn: 我想试试！
text.src: I’d like to have a go at it!

text.cn: 好。参赛费1000。|如果你跑到终点，奖金归你。|不行的话，抱歉了兄弟！
text.src: Good. The participant’s fee is 1,000. If you get to the end, the prize is yours. If not, then, sorry man!

text.cn: 我没钱。
text.src: I don’t have money.

text.cn: 成交。
text.src: Deal.

text.cn: 你是来买保险的吗？
text.src: Have you come here to get insurance?

text.cn: 你们提供什么样的保险？
text.src: What sort of insurance do you give?

text.cn: 我们可以为你的赛车投保损坏险。|如果你撞坏了，我们赔偿修理费。
text.src: We can insure your car against damage in the race. If you crush it, we’ll compensate the repair costs.

text.cn: 我不需要。
text.src: I don’t need it.

text.cn: 保险多少钱？
text.src: How much does the insurance cost?

text.cn: 1000金币。如果车损坏了，|退你一半；如果撞废了，全额不退。
text.src: It costs 1,000. If the car gets damaged, we’ll return you half the sum, but if you crush it, we’re keeping the whole sum.

text.cn: 就这些？
text.src: Is that all?

text.cn: 还有一件事。如果你赢了，|我们要拿25%的奖金。
text.src: There’s one more thing. In case of your victory, we’ll get 25% of the prize.

text.cn: 我没钱。
text.src: I don’t have money.

text.cn: 我不买。
text.src: I’m not buying it.

text.cn: 条件听起来还行。|我想给我的赛车买保险。
text.src: Your conditions don’t sound too bad. I’d like to insure my bolide.

text.cn: 欢迎来到成年男人的娱乐世界！
text.src: Welcome to the world of grownup men entertainment!

text.cn: 你们的娱乐有什么特别的？
text.src: What’s so special about your entertainment?

text.cn: 我们帮你释放真实本性，|感受极致快感！
text.src: We help to unleash your true nature and feel utter pleasure!

text.cn: 怎么回事？
text.src: How’s that?

text.cn: 你将有机会与势均力敌的对手交手，|而不只是杀一群蠢劫匪。
text.src: You’ll get a chance to kill your match, not just a bunch of stupid bandits.

text.cn: 我不想冒险。
text.src: I don’t want to risk my butt.

text.cn: 听起来有趣。我想试试。
text.src: Sounds interesting. I’d like to try.

text.cn: 好的。规则是这样的……
text.src: Good. So, here are the rules...

text.cn: 看！是他们！
text.src: Look! It’s them!

text.cn: 谁？
text.src: Who?

text.cn: 屠杀你村庄的人。
text.src: The people who massacred your village.

text.cn: 你确定？我现在就能报仇！
text.src: Are you sure? I can get my revenge right here!

text.cn: 绝对没错。那就是我在村里|看到的卡车。
text.src: Absolutely. That’s the truck I saw in the village.

text.cn: 是时候报仇了。血债血偿。
text.src: It’s time for revenge then. Blood for blood.

text.cn: 我觉得他们只是雇佣兵。|跟踪他们，找到真正的凶手。
text.src: I think they are just mercenaries. Let’s follow them and find the true murderers.

text.cn: 你为什么要杀我们，陌生人？
text.src: Why do you want to kill us, stranger?

text.cn: 几个月前你们袭击了我的村庄，|杀了所有人。
text.src: You’ve attacked my village and killed all of our people several months ago.

text.cn: 你在说什么，兄弟？|我们不会离开自己的城镇|超过自卫的范围。
text.src: What are you talking about, man? We wouldn’t go further than it takes to defend our towns.

text.cn: 好久没在这些地方看到新面孔了。|把这里当自己家吧，陌生人！
text.src: It’s been ages since we saw a new face in our lands. Make yourself at home, stranger!

text.cn: 我在找一个人……
text.src: I’m looking for a man...

text.cn: 别找了。你来到了世界上最|好的地方。我们城镇的花|园和喷泉曾被最伟大的诗人赞颂！|还有什么比这更好的呢？
text.src: Stop looking. You’ve come to the best place in the world. The gardens and the fountains of our town have been glorified by the greatest poets! What more could a man want?

text.cn: 我既没看到花园，也没看到喷泉。
text.src: I see neither gardens, nor fountains here.

text.cn: 沙漠里的恶鬼每天都在袭|击我们的房屋，沿途摧毁一切。|我们必须时刻警惕……|所以我们的纪念碑都荒废了。|没有好好维护，它们都在坍塌……|太可惜了！
text.src: Every day the evil demons of the desert raid our houses and destroy everything on their way. We have to be always on guard – that’s why our monuments are neglected. Without due care they crumble... What a shame!

text.cn: 但有人能帮我找到那个人吗？|他几年前经过这些地方。
text.src: But can anyone help me find the man I need. He passed these places several years ago.

text.cn: 我们不记录旅行者的行踪，|我们有别的烦心事。|不过我们的长老可能帮得上忙。|但他们已经离开了城镇。
text.src: We don’t keep track of the travelers; we’ve got other things to worry about. Our elders might be of help, though. But they’ve left the town.

text.cn: 他们去哪了？
text.src: Where have they gone?

text.cn: 这我不知道。去问问我们的邻居吧，|他们可能知道。比如凯夫。
text.src: Of this I do not know. Ask our neighbors, they might tell you. Try Kef, for instance.

text.cn: 谢谢，我去凯夫碰碰运气。
text.src: Thanks, I’ll try my luck in the Kef.

text.cn: 晚上好，旅行者。|什么风把你吹到这么远的地方？
text.src: Good night, traveler. What brought you so far?

text.cn: 你好。几年前有个叫伊万的人|经过这里。他没有回来，|我需要找到他。这里有人能帮我吗？
text.src: Greetings. A man called Ivan passed these places several years ago. He hasn’t come back, and I need to find him. Is there anybody who might help me here?

text.cn: 恐怕没有。我们的长老，|记忆的守护者，已经离开了我们。|我们不知道他们去了哪里，|也找不到他们。但我们一直在找！
text.src: I’m afraid not. Our elders, the memory keepers, have left us. We don’t know where they’ve gone and we can’t find them. We are trying though!

text.cn: 他们为什么离开？
text.src: Why did they leave?

text.cn: 大概是因为战争吧。|不断的袭击让我们变得虚弱，|也疏忽了长老。我们忘了世上还有|美好的东西。满脑子只想活着。|但你让我思考，我们这样的生|活还值得过吗？
text.src: Because of the war, I guess. The incessant attacks made us weak and neglectful to our elders. We forgot that there is beauty in the world. All we are thinking about is survival. But you’ve made me think, is the kind of life we have worth living?

text.cn: 你说的很奇怪。
text.src: Strange things you are saying.

text.cn: 我们的一支搜救队很快就会回来。|等一等，他们可能有长老的消息。|同时，你能帮帮我们吗？
text.src: One of our rescue parties is going to come back soon. Wait a while; they may have news of the elders. In the meantime, could you help us out?

text.cn: 什么事？
text.src: What is it?

text.cn: 石油是我们的命脉。|没有它，卡车停摆，|在袭击者面前毫无还手之力。
text.src: Oil is our blood. Without it, our trucks will stop and we’ll be totally helpless before the attackers.

text.cn: 确实如此。你们的石油怎么了？
text.src: You sure will be. But what happened to your oil?

text.cn: 油田干涸了。去哈兹夫又太危险。|你有胆量，陌生人。请帮帮我们！
text.src: The oil field has gone dry. And it’s too dangerous to go to Khazif. You have guts, stranger. Help us, please!

text.cn: 你想让我运一罐油回来？
text.src: Do you want me to bring you a tank of oil?

text.cn: 好，我们给你一辆油罐车，|你不在时我们会照看你的卡车。
text.src: Yes, we’ll give you a tank-truck and take care of your truck while you are away.

text.cn: 听起来很危险。我不想卷入。
text.src: Sounds dangerous. I don’t want to get involved in it.

text.cn: 好的。但请不要碰我卡|车上的任何东西！
text.src: Ok. But please don’t touch anything on my truck!

text.cn: 你拿到了吗？
text.src: Have you got it?

text.cn: 没有，有点急事。|但我会替你弄到的。
text.src: No, something urgent came up. But I’ll get it for you.

text.cn: 这是你的货物。
text.src: Here’s your cargo.

text.cn: 该死。原油不能直接给卡车用，|给我们炼油的技工也不见了。
text.src: Damn. Crude oil is no good for our trucks and the mechanic who distills oil for us has gone.

text.cn: 他怎么了？
text.src: What happened to him?

text.cn: 我猜他不喜欢我们。|不过他可能会听你的。|请把他带回来。
text.src: He didn’t like us, I guess. He might listen to you, though. Please, get him back.

text.cn: 我去哪里找他？
text.src: Where will I find him?

text.cn: 这附近没多少地方可去。|所有村庄都被烧毁了。|他一定是去加达德了。
text.src: There aren’t many places to go around here. All villages are burnt down. He must have gone to Ghadad.

text.cn: 我会把他带回来。|到时候希望你们有长老的消息。|我真的需要和他们谈谈。
text.src: I’ll bring him back. By that time I hope you’ll have some information about the elders. I really need to talk to them.

text.cn: 你愿意为我们做吗？
text.src: Will you do it for us?

text.cn: 什么？
text.src: What?

text.cn: 石油！你能给我们运石油吗？
text.src: The oil! Will you bring us the oil?

text.cn: 我有更重要的事要做。
text.src: I’ve got more important things to do.

text.cn: 好的，我来做。
text.src: All right, I’ll do it.

text.cn: 你在找什么？
text.src: What are you looking for?

text.cn: 你有没有看到另一个城镇来的技工？
text.src: Have you seen the mechanic from the other town here?

text.cn: 看到了。他头发乱糟糟的，|行为很奇怪。
text.src: Yes, I saw him. He was all disheveled and acted really strange.

text.cn: 他从这里去了哪里？
text.src: Where has he gone from here?

text.cn: 他提到了飞船墓地……
text.src: He mentioned the ship cemetery...

text.cn: 谢谢。
text.src: Thanks.

text.cn: 请不要碰我。
text.src: Please, don’t touch me.

text.cn: 我不会伤害你。
text.src: I’m not going to harm you.

text.cn: 我不信任任何人。|这里的人做事太疯狂！
text.src: I don’t trust anyone. People do crazy things around here!

text.cn: 为什么？
text.src: Why is that?

text.cn: 我什么都不知道，也不想跟你说话。
text.src: I know nothing and I don’t want to talk to you.

text.cn: 这老头疯了。我想我还是|得把他带回凯夫。|不过我觉得他对那里的人帮助不大。
text.src: The old chap has gone out of his mind. I guess I’ll have to take him to Kef anyway. I don’t think he’ll be of much help to its people, though.

text.cn: 你不敢的。放我走！|我想知道这个世界上还有|没有其他活着的人。|我绝不回凯夫，绝不！！！
text.src: You won’t dare. Let me go! I want to know, if there are other living people in this world. I’m not coming back to Kef, no way!!!

text.cn: 为什么？
text.src: But why?

text.cn: 我发现了真相。我承受不了。|但我也不能活在谎言里。
text.src: I found the truth. And it’s more than I can bear. But I can’t live in lie either.

text.cn: 听着，你的车能穿过沙漠。|往东南走，你会找到城镇，|那里充满生机和快乐的人。|也许在那片绿色的牧场上，|你能更快恢复内心的平静。
text.src: Listen, your car will make it through the desert. Go to the south-east and you will find towns there, full of life and happy people. Perhaps you’ll restore your piece of mind there sooner, among the green pastures.

text.cn: 你是说还有其他幸存者？你放我走？|太感谢了。
text.src: Are you saying there are other survivors? And you’re letting me go? Thank you so much.

text.cn: 我回凯夫怎么说？
text.src: What am I going to say in Kef?

text.cn: 那我只能用强了。
text.src: I’ll have to use force then.

text.cn: 我宁可死！
text.src: I’d rather die!

text.cn: 该死。什么把他吓成这样？|我回凯夫怎么说？
text.src: Damn. What scared him so much? And what am I going to say in Kef?

text.cn: 我没看到技工。你没找到他？
text.src: I don’t see the mechanic. You didn’t find him?

text.cn: 他不会回来了。他把自己吓死了。
text.src: He won’t come back. He scared himself to death.

text.cn: 坏消息。但我相信你已经尽力了。
text.src: Sad news. But I believe you’ve done everything you could.

text.cn: 那你能告诉我去哪里找你们的长|老吗？
text.src: So, you’ll tell me where to find your elders?

text.cn: 是的，我们找到了他们的村庄。|老人们住在海边。|等我们从上次袭击中恢复过来，|就会再派搜救队去接他们。|长老们需要合适的住所和照料，|我们愿意提供这些。
text.src: Yes, we found their village. The old men live on the coast. We’ll send another rescue party after them as soon as we recover from the last attack. Our elders need proper houses and care, which we are willing to give them.

text.cn: 谢谢，我会转告他们的。
text.src: Thanks, I’ll make sure they know it.

text.cn: 他们找到我们了！快跑！
text.src: They found us! Run for your lives!

text.cn: 等等！我是和平来的。
text.src: Wait! I’ve come with peace.

text.cn: 那个人看起来挺正常的。|你是怎么找到我们的？
text.src: That one looks quite normal. How did you find us?

text.cn: 镇上一个好心人给我指了路。|他说搜救队很快就来接你们。
text.src: A kind man from the town showed me the way. He said a rescue party will soon arrive after you.

text.cn: 我担心的时刻到了。|再躲下去也没意义了。|兄弟们，我们必须迎战。
text.src: The moment I dreaded has come. There’s no point in hiding anymore. We’ll have to fight that battle, brothers.

text.cn: 你在说什么？他们只是想……
text.src: What are you talking about? They only want...

text.cn: 你不明白吗？我来告|诉你我们的故事，进来吧。
text.src: Don’t you get it? I’ll tell you our story, drive in.

text.cn: 没时间讲故事了。我们正遭到攻击！
text.src: There’s no time for stories. We are under attack!

text.cn: 告诉我这里发生了什么！
text.src: Tell me what’s happening here!

text.cn: 很多年前这里是一个繁荣的地区。|我们很快就从灾难中恢复了过来，|以为可以重新开始生活。|但人们开始行为怪异。|一天欣喜若狂，第二天就眼露凶光。
text.src: Years ago this was a thriving region. We recovered from the catastrophe soon enough, and we thought we could start our life afresh. But people started to act really strange. One day they would be overjoyed, the next day they would have this evil look in their eyes.

text.cn: 我好像开始明白了。
text.src: I think I begin to understand.

text.cn: 人们试图控制自己的情绪，|但有一天一切都崩溃了。|一个男人杀了自己的家人|却对此毫无记忆。|他被处决了，但从那天起恐|惧就紧紧抓住了我们的心。|我们无法信任自己的亲人。|甚至无法信任自己。
text.src: People tried to control their emotions, but one day it all collapsed. A man killed his family and had no memory of doing it. He was executed, but ever since that day fear took a strong grip of our hearts. We couldn’t trust our relatives. We couldn’t trust ourselves.

text.cn: 所以根本没有劫匪和沙漠恶鬼？
text.src: So, there are no bandits, demons of the desert?

text.cn: 恐怕没有。有着类似疯狂周|期的人联合起来攻击其他群体。|只有少数人幸存。|他们建城镇，第二天又毁掉。
text.src: I’m afraid not. People with similar cycles of madness united to attack other groups. Only few survived. They build towns and destroy them the next day.

text.cn: 但你们是怎么避免疯狂的？
text.src: But how could you avoid the madness?

text.cn: 灾难发生时我们太老了，|感受不到强烈的情感波动。|强烈的情感是年轻人的事；|我们的职责是保存记忆、哀悼死者。|当我们意识到发生了什么时，|我们离开了城市躲避年轻人。|但这种局面维持不了太久。|我们被发现了，他们现在要杀我们。|我能感觉到他们在逼近。
text.src: We were too old to feel powerful emotions at the time of the Catastrophe. Strong emotions are for the young; our part is to keep memories and mourn the dead. When we realized what happened, we left the cities to hide from the young. But it couldn’t last long. We’ve been disclosed and they are going to kill us now. I feel them approaching.

text.cn: 在你告诉我你所知道的关于伊|万的一切之前，我不会让你死！
text.src: I won’t let you die until you tell me everything you know about Ivan!

text.cn: 太迟了。他们攻过来了。
text.src: Too late. They are attacking.

text.cn: 我和你们并肩作战。
text.src: I’ll fight on your side.

text.cn: 我们赢了这场战斗，|但他们会回来的。只是时间问题。
text.src: We won this battle, but they are going to be back. It’s just a matter of time.

text.cn: 我们怎么办？我不|能把你们留在这里，对吧？|我怎么把你们带出去？
text.src: What are we gonna do? I can’t just leave you here, can I? How can I get you out of here?

text.cn: 附近有个港口，但没有船。|不过机器看起来还能用。
text.src: There is a port nearby, but there aren’t any ships there. The machinery looks working, though.

text.cn: 我有一个呼叫救援船的装置。|你们会被疏散到人们正常的地方。|至少比这里正常。
text.src: I’ve got a device for calling a rescue ship. You’ll be evacuated to the lands where people are normal. At least more normal than here.

text.cn: 我简直不敢相信我们的运气。
text.src: I can’t believe our luck.

text.cn: 带我去港口，我来呼叫船只。
text.src: Show me the port and I’ll call the ship.

text.cn: 站住，异教徒！你为何来到神|谕的圣地？
text.src: Stay where you are, infidel! Why have you come to the sacred land of the Oracle?

text.cn: 我来神谕这里寻找答案。
text.src: I’ve come to the Oracle to get an answer to my question.

text.cn: 只有信徒才能见到他！
text.src: Only the believers can see Him!

text.cn: 我想成为信徒。让我加|入你们的社群。
text.src: I want to be a believer. Let me join your community.

text.cn: 你的想法没错。但你准备好|做出牺牲来证明你的决心吗？
text.src: You want the right thing. But are you ready to make a sacrifice to prove us your resolution?

text.cn: 我会做必要的事来入教。
text.src: I’ll do what it takes to be initiated.

text.cn: 你必须先献出武器。|杀人的人不配见神谕。
text.src: You’ll have to sacrifice your weapon first. A man who kills is not worthy of seeing the Oracle.

text.cn: 但那会让我在接下来的旅|途中成为容易的目标。
text.src: But that’ll make me an easy prey in the forthcoming trip.

text.cn: 全能的神谕会在旅途中保护你。
text.src: The almighty Oracle will protect you in your journey.

text.cn: 你要求太多了。还有别的办|法见神谕吗？
text.src: You are asking too much. Is there any other way to see the Oracle?

text.cn: 总有另一条路，但艰难且充满危险。
text.src: There is always another way, but it’s hard and full of dangers.

text.cn: 我习惯冒险了。告诉我需要做什么。
text.src: I'm used to taking risks. Tell me, what I need to do.

text.cn: 把守在活死人镇入口的钢铁|怪物的头带给我们。
text.src: Bring us the head of the steel monster that is guarding the entrance to the town of the living dead.

text.cn: 听起来很厉害，虽然我不信童话。|我怎么打败守卫？
text.src: Sounds impressive, even though I don’t believe fairy-tales. How do I defeat the guard?

text.cn: 试着引它单挑。那是你打|败它的唯一机会。|而且即使那样胜算也很小。
text.src: Try luring him to a one-on-one combat. That’s your only chance to defeat it. And even then it’s only a slim chance.

text.cn: 我宁愿杀了你！
text.src: I’d rather kill you!

text.cn: 艰难的选择，但我想我会献出武器。
text.src: It’s a hard choice, but I guess I’ll sacrifice my weapon.

text.cn: 明智的决定。仁慈的神谕|会与你分享他的智慧。
text.src: Wise decision. The gracious Oracle will share his wisdom with you.

text.cn: 希望他的建议值得这么多麻烦。
text.src: I hope his advice is worth all that trouble.

text.cn: 我会把怪物的头带给你！
text.src: I’ll bring you the head of the monster!

text.cn: 好吧。你可以拿走武器。
text.src: All right. You can take the weapon.

text.cn: 问候你，兄弟。你现在可以去|神谕那里问他问题了。
text.src: I greet you, brother. You can go to the Oracle now and ask him your question.

text.cn: 希望我做了正确的事。
text.src: I hope I did the right thing.

text.cn: 让开！我没时间跟你废话。
text.src: Get out of my way! I have no time to talk to you.

text.cn: 他在威胁我们，兄弟们！|攻击异教徒！
text.src: He’s threatening us, brothers! Attack the infidel!

text.cn: 看来这里没有和平解决的办法。
text.src: There seems to be no peaceful solution here.

text.cn: 你杀了那个怪物吗？
text.src: Did you kill the monster?

text.cn: 这是他的头。我完成了我的部分。
text.src: Here’s his head. I’ve done my part of the deal.

text.cn: 问候你，兄弟！你现在可以去|神谕那里问他问题了。
text.src: I greet you, brother! You can go to the Oracle and ask him your question now.

text.cn: 这正是我来这里的原因。
text.src: That’s exactly why I came here.

text.cn: 我还没打败它。
text.src: I couldn’t defeat it yet.

text.cn: 你怎敢打扰我，凡人？！|众神借我之口说话，|我才不在乎人类。
text.src: How dare you trouble me, mortal?! Gods speak through me and I couldn’t care less about humans.

text.cn: 回答我的问题，然后继续打你的盹。
text.src: Answer my question and sleep on.

text.cn: 你不是祭司之一吧？|我的预言是珍贵的礼物，|我要的回报也不菲。你准备好了吗？
text.src: You aren’t one of the priests, are you? My prophecies are a valuable gift, and I will ask a lot in return. Are you ready for that?

text.cn: 我穿越世界才到这里，|现在不会回头。告诉我你需要什么。
text.src: I’ve crossed the world to get here and I’m not turning back now. Tell me what you need.

text.cn: 我需要从钢铁怪物堡垒带两|件工艺品，就是愚人说的——|活死人镇。我通常只要一件，|但你有卡车，而且我看到了上|面积累的战斗痕迹。
text.src: I need two artifacts from the fortress of the steel monsters, or as the silly people call it – from the town of the dead. I usually ask for one artifact, but you’ve got a truck and I see the scars from many combats on it.

text.cn: 什么样的工艺品？
text.src: What sort of artifacts?

text.cn: 你看到就知道了。|如果不认识，那你就不配|得到我的帮助。走吧！
text.src: You’ll know when you see them. If not, then you are not worthy of my help. Off you go!

text.cn: 我很快回来。
text.src: I’ll be back soon.

text.cn: 干得好，流浪者。
text.src: Good job, wanderer.

text.cn: 是的，我带来了你要的东西。
text.src: Yes, I’ve brought what you asked.

text.cn: 我的计划终于可以启动了。|就当是神灵的祝福吧。|我会听你的故事。
text.src: My project will finally take off. Let’s consider it gods’ blessing. I’ll listen to your story.

text.cn: 我父亲被杀了。我要找到凶|手并惩罚他们。
text.src: My father was killed. I want to find the murderers and punish them.

text.cn: 凡人的问题与我无关，|但我答应帮你。我需要信息|进行分析。告诉我你知道的一切。
text.src: Problems of the mortal do not concern me, but I promised to help you. I need information for analysis. Tell me everything you know.

text.cn: 我的家被东方来的人袭击了，|来自死亡沙漠的另一边。|我必须找到他们，|但没人知道如何在那诡异的地|方生存。
text.src: My house was attacked by some people from the east, from the other side of the Death Desert. I’ve got to find them, but no one knows how to survive in that eerie place.

text.cn: 血肉之躯在那儿活不长。|但你手里拿的是什么？
text.src: A man of flesh will not survive there long. But what’s in your hands?

text.cn: 这是一张属于我父亲的光盘。|他们说你能读。也许它能|帮我找到凶手并理解他们的动机。
text.src: It’s a disc that belonged to my father. They say you can read it. Perhaps it’ll help me find the murderers and understand their motives.

text.cn: 我父亲叫伊万·戈，是一名探险家。|几年前他凭空消失，|我被他的朋友收养。|几个月前我的村庄被烧毁。|无人幸存……
text.src: My father’s name is Ivan Go, he was an Explorer. Several years ago he disappeared without a trace and I was adopted by a friend of his. A few months ago my village was burnt down. No one survived...

text.cn: 我没听到你的问题。|你想知道谁袭击了你的村庄吗？|你想要复仇？
text.src: I didn’t hear your question. Do you want to know who attacked your village? Do you seek revenge?

text.cn: 是的。我是说，不。|我觉得我父亲还活着，我想找到他。|我敢肯定村庄被袭和他失踪有关。
text.src: Yes. I mean, no. I think my father is still alive and I want to find him. I’m sure the attack on my village is somehow connected with his disappearance.

text.cn: 明白了。我不知道伊万·戈的下落。|很抱歉你白跑了一趟，朝圣者。|再见。
text.src: I see. I don’t know Ivan Go’s whereabouts. I’m sorry you’ve gone all that way, pilgrim. Good bye.

text.cn: 我不是空手来的。|这是一张属于我父亲的光盘。|他们说你能读。也许里面有|什么线索。
text.src: I haven’t come here empty-handed. Here’s a disc that belonged to my father. They say you can read it. Perhaps it contains some clues.

text.cn: 我很久没见过这种东西了。|也不记得有人带着这种问题|来找过我。不过，|在最初的时候确实有一些……
text.src: I haven’t seen anything of the kind for a long time. And I don’t recall anybody coming to me with such a question. However, in the very beginning there was something...

text.cn: 这是我唯一的希望。
text.src: That’s my only hope.

text.cn: 你带来的工艺品会有帮助。|也许行得通。但你得帮我回忆。
text.src: The artifacts you’ve brought will help. It might work out. But you’ve got to help me remember.

text.cn: 直接告诉我该做什么。
text.src: Just tell me what I need to do.

text.cn: 集中球体能量，让天光……
text.src: Concentrate the energy of the spheres, so that the celestial light...

text.cn: 谜语留给当地人吧，|直接告诉我该做什么。
text.src: Save your riddles for the locals, just tell me what I need to do.

text.cn: 把我的三个小帮手带到三根|巨石那里。这里，这里和这里。|它们会配置我的远程记忆模块。|但确保那些崇拜我的野蛮人不捣乱。
text.src: Take three of my little helpers to the three menhirs. Here, here and here. They will configure my remote memory modules. But make sure the savages who worship me don’t interfere.

text.cn: 我马上出发。现在有希望了！
text.src: I’m leaving immediately. I’ve got hope now!

text.cn: 安装新模块后我的功能大幅提升。|我还没检查所有系统。|需要一些时间。
text.src: My functionality increased significantly with the application of new modules. I haven’t checked all systems yet. It’ll take a while.

text.cn: 但做了这么多任务之后，|你有什么能确定的告诉我吗？
text.src: But is there just anything you can tell for sure me after all those tasks?

text.cn: 确实。光盘真的是伊万·戈的。|那是一本日记，包含大量|关于我们世界的信息。
text.src: Indeed. The disc really belonged to Ivan Go. It’s a diary that contains a lot of information about our world.

text.cn: 快，读最后几条记录！
text.src: Come on, read the final entries!

text.cn: 读取内容中……最后一条：|[远征准备]。
text.src: Reading the contents... The final entry: [Preparations for the expedition].

text.cn: 对，就是这个。继续读！
text.src: Yes, that’s it. Read on!

text.cn: 信息受复杂密码保护。|除非你有密钥，否则解密可|能需要好几年，这对你来说|显然不可接受。
text.src: The information is protected by a complex cipher. Unless you’ve got a key, the deciphering may take a few years, which is unacceptable for you, as I can see.

text.cn: 什么密钥？
text.src: What key?

text.cn: 根据密码和密码长度判断，|96.7%的概率是另一张光盘。
text.src: Judging the cipher and the password length, with 96,7% probability it’s another disc.

text.cn: 你开玩笑吧！我来这里|是为了得到答案，|不是被支走去找一块该死的塑料！
text.src: You must be kidding! I’ve come here to get an answer to my question, not to be sent away to look for a stupid piece of plastic!

text.cn: 寻找就会找到。可能在伊|万的遗物中。
text.src: Seek and you will find. It’s probably among Ivan’s stuff.

text.cn: 我想我该再去父亲的房子看看。
text.src: I guess I should visit father’s house again.

text.cn: 从内容判断，光盘上有能|让你穿越放射性沙漠的装置图纸，|还有别的东西。
text.src: Judging by the contents, the disc contains the scheme of the device that allows you to cross the radioactive desert among other things.

text.cn: 太好了！继续。
text.src: Great! Go on.

text.cn: 光盘上还有很多关于一个叫|伊万·戈的人的信息。
text.src: The disc also contains a lot of information about a man called Ivan Go.

text.cn: 原来我们是对的，|我已故的父亲和那个人有密切联系。
text.src: Turns out, we were right and my deceased father was closely connected with that man.

text.cn: 然而，这些信息受到复杂密码保护。|除非你有密钥，否则解密可|能需要好几年，这对你来说|显然不可接受。
text.src: However, the information is protected by a complex cipher. Unless you’ve got a key, the deciphering may take a few years, which is unacceptable for you, as I can see.

text.cn: 什么密钥？
text.src: What key?

text.cn: 根据密码和密码长度判断，|96.7%的概率是另一张光盘。
text.src: Judging by the cipher and the password length, 96,7% probability it’s another disc.

text.cn: 我该去哪找？
text.src: Where am I to find it?

text.cn: 问跟你一起来的那个姑娘。|她会告诉你的。再见。
text.src: Ask the girl who came with you. She’ll tell you. Good bye.

text.cn: 等等！我还没跟你说完！他走了……|看来我得问丽莎几个问题。
text.src: Wait up! I haven’t finished with you! He’s gone... Looks like I’ll have to ask Lisa a few questions.

text.cn: 你带着密钥回来了。
text.src: You’ve returned with the key.

text.cn: 好的，这是第二张光盘。
text.src: Yes, here’s the second disc.

text.cn: 给我，然后等答复。
text.src: Give it to me and wait for the answer.

text.cn: 好吧。
text.src: All right.

text.cn: 你说对了光盘的事：|那是你父亲的日记。|我需要一些时间分析全部数据，|但现在可以给你大致的答案。
text.src: You were right about the disc: it’s your father’s diary. I need some time to analyze the whole data, but I can give you the general answers now.

text.cn: 告诉我去哪找他？
text.src: Tell me where to find him?

text.cn: 你说对了光盘的事：|那是伊万·戈的日记，|描述了他的旅行和发现。|分析全部内容需要时间，|但我可以马上回答一般性问题。
text.src: You were right about the disc: it’s Ivan Go’s diary, where he describes his journeys and discoveries. It will take a while to analyze it all, but I can answer general questions right away.

text.cn: 伊万去过死亡沙漠吗？|光盘上应该有怎么穿过沙漠的线索！
text.src: Has Ivan been in the death desert? The disc should have some hints how to cross the sands!

text.cn: 最后一条写着：'我从没离|目标这么近过。远征所需的一|切都准备好了。沙漠那边一定有人，|但我不在乎。不过他们也许|能给我指路。如果我的计划成功，|世界会变得更好。|如果失败——反正我也没|什么可失去的了。'
text.src: The final entry says: ‘I’ve never been so close to my objective before. I’ve got everything I need for the trip. There must be people on the other side of the desert, but I couldn’t care less. They might show me the way, though. If my plan works out, the world will change for the better. If not – I’ve got nothing to lose anyway’.

text.cn: 我就知道我们会在这里找到需|要的东西。继续读！
text.src: I was sure we would find what we need here. Read on!

text.cn: 光盘上有一份图纸，|我会给你拷贝一份。|拿给熟练的机械师，|他会帮你做出装置。|用那个装置，你就能穿过沙漠了。
text.src: The disc had a scheme I’ll make you a copy of. Show it to a skilled mechanic and he’ll make a device for you. Using it, you will be able to cross the desert.

text.cn: 现在我只需要找个机械师。|希望米德加德有。
text.src: I just need to find a mechanic now. I hope there are some in Midgard.

text.cn: 毫无疑问你想知道日记里还有什么。|但光盘上的数据在无知者|手中会变成危险的武器。|时机到了，我会与全人类分|享这些信息！
text.src: No doubts, you want to know what else the diary contains. But the data from the disc can become a dangerous weapon in the hands of the ignorant. When time comes, I’ll share the information with the humanity!

text.cn: 你骗了我！还好我从你这里|得到了一些信息。
text.src: You lied to me! I'm glad I got some information from you at all.

text.cn: 好久没人来拜访我了……|什么风把你吹来了？
text.src: It’s been a while since somebody came to visit me… What brought you here?

text.cn: 你塞斯的朋友让我给你这个包裹。
text.src: Your friend from Seth asked me to give you this package.

text.cn: 你让我今天真开心，年轻人！|那才叫日子……现在的人只|知道打打杀杀，毁我的田地。
text.src: You’ve made my day, young man! These were the times… And now they only fight, shoot each other and damage my fields.

text.cn: 是的，确实很艰难。|你的田地怎么了？
text.src: Yes, it’s hard times, indeed. Whatever happened to your fields?

text.cn: 有人踩坏了我的庄稼。|他们开车碾过或者烧了——|还留下了奇怪的标记。
text.src: Somebody trampled my crops. They drove across it or burnt it – and left strange signs behind.

text.cn: 我想我之前见过类似的东西。|带我去看看你的田地。
text.src: I think I saw something of the kind before. Show me your field.

text.cn: 就在这附近——从这里出去右转。|跟你聊很高兴。谢谢你的包裹！
text.src: It’s a stone’s throw from here – turn right as you go from here. It was nice talking to you. And thanks for the package!

text.cn: 不客气。我去看看你田里的标记。
text.src: You’re welcome. I’ll go have a look at the signs on your field.

text.cn: 你在这被遗忘的土地上找什么？
text.src: What are you looking for in these forgotten lands?

text.cn: 我在找神谕。
text.src: I’m looking for the Oracle.

text.cn: 你来错地方了。神谕在西北方向。
text.src: You’ve come to the wrong place. The Oracle is in the north-west from here.

text.cn: 谢谢，老人家。
text.src: Thanks, old man.

text.cn: 停火！我们不比敌人好到哪去。|对不起，陌生人；我们认错人了。
text.src: Cease fire! We’re no better than our enemies. I’m sorry, stranger; we mistook you for somebody else.

text.cn: 我没事。这是什么地方？|你们为什么攻击过路人？
text.src: I’m OK. What sort of place is this? And why are you attacking passers-by?

text.cn: 世界充满危险：钢铁怪物正在苏醒，|沿途杀人。它们看起|来很像你的卡车。
text.src: The world is full of danger: steel monsters are waking up and killing everyone on their way. They look a lot like your truck.

text.cn: 谢谢警告。我会小心的。
text.src: Thanks for the warning. I’ll be careful.

text.cn: 什么风把你吹来了？
text.src: What brought you here?

text.cn: 我在找神谕。
text.src: I’m looking for the Oracle.

text.cn: 只有大德鲁伊能帮到你。|去塞斯吧，但小心——|路上全是钢铁怪物。
text.src: Only the High Druid can help you in your quest. Go to Seth, but be careful – the road is full of steel monsters.

text.cn: 谢谢。
text.src: Thanks.

text.cn: 欢迎来到我们的圣林，陌生人。
