text.src: I greet you in our sacred grove, stranger.

text.cn: 你好，大德鲁伊。|他们告诉我你知道怎么去神谕那里。|我真的需要跟他谈谈。
text.src: Good day to you, High Druid. They told me you know how to get to the Oracle. I really need to talk to him.

text.cn: 你确定能承受神谕给你的信息？|向我证明你能承受，|我就告诉你去神谕的路。
text.src: Are you sure you can handle the information the Oracle gives you? Prove me that you can handle it and I’ll show you the way to the Oracle.

text.cn: 试试看。
text.src: Try me.

text.cn: 我们的圣殿被亵渎了。|净化它，好让我们能以大地|母亲之名进行仪式。
text.src: Our sanctuary has been desecrated. Cleanse it, so that we can carry out our rites in the name of mother-earth.

text.cn: 那里发生了什么？
text.src: What happened there?

text.cn: 敌视一切生命的钢铁怪物|正在摧毁圣树周围的森林。|他们很快就会到圣树了！阻止他们！
text.src: Steel monsters that are hostile to anything living are destroying forests around the holy tree. They’ll soon get to the holy tree! Stop them!

text.cn: 我身经百战都赢了。|没理由这次会输。
text.src: I’ve come out of many combats with victory. I don’t see why this one should be different.

text.cn: 我们的圣殿没有怪物了吗？
text.src: Is our sanctuary free from the monsters?

text.cn: 还没有，但快了。
text.src: Not yet, but I’m getting there.

text.cn: 我就知道外人不可信。
text.src: I knew that foreigners are not to be trusted.

text.cn: 但我已经按你说的做了！
text.src: But I’ve done what you asked!

text.cn: 我不知道你做了什么，|但只会激怒敌人。|怪物跟着你，正在逼近我们的城镇！
text.src: I don’t know what you’ve done, but it only enraged the enemy. The monsters followed you and are approaching our town now!

text.cn: 那些铁疙瘩比我想象的聪明。|但我会信守承诺——敌人会被打败。
text.src: The scraps of iron turned out to be cleverer than I thought. But I’ll keep my word – the enemy will be defeated.

text.cn: 光杀敌人不够。我们得确保|新的敌人不会取代它。
text.src: It’s not enough to kill the enemy. We’ve got to make sure that a new one will not take its place.

text.cn: 明白了。你知道怪物巢穴在哪吗？
text.src: I see. Do you know where the monsters’ lair is?

text.cn: 我们的侦察兵报告说，|怪物从东北方向最新地震后|出现的一个地洞里出来的。
text.src: Our scouts reported that the monsters are coming from a hole in the ground that appeared in the north-east after the latest earthquake.

text.cn: 看来阻止他们的唯一办法是|堵住洞穴。
text.src: Looks like the only way to stop them is to block the cave.

text.cn: 我们想过。我们会呼唤大地|母亲吞噬那些可恶的生物。|要做到这一点，我们需要非常|靠近那个洞。这里没人自愿去。
text.src: We thought about it. We’d call to the mother earth to devour the hateful creatures. To be able to do that, we need to come really close to the hole. We’ve got no volunteers here.

text.cn: 现在你有了。你到底要我做什么？
text.src: Consider you’ve got one now. What exactly do you want me to do?

text.cn: 把祈祷石放在洞旁边然后迅速离开。|逗留的话可能会受伤。
text.src: Place the praying stone by the hole and quickly leave that place. You may get hurt if you linger.

text.cn: 我会凯旋的。你最好准备好|告诉我关于神谕的事。
text.src: I’ll come back with victory. And you’d better be ready to tell me about the Oracle.

text.cn: 怪物离开了我们的土地。谢谢你！！
text.src: The monsters left our land. Thank you!!

text.cn: 我已经足以证明对德鲁伊的忠|诚了吧？
text.src: I’ve done enough to prove my loyalty to druids, haven’t I?

text.cn: 神谕住在北方。通往神谕的秘|密通道就在这里开始。
text.src: The Oracle lives in the North. The secret path to the Oracle starts right here.

text.cn: 我现在一定能找到他了。再见。
text.src: I’ll sure find him now. Good bye.

text.cn: 警报！敌人从后面偷袭。开火！
text.src: Alert! The enemy is attacking from the rear. Fire!

text.cn: 等等！我是和平来的。
text.src: Hold it! I’ve come with peace.

text.cn: 如果你想用枪说话，那就来吧。
text.src: If you want to speak the language of guns, let it be.

text.cn: 你骑着钢铁骏马。致敬，朋友！
text.src: You are riding a steed of steel. Greetings, friend!

text.cn: 我需要见神谕。
text.src: I need to meet the Oracle.

text.cn: 神谕的位置对我们保密。|只有德鲁伊知道，|他们还以此来谋私利。
text.src: The Oracle’s location is hidden from us. Only the druids know it and they use it to their own benefit.

text.cn: 那我得去跟德鲁伊谈谈了。
text.src: I guess I’ll have to talk to the druids then.

text.cn: 等等。不给一大笔钱他们不会开口。|而且跟我们不同，|他们对陌生人有敌意。|帮我们抓住他们的大德鲁伊，|你就能得到所有需要的信息。|把他引出城，剩下的我们来办。|明白了吗？
text.src: Wait. They won’t talk unless you offer them a lot of money. And besides. Unlike us, they are aggressive towards strangers. Help us capture their High Druid and you’ll get all the information you need. Lure him out of town and we’ll do the rest. Got it?

text.cn: 我看看能做什么。|但出事了我们互不认识。
text.src: I’ll see what I can do. But if anything goes wrong – we don’t know each other.

text.cn: 不可能！我不是叛徒。
text.src: It’s out of the question! I’m not a traitor.

text.cn: 你真的帮了大忙。|大德鲁伊是我们最后的障碍。|现在机器将进入我们的生活，|让它变得更好！
text.src: You’ve really helped us. The high druid was the final obstacle on our way. Now the machines will enter our life and make it better!

text.cn: 我真的需要见神谕。
text.src: I really need to see the Oracle.

text.cn: 德鲁伊告诉我们怎么去了。|谢谢帮忙，这是你的报酬。
text.src: The druid told us how to get there. Thanks for the help and here’s your reward.

text.cn: 我得到了想要的，|但不确定做得对不对。
text.src: I got what I wanted, but I’m not sure I did the right thing.

text.cn: 怎么了，陌生人？你看起来很焦虑。
text.src: What happened, stranger? You look worried.

text.cn: 乌鲁克的人密谋要杀你。|他们派我来把你引出城镇。
text.src: People from Uluk are plotting to kill you. They sent me to lure you out of the town.

text.cn: 你做对了，告诉了我他们的计划。|进来吧，做我的客人。
text.src: You’ve done the right thing by telling me about their plans. Come in and be my guest.

text.cn: 我不想参与背叛。|而且你有我需要的信息。
text.src: I’d hate to be involved in a betrayal. Besides, you’ve got the information I need.

text.cn: 我有吗？你想知道什么？
text.src: Have I? What is it that you want to know?

text.cn: 我来这里是为了神谕。|他是唯一能回答我问题的人。
text.src: The reason I’ve come here is the Oracle. He’s the only one who can answer my question.

text.cn: 我们被野兽袭击了。|我的朋友受伤了动不了。|我把他留在附近了。帮帮我们！
text.src: We were attacked by wild animals. My friend is wounded and he can’t move. I left him nearby. Help us!

text.cn: 我来帮你，陌生人！
text.src: I’ll help you, stranger!

text.cn: 跟我来。
text.src: Follow me.

text.cn: 我们已经好几周没有乌鲁|克的消息了。帮我们查查那里|怎么了！
text.src: We haven’t heard from Uluk people for a couple of weeks now. Help us find out what happened there!

text.cn: 你们为什么不去？
text.src: Why don’t you go there?

text.cn: 怪物还没全消灭，出去太危险了。|你是唯一够快的人。
text.src: Not all monsters are defeated yet, it’s way too dangerous to go out. You are the only one who can move fast enough.

text.cn: 我有更重要的事要做。
text.src: I’ve got more important things to do.

text.cn: 好的，我会处理的。
text.src: All right, I’ll sort it out.

text.cn: 骑着钢铁骏马的客人就是我们的朋|友。
text.src: A guest on a steel steed is our friend.

text.cn: 你们怎么了？为什么忘了邻居？
text.src: What happened to you, people? Why did you forget your neighbors?

text.cn: 我们不需要傲慢的德鲁伊的帮助。|叫他们离我们远点。|我们找到了更强大的神。|他们比石头还坚硬，|他们的愤怒比闪电还猛烈。
text.src: We don’t need help from arrogant druids. Tell them to stay away from us. We found more powerful gods. They are stronger than stone and their rage is greater than lightning.

text.cn: 我会替你传话。还有什么我能|做的吗？
text.src: I’ll pass your message to them. Is there anything else I can do?

text.cn: 我来告诉你你能做什么，陌生人。|我们的村庄在衰亡，人们在受苦。|不过不是所有人都疯了。|很多人反对这些变化，|但害怕怪物的暴怒。|最强壮的人已经离开了，|但他们独自到不了塞斯。
text.src: I’ll tell you what you can do, stranger. Our village is dying and the people are suffering. Not everyone has gone mad, though. Lots of people are against the changes, but they are afraid of the monsters’ rage. The strongest ones have left, but they won’t reach Seth alone.

text.cn: 你们会怎样？
text.src: What’s going to happen to you?

text.cn: 我留下来。我得查清楚是|什么导致了这种机器狂热，|再劝劝长老。
text.src: I’m staying here. I’ve got to find out what causes this machine-craze and talk some sense into the elder.

text.cn: 关我什么事？自己的问题自己解决。
text.src: Why should I care? Solve your own problems.

text.cn: 我会帮他们。也祝你好运。再见。
text.src: I’ll help them. May luck be with you too. Good bye.

text.cn: 乌鲁克发生了什么？
text.src: What happened in Uluk?

text.cn: 长老开始信奉新神，|现在崇拜金属怪物了。
text.src: The elder came to believe the new gods and he worships metal monsters now.

text.cn: 坏消息。不过你挣到了报酬。|一路平安。
text.src: Bad news. You’ve earned your reward, though. Go with peace.

text.cn: 再见。
text.src: Good bye.

text.cn: 长老开始信奉新神，|现在崇拜金属怪物了。|那些人会跟你解释的。
text.src: The elder came to believe the new gods and he worships metal monsters now. Those people will explain it to you.

text.cn: 你改变了我们对外乡人的看法。|这是你的报酬。如果路过，|随时来坐。你可以永远信|赖我们的帮助。
text.src: You’ve changed our opinion of the foreigners. Here’s your reward. If you happen to be near, drop by. You can always rely on our help.

text.cn: 谢谢。很高兴有人与自然和谐相处。
text.src: Thank you. I’m glad there are people who live in harmony with nature.

text.cn: 你回来了！神谕告诉你什么了？|你知道怎么穿过沙漠了吗？
text.src: You are back already! What did the Oracle tell you? Do you know how to cross the desert?

text.cn: 拜访神谕后我得到了更多问|题而非答案。至少我知道方向对了。|告诉我哪里能找到其他光盘，|就像我给神谕的那张？|有谁能聊聊伊万·戈的事？
text.src: I got more questions, rather than answers after my visit to the Oracle. At least I know we are on the right way. Tell me where I can find other discs, like the one I’ve given to the Oracle? Is there anybody I can talk to about Ivan Go?

text.cn: 所有人中，只有本·斯罗特|尔可能知道他的事。|他住在米德加德附近。|他是老探险家，伊万的朋友。|他应该能帮你。
text.src: Of all people, only Ben Throttle may know something about him. He lives near Midgard. He’s an old explorer and a friend of Ivan. He should be able to help you.

text.cn: 那我必须见他。给我指路。
text.src: I’ve got to meet him then. Show me the way.

text.cn: 别走，陌生人。我给像你这样的人|一个特别优惠！
text.src: Don’t pass by, stranger. I’ve got a special offer for people like you!

text.cn: 你让我感兴趣了。是什么？
text.src: You got me interested. What is it?

text.cn: 仅限今天！你可以得到这个|区域的地图！而且几乎免费！
text.src: Only today! You can get the map of this area! And it’s almost free!

text.cn: 那个'几乎免费'是多少？
text.src: How much is that ‘almost free’?

text.cn: 只要50金币。少一个子都不行。
text.src: It’s only 50 coins. And not a coin less.

text.cn: 谢谢，但不用了。不需要你的地图。
text.src: Thanks, but no, thanks. I can do without your map.

text.cn: 30金币成交，大家交个朋友。
text.src: I’ll take it for 30 coins and we’ll part friends.

text.cn: 我说了：一口价。|50金币，少一个子都不行。
text.src: I told you: the price is final.  50 coins and not a coin less.

text.cn: 随你。去找其他傻子买你那破|地图吧。
text.src: Whatever. Find other fools to buy your stupid map.

text.cn: 好了好了。给你50金币。
text.src: All right, all right. Here are your 50 coins.

text.cn: 我要这张地图。成交。
text.src: I’m gonna need the map. It’s a deal.

text.cn: 听说你要去神谕那里。
text.src: I heard that you are going to the Oracle.

text.cn: 你听说得对。我真的需要它的建议。
text.src: You heard right. I really need its advice.

text.cn: 能帮我个忙吗？
text.src: Could you do me a favor?

text.cn: 抱歉，我自己的事都够多了。
text.src: I’m sorry, but I’ve enough problems on my mind.

text.cn: 好的，能帮你什么？
text.src: Sure, what can I do for you?

text.cn: 我的一个好朋友去找神|谕后再也没回来。|据说他在那里安了家，离神谕不远。|如果你见到他，顺便帮我把这个|包裹交给他。
text.src: A good friend of mine has gone off in search of the Oracle and never came back. They say he’s made a new home there, not far from the Oracle. If you see him, drop by and give him a package from me.

text.cn: 他具体住在哪里？
text.src: Where exactly does he live?

text.cn: 就在这里，老路旁边。
text.src: Right here, by the old road.

text.cn: 我会替你传达消息并转交包裹。
text.src: I’ll pass him your message and your package.

text.cn: 看来你是好人，陌生人。|拿着这本关于我们这片土地|历史的书。
text.src: I see you are a good man, stranger. Take that book about the history of our land.

text.cn: 我对历史不感兴趣。
text.src: I’m not interested in history.

text.cn: 我不喜欢杀人……
text.src: I hate killing people…

text.cn: 很荣幸跟您交谈，谢谢您的书。|我会珍藏它。
text.src: It was an honor to talk to you and thanks for the book. I’ll treasure it.

text.cn: 这才像话。你可以走了。
text.src: That’s better. You can go now.

text.cn: 谢谢。再见！
text.src: Thanks. Good bye!

text.cn: 你逮到我了，恶魔！|先是毁我田地，现在又要来抓我！|我不会轻易屈服的！
text.src: You got me, demons! First my fields and now you want to take me! I’m not giving in easily!

text.cn: 也祝你晚上好。
text.src: Good evening to you, too.

text.cn: 你是他们的一员——|我在燃烧的田地上见过你。
text.src: You’re one of them – I saw you on the burning field.

text.cn: 又一个无害的疯子……
text.src: Another harmless madman…

text.cn: 别担心，好人。科学的力量|会赶走你田里的恶魔。|我见过这种事发生。
text.src: Don’t worry, good man. The power of science will drive demons from your fields. I saw it happen before.

text.cn: 你好，迷途的灵魂。|我看到你心中的空虚需要信|仰来填补。帮助我们的教会，|你会得到祝福。
text.src: I greet you, lost soul. I see the void in your heart that has to be filled with faith. Help our church and you’ll be blessed.

text.cn: 不确定需不需要。|但你具体要我做什么？
text.src: I’m not sure I need it. But what exactly do you want me to do?

text.cn: 我们会众的精神平衡被两个|异教徒扰乱了。他们用异端|邪说迷惑我们的人心。|杀了异教徒，把他们的头带给我。|这将恢复我们人民的精神和谐。|你会得到祝福和丰厚报酬。
text.src: Spiritual balance of our congregation has been disturbed by two pagans. They are confusing the minds of our people with heresy. Kill the heretics and bring their heads to me. It’ll restore spiritual harmony of our people. And you will receive a blessing and a generous reward.

text.cn: 我不需要你的祝福。
text.src: I can do without your blessing.

text.cn: 我愿意帮助教会。
text.src: I agree to help the church.

text.cn: 你做了吗？
text.src: Have you done it?

text.cn: 我还没找到那些异教徒。
text.src: I haven’t found the heretics yet.

text.cn: 是的，这是两个异教徒的头。|他们不会再在你的人中散布分歧了。
text.src: Yes, here are the heads of the two heretics. They’ll no longer sow discord among your people.

text.cn: 这是你的报酬。我祝福你以教|会的名义行动！愿好运与你同在。
text.src: Here’s your reward. I bless you to act in the name of our church! May fortune be on your side.

text.cn: 谢谢。
text.src: Thank you.

text.cn: 嘿，伙计，能帮忙送点东|西到附近的村庄吗？|当然有报酬。我可以自己去，|但我正忙着在战场上收集战利品。
text.src: Hey, man, could you deliver some stuff to a nearby village? For money, of course. I could go there myself, but I’m too busy now collecting trophies on the battlefields.

text.cn: 我太忙了，没空帮你运东西！
text.src: I’m too busy to drive around with your stuff!

text.cn: 听起来是个轻松活。装货吧。
text.src: Sounds like a cushy job. Load your stuff.

text.cn: 你把发动机带来了。|谢谢！这是你的钱。
text.src: You’ve brought me that engine. Thanks! And here’s your money.

text.cn: 钱是不错，但我不明白为什么|要运着这台坏发动机到处跑？
text.src: Money is good, but what I don’t get is why am I carrying this broken engine around?

text.cn: 这是生意，伙计。|我不能告诉你我的秘密。
text.src: It’s business, pal. I cannot tell you my secrets.

text.cn: 有猫腻……
text.src: Smells fishy…

text.cn: 又是你。什么事？
text.src: It’s you again. What’s up?

text.cn: 我还是不明白，把这台坏发|动机来回运有什么意义？|告诉我你的秘密。
text.src: I still don’t understand, what’s the point of taking this broken engine back and forth? Tell me your secret.

text.cn: 满足你的好奇心要花2000。
text.src: It’ll cost you 2000 to satisfy your curiosity.

text.cn: 太贵了。还没急到要听那个。
text.src: That’s way too much. I’m not that desperate to hear it.

text.cn: 2000的秘密一定很劲爆！快说！
text.src: That must be a hell of a secret for 2 grand! Spit it out!

text.cn: 我收集战场上留下的零件，|寄给我那修车的朋友。|他把修车时的好零件换成我寄|去的旧零件，把好零件还给我，|我高价卖出去。我们就是这么|谋生的。|既然你知道了，我得杀了你。哈哈！|逗你的！安心走吧，|别想用我们的招。
text.src: I collect car parts that are left on the battlefield and send them to my friend repairman. He replaces the good parts in the cars that he fixes with the ones that I send him and returns me the good ones, which I sale at a very high price. That’s how we make our living.|Now that you know it, I’ll have to kill you. Ha-ha-ha! Got ya! Go with peace and don’t even think of using our scheme.

text.cn: 够聪明。
text.src: Clever enough.

text.cn: 这就是我等了好久的发动机。|这是你的报酬，陌生人。
text.src: That’s the engine I’ve been waiting for so long. Here’s your reward, stranger.

text.cn: 轻松赚钱。
text.src: Easy money.

text.cn: 你能把这台发动机带回马雷齐亚吗？|当然有报酬。
text.src: Could you take this engine back to Marezzia? You’ll get paid, of course.

text.cn: 你当我是傻子吗？我不去。
text.src: Do you take me for a fool? I’m not going there.

text.cn: 干什么不重要，只要有钱拿就行。
text.src: It doesn’t matter what I do, as long as I get paid for doing it.

text.cn: 你想干什么？
text.src: What do you want?

text.cn: 他们告诉我在这里能找到工|作和答案。
text.src: They told me I can get a job and some answers to my questions here.

text.cn: 也许吧。你是谁？
text.src: You might as well. Who are you?

text.cn: 我是新来的：从东方来。|我听说过很多关于你们领袖|阿克塞尔的事。
text.src: I’m new here: I’ve come from the east. I’ve heard a lot about your leader, Axel.

text.cn: 哦，是的。他是个伟人！|没有他做不到的事。
text.src: Oh, yes. He’s a great man! There’s nothing that he can’t do.

text.cn: 我想亲眼见他。
text.src: I’d like to meet him in person.

text.cn: 那很难做到。因为暗杀威胁，|他不会出来见普通人。
text.src: It would be very hard to do. He doesn’t come out to meet ordinary people because of the murderous assaults.

text.cn: 难道完全没有办法见他？|我等了一辈子。
text.src: Isn’t there absolutely no way to meet him? I’ve been waiting for it all my life.

text.cn: 我说的是'困难'，|没说'不可能'。|阿克塞尔会亲自嘉奖战争英雄。|加入我们的军队，|证明你是个伟大的战士。|那样你就有机会和阿克塞尔握手。
text.src: I said it would be ‘hard’, but I didn’t say ‘impossible’. Axel awards war heroes in person. Join our army and prove yourself a great warrior. That way you’ll get a chance to shake hands with Axel.

text.cn: 你们在跟谁打？
text.src: Who are you fighting with?

text.cn: 我们的敌人是北方人。|在我们最需要帮助时他们背|弃了我们，所以我们不再怜悯他们。|阿克塞尔会带领我们走向繁荣，|只有那些可怜的邻居挡在路上。|不会太久了，不会太久了……
text.src: Our enemies are the northerners. They turned their backs on us when we really needed their help, so we have no pity for them anymore. Axel will lead us to the era of prosperity, and only the miserable neighbors are standing in our way. Not for long now, not for long…

text.cn: 我明白了。
text.src: I see.

text.cn: 所以，你跟我们还是反对我们？
text.src: So, are you with us or against us?

text.cn: 当然跟你们一起。|我会争取做些能见到阿克塞尔的事。
text.src: I’m with you, of course. I’ll try to do something that wins me a chance of meeting Axel.

text.cn: 从小事做起。我们必须遏制敌人。|去边境，攻击一切移动的目标。|保持警惕。
text.src: Start with small things. We’ve got to keep the enemy at bay. Go to the border and attack everything that’s moving. Stay tuned.

text.cn: 是！
text.src: Yes!

text.cn: 也许还有别的办法见到阿克塞尔……
text.src: Perhaps, there is another way to meet Axel…

text.cn: 随你便。但那样的话，|尽快离开我们的土地。|我们不喜欢浪费时间说废话的人。
text.src: Suit yourself. But in that case, leave our land as soon as you can. We don’t like people who waste out time with pointless talk.

text.cn: 说得对。
text.src: Fair enough.

text.cn: 你准备好为猩红之晨献出生命吗？
text.src: Are you ready to give up your life for the Crimson Dawn?

text.cn: 行动成功了。你吸引敌人注意力时，|我们拿下了重要的战略目标。|拿你那份战利品吧。
text.src: The operation has been successful. We got hold of an important strategic object, while you were distracting the enemy. Take your part of the trophies.

text.cn: 很容易。
text.src: That was easy.

text.cn: 下一个任务更复杂。|去敌方领地炸掉他们的补给商队。|战利品照旧归你。
text.src: The next task is going to be more complicated. Go to the enemy’s lands and blow up their caravan with provision. The trophies are yours, as usual.

text.cn: 正合我意。
text.src: That’s my kind of job.

text.cn: 你给北方人的经济造成了重大打击。|剩下的就容易了。
text.src: You’ve done great harm to the northerners’ economics. The rest will be easy.

text.cn: 我什么时候能见到阿克塞尔？
text.src: When am I going to see Axel?

text.cn: 别急。继续为我们的人民效力，|他会嘉奖你的。我们的朋友——|僧侣们想认识你。他们用祈祷和……|美酒来鼓舞战士的士气。|去修道院带几瓶那种提精|神的酒回来。
text.src: Not so fast. Keep on serving our people and he will award you. Our friends – monks want to get to know you. They boost the morale of our warriors with their prayers and… great wine. Go to the monastery and bring some bottles of that spirit-rising drink.

text.cn: 战时做这种蠢事！
text.src: What a silly thing to do in the time of war!

text.cn: 信仰的力量被低估了。
text.src: The power of faith is underrated these days.

text.cn: 我来做。
text.src: I’ll do it.

text.cn: 你去了好久。酒带了吗？
text.src: It took you a long time. Have you brought the wine?

text.cn: 是的，酒桶在车上。
text.src: Yes, the barrels are in the truck.

text.cn: 好。你什么都不用说。|我自己都怕那些僧侣。|不管怎样，说正事吧。|我们知道内部有叛徒。
text.src: Good. You don’t need to tell me anything. I’m afraid of the monks myself. Anyway, let’s get down to business. We know that there are traitors among us.

text.cn: 他们是谁？
text.src: Who are they?

text.cn: 是对政权不满的叛军。|他们从内部腐蚀我们的经济。|就像蛀虫啃树皮慢慢杀死树。|我们知道他们基地的位置。|叛军没想到会遭到攻击，|应该很容易对付。|你必须把他们全杀了。
text.src: It’s the rebels who are unhappy about the regime. They corrupt our economics from inside. They are like worms that slowly kill the tree by gnawing on its bark. We know the location of their base. The rebels are not expecting an attack, so they should be an easy target. You’ve got to kill them all.

text.cn: 杀手无寸铁的人……如果我拒绝呢？
text.src: Killing the unarmed… What if I refuse?

text.cn: 那样的话，我们宣布你为叛徒。
text.src: In that case, we’ll declare you a traitor.

text.cn: 我会执行你的命令。
text.src: I’ll carry out your order.

text.cn: 谈判结果如何？
text.src: What are the results of the negotiations?

text.cn: 防御领袖同意在这里见我。
text.src: The Defense Leaders agreed to meet me here.

text.cn: 听起来太容易了。|敌人诡计多端，很可能是陷阱。|不管怎样我们应该去那里战斗。
text.src: It sounds too easy. The enemy is treacherous, so it may easily be a trap. We should go there and fight, anyway.

text.cn: 我想参加这次行动。
text.src: I’d like to take part in the operation.

text.cn: 你好，我的孩子。|你为共同事业做了很多。|我们想更好地了解你。
text.src: Good day, my son. You’ve done a lot for the common cause. We’d like to know you better.

text.cn: 我不明白你在说什么。
text.src: I don’t understand what you are talking about.

text.cn: 有个旅行者路过，说他认识你……
text.src: A traveler dropped by and told us that he knows you…

text.cn: 谁？我不明白你在说什么。
text.src: Who’s that? I don’t understand what you are talking about.

text.cn: 他还说你发誓要消灭世|界上所有劫匪……
text.src: He also said that you swore to exterminate all bandits in the world…

text.cn: 那是谎言！我……|我对劫匪没意见……|我自己就是劫匪。
text.src: That’s a lie! I…I’ve nothing against bandits… I’m a bandit myself.

text.cn: 我相信你，我的孩子。|但指控很严重，我们得搞清|楚谁说真话谁说谎。|让上帝来审判你……|在竞技场的死斗中！无辜的人会赢。
text.src: I believe you, my son. But the charges are serious enough, and we’ve got to figure out who’s telling the truth and who’s lying. May God be your judge… in the death match on the arena! The innocent man will win.

text.cn: 那我要跟谁打？
text.src: So, who am I going to fight with?

text.cn: 老费利克斯。
text.src: Old Felix.

text.cn: 什么？费利克斯？？？
text.src: What? Felix???

text.cn: 你好，我的孩子。|你为共同事业做了很多。|我们想更好地了解你
text.src: Good day, my son. You’ve done a lot for the common cause. We’d like to know you better

text.cn: 我没什么好隐瞒的。问吧。
text.src: I’ve got nothing to hide. Ask your questions.

text.cn: 我们不需要问你问题。|看一眼就能决定你是否合格。|我们考验每一个加入十字军的人。|这就是我们战无不胜军队的秘密。
text.src: We don’t need to ask you questions. One look is enough to decide if you are worthy or not. We test everyone who joins our crusade. That’s the secret of our invincible army.

text.cn: 那我呢？
text.src: So what about me?

text.cn: 你是个难啃的硬骨头。|有一点是确定的：你带来了变化。|有人说应该立刻杀了你。|但我觉得你应该活着。
text.src: You are a hard nut to crack. One thing is certain: you are bringing changes. Some people say we should kill you at once. But I think you should live.

text.cn: 听起来不错，但你为什么这么想？
text.src: Good to hear that, but what makes you think so?

text.cn: 我们在这个地区的使命不是杀戮。|是更高的东西。你的使命也是如此。|安心走吧，别忘了酒。
text.src: Our mission is not slaughter in this region. It’s something higher than that. So is your mission. Leave with peace and don’t forget the wine.

text.cn: 跟明白人说话真好，|不是那些狂热分子。
text.src: It’s good to talk to sensible people, not fanatics.

text.cn: 你证明了自己是对的。|你可以回去了，别忘了酒。
text.src: You’ve proved you were right. You can go back and don’t forget the wine.

text.cn: 好，我就是为这个来的。
text.src: Sure, that’s what I came here for.

text.cn: 神圣的声音引导你来到了我们的|居所。
text.src: The holy voice brought you to our abode.

text.cn: 我知道丽莎在这里。|把她交出来，否则我毁了这个地方！
text.src: I know Lisa is here. Give her to me, or I’ll destroy this place!

text.cn: 我们对你没有恶意。别嚷嚷。
text.src: We have nothing against you. Stop shouting.

text.cn: 阿克塞尔败了，你在这里|没有权威了。如果我不毁了这里，|别人也会。我数到三就动手。一……|二……
text.src: You’ve no authority here after Axel’s defeat. If I don’t destroy this place, somebody else will do it. I’m going to attack you on the count of three. One… Two…

text.cn: 睁开眼吧，孩子。|转过头去，你就看到她正在离|开修道院。
text.src: Open up your eyes, my boy. Turn around and you’ll see that she’s leaving the monastery.

text.cn: 该死！
text.src: Damn!

text.cn: 你是谁，陌生人，你想干什么？
text.src: Who are you, stranger, and what do you want?

text.cn: 我惩罚背叛阿克塞尔事业的人。
text.src: I punish traitors of Axel’s cause.

text.cn: 我们对你没有恶意。|我们为正义而战。|饶了我们吧！我们家里还有家人……
text.src: We mean you no harm. We are fighting for the right cause. Have mercy upon us! We’ve got families at home…

text.cn: 我不是杀人犯。趁我没改主意快跑。
text.src: I’m not a murderer. Run, before I changed my mind.

text.cn: 谢谢你！我们要去利布里姆，|但我得把一些情报传递给独|立城镇联邦的领袖。
text.src: Thank you! We are going to Librium, but I’ve got to pass some information to the leaders of the Independent Towns.

text.cn: 我不再属于猩红之晨了。|我也是逃亡者。上车，我搭你一程。
text.src: I don’t belong to the Crimson Dawn anymore. I’m a fugitive too. Get in, I’ll give you a lift.

text.cn: 以猩红之晨的名义去死吧！
text.src: Die, in the name of the Crimson Dawn!

text.cn: 我是叛军领袖。你是来找我的？
text.src: I’m the leader of the rebels. Have you come after me?

text.cn: 我得带你去赫尔维蒂亚。|你最好知道一些重要的事情。
text.src: I’ve got to take you to Helvetia. You’d better know something that’s really important.

text.cn: 长夜漫漫……
text.src: The night is long…

text.cn: 但黎明近了。我得到了关于即|将对独立城镇联邦发起行动的情报。
text.src: But the dawn is near. I’ve got intelligence of the imminent operation against the Independent Towns.

text.cn: 作为交换情报的回报，我们会帮你。
text.src: We’ll help you in return for the intelligence.

text.cn: 我的情报太重要了，|不能告诉普通特工——|我只对高层说。我不能冒险。|我知道的东西能让我们在战|争中占据重大优势。
text.src: My information is too important to tell it to an agent - I’ll speak to the higher ranks only. I can’t risk. I know something that will give us a major advantage in the war.

text.cn: 说得对。我们的领导会在这里见你。
text.src: Fair enough. Our leaders will meet you here.

text.cn: 我马上到。
text.src: I’ll be right there.

text.cn: 我不认识你。
text.src: I don’t think I know you.

text.cn: 长夜漫漫……
text.src: The night is long…

text.cn: 但黎明近了。你好，同志。
text.src: But the dawn is near. Hello, comrade.

text.cn: 我来讨论我们的计划。
text.src: I’ve come to discuss our plans.

text.cn: 谢天谢地你来了。|我们的领导5分钟后就到，|会回答你的问题。祝好运！
text.src: Thank God, you’ve arrived. Our leader will be here in 5 minutes and he will answer your questions. Good luck!

text.cn: 暴君会被推翻的。
text.src: The tyrant will be defeated.

text.cn: 我是阿克塞尔。听说你在找我？！
text.src: I’m Axel. I heard you were looking for me?!

text.cn: 很高兴终于见到你了！|不得不说真不容易。
text.src: I’m glad I met you at last! Can’t say it was easy.

text.cn: 我佩服你的决心，|但恐怕你活不过我们的会面。|我想考验你，看看你是否|像他们说的那样强壮敏捷。
text.src: I respect your determination, but I’m afraid you won’t survive our meeting. I’d like to test you and see if you are as strong and dexterous, as they say.

text.cn: 我准备好接受任何考验，|只要能达到我的目的。
text.src: I’m ready for any tests, as long as they serve my end.

text.cn: 很高兴终于能直视你的眼睛了，|阿克塞尔。说实话，|我来这里是要你的命。|像个男人一样战斗吧！
text.src: I’m glad I can finally look you in the eye, Axel. The truth is that I came here to take your life. Fight like a man!

text.cn: 我接受挑战，虽然我不想杀你。|去竞技场，兄弟们！
text.src: I accept the challenge, much as I hate to kill you. To the arena, my brothers!

text.cn: 去竞技场！
text.src: To the arena!

text.cn: 缺钱？我用得着你的本事。
text.src: Need cash? I could use your skills.

text.cn: 继续……
text.src: Go on…

text.cn: 我的房子几天前被盗了。|盗贼拿走了对我来说很珍|贵的东西——一件艺术品。|只有懂古董的人才会做这种事。|而在这附近，除了我自己只有|一个人对那东西感兴趣。
text.src: My house was looted a couple of days ago. The house-breakers took something really valuable to me – a work of art. Only an antiquities connoisseur could do such a thing. And there is only one man, besides myself who’s interested in that sort of thing around here.

text.cn: 听起来太费事了。我不想卷入。
text.src: Sounds like too much work. I don’t want to get involved in it.

text.cn: 给那混蛋一个教训。
text.src: Let’s teach the bastard a lesson.

text.cn: 哦，你把杰作带来了！|给我，拿你的钱。
text.src: Oh, you’ve brought the masterpiece! Give it to me and take your money.

text.cn: 这件艺术品我也许能|卖个更好的价钱。
text.src: I might get a better price for that piece of art.

text.cn: 拿走你的宝贝……
text.src: Take your precious…

text.cn: 能帮你什么？
text.src: What can I do for you?

text.cn: 别拐弯抹角了。是你从鉴赏|家那里偷了那件杰作吗？
text.src: Let’s not beat about the bush. Was it you who stole the masterpiece from Aesthete?

text.cn: 是的，但……我现在没有了。|有个人来找我，说可以帮我偷|一件著名的艺术品。|我们制定了闯入鉴赏家家的计划。|我付了定金就再也没见过他。|我真希望没做那件事，|但我太想要那件艺术品了。|也许你能找到骗了我们两个|人的家伙。他自称“骗子”。|我在附近的峡谷遇到的。|他可能还在那里。
text.src: Yes, but… I don’t have it now. This man came to me and offered to steal a famous work of art for me. We worked out a plan of breaking into Aesthete’s house. I made the advance payment and never saw him again. I wish I hadn’t done that, but I wanted that work of art badly. Perhaps you will be able to find the guy who cheated both of us. He called himself Swindler. I met him in a canyon nearby. He might still be there.

text.cn: 我一定能找到他。|但如果你骗了我，|我会回来找你算账。
text.src: I’ll sure find him. But if you lied to me, I’ll come back for you.

text.cn: 你拿到那件杰作了吗？|给我！我会慷慨地付钱。
text.src: Have you got the masterpiece? Give it to me! I’ll pay generously.

text.cn: 暂时还是我自己留着。
text.src: I prefer to keep it for the time being.

text.cn: 在这里。
text.src: Here it is.

text.cn: 消息说有一支护卫不多的富|商队要往南走。稳赚的买卖。|赃物五五分。成交？
text.src: A source says that a rich caravan with few guards is going to the South. It’s a sure thing. We’ll share the loot 50/50. Deal?

text.cn: 没门！
text.src: No way!

text.cn: 成交。
text.src: Deal.

text.cn: 我带着战利品等你。
text.src: I’ll be waiting for you with booty.

text.cn: 我会回来的。
text.src: I’ll be back.

text.cn: 我们走运了！如果能找到买家，|我……呃，我们下半辈|子就靠这些钱了。|该死，这是大老板的标记——|没哪个正常人会买！|而且你可能不知道——|偷大老板东西的人活不长……
text.src: We are in luck! If we find the buyer, I… um, we’ll live on that money for the rest of our life. Damn it, it’s the Big Boss’s mark – no one in their right mind will buy it! And in case you didn’t know – people who steal from the Big Boss don’t live long…

text.cn: 你留着赃物吧。我不想卷入。|我不需要麻烦。
text.src: You can keep the booty. I don’t want to get involved in this. I don’t need troubles.

text.cn: 听起来有很多钱。|大老板是谁？我们得在他听|说抢劫的事之前找到他。
text.src: Sounds like a lot of money. Who’s the Big Boss? We should get to him before he hears about the robbery.

text.cn: 据说他住在山顶上一座坚不|可摧的堡垒里。我藏好赃物，|引开守卫。那就是你进去杀|大老板的机会。
text.src: They say he lives in an unassailable fortress at the top of a mountain. I’ll hide the loot and lure the guards out. It’ll be your chance to get in and kill the Boss.

text.cn: 我来做。
text.src: I’ll do it.

text.cn: 你想怎样，我的救命恩人？
text.src: What do you want, my rescuer?

text.cn: 丽莎来过这里吗？
text.src: Has Lisa been here?

text.cn: 是的，大人。她匆忙离开了，|据我所知她往赫尔维蒂亚去了。
text.src: Yes, my lord. She left in a hurry and she was heading to Helvetia, as far as I know.

text.cn: 她跑不掉的！
text.src: She won’t get away from me!

text.cn: 我现在很忙。
text.src: I’m really busy now.

text.cn: 紧急！你必须关掉电站。|人类的命运就靠你了！
text.src: It’s urgent! You’ve got to switch off the electric power station. The destiny of the mankind depends on you!

text.cn: 你疯了吗？这个电站给好|几个城镇供电。我不|会因为你一个疯狂的念|头就断了这些人的电。
text.src: Are you out of your mind? The station supplies several towns with energy. I’m not going to cut these people off electricity because of some crazy idea you got.

text.cn: 你知不知道电站也给敌人的基|地供电？
text.src: Do you realize that the station supplies the enemies’ base as well?

text.cn: 我不明白你的意思。|想想看，最近确实有一些能|量泄漏……但不管怎样，|我不会关掉电站。
text.src: I don’t understand you. Come to think of it, there have been some energy leaks lately… Anyway, I’m not going to turn off the station.

text.cn: 人类的未来就在你手中。|你只需要关掉电站几秒钟！
text.src: The future of the humanity is in your hands. All you need to do is turn off the station for a few seconds!

text.cn: 你觉得有那么简单？|紧急启动要好几个小时！|不过也到了该检修的时候了。|去找你的外星人吧！
text.src: Do you think it’s that simple? The emergency start will take hours! But then again, it’s time for maintenance inspection. Go look for your green men!

text.cn: 你为世界做了一件大好事！
text.src: You’ve done the world a great favor!

text.cn: 我要炸了这个洞！|猩红之晨的人会很乐意帮我。
text.src: I’ll blow up this hole! The guys from the Crimson Dawn will be more than happy to help me.

text.cn: 冷静，伙计。你是战争英雄，|可能有心理创伤。我来帮你。|看，电断了！
text.src: Easy, man. You are a war hero and you’ve probably got a psychological trauma. I’ll help you. See, the electricity is off!

text.cn: 算你走运我今天心情好。|你这种挡我拯救世界的人真|让我发疯。
text.src: It’s your luck that I’m in good mood today. People like you drive me nuts when they stand in the way of saving the world.

text.cn: 又怎么了？
text.src: What is it now?

text.cn: 最近有没有注意到什么异常？|有人行为古怪吗？
text.src: Have you noticed anything unusual lately? Any people acting strange?

text.cn: 附近有异常区域，|所以这里的人经常行为古怪。|有人说看到天空中有金属物体。
text.src: There’s an anomalous zone nearby, so people are often acting strange around here. Some of them say they saw metal objects in the sky.

text.cn: 我真的很需要去那里。谢谢告诉我。
text.src: I really need to get there. Thanks for telling me.

text.cn: 该死！又出故障了。|走开！我忙着修电站呢！
text.src: Damn! That malfunction again. Go away! I'm busy repairing that station!

text.cn: 好吧。
text.src: All right.

text.cn: 我没见过你。
text.src: I haven’t seen you before.

text.cn: 我是外地人。我翻过山脉才到这里。
text.src: I’m a stranger here. I had to cross the mountains to get this far.

text.cn: 你能穿过隧道说明你的战斗|技能不一般。你是来加入雇|佣兵的吗？
text.src: The fact that you got through the tunnel says a lot about your battle skills. Have you come here to join the mercenaries?

text.cn: 不完全是。我对你们的国家|不太了解，也不想卷入你们的冲突。
text.src: Not really. I don’t know much about your country and I don’t want to get involved in your conflicts.

text.cn: 奇迹！一个战争贩子来这里|竟然不是为了杀人挣钱。
text.src: It’s a miracle! A war dog comes here for a reason other than killing people for money.

text.cn: 活着也让别人活着，|这是他们教我的。
text.src: Live and let live, as they taught me.

text.cn: 迟早你得选边站。|在这里不是朋友就是敌人。|没有第三种选择。
text.src: Sooner or later, you’ll have to take sides. You can either be friend, or foe here. There’s no third option.

text.cn: 不过，在这场战争中选边站之前，|我想自己先搞清楚。
text.src: Still, I want to work it out for myself, before I take sides in this war.

text.cn: 加入我们，战士。|我们在对抗背叛的侵略者。|我们为正义而战。
text.src: Join us, warrior. We are fighting against the treacherous aggressors. We are fighting for the right cause.

text.cn: 在加入某一方之前，|我想自己下结论。让我先看看。
text.src: I want to make my own conclusions before I join somebody’s side. Let me take a look around.

text.cn: 你知道吗？去图斯吧。|那里的人会告诉你关于侵略|者你需要知道的一切。|他们也许还能帮你的搜索。
text.src: You know what? Go to Tous. People there will tell you everything you need to know about the aggressors. They might also help you in your search.

text.cn: 我考虑一下。
text.src: I’ll think about it.

text.cn: 你准备好加入我们的军队了吗？
text.src: Are you ready to join our army?

text.cn: 跟我说说这场战争。
text.src: Tell me about the war.

text.cn: 我们在为正义而战，|对抗野蛮的侵略者。
text.src: We are fighting for justice against the brute aggressors.

text.cn: 我好像在哪听过这套说法。|我去别处找答案吧。
text.src: I think I’ve heard it somewhere before. I’ll go look for answers someplace else.

text.cn: 等一下。拿这张传单。|也许当你更了解这个国家的历史后，|你的心会告诉你该怎么做。
text.src: Hold on. Take this leaflet. Perhaps, when you know the history of this country better, your heart will tell you what to do next.

text.cn: 等我有空翻翻看。|传单上写的东西很可怕！|但这跟我有什么关系？
text.src: I’ll leaf it through when I get a minute. The leaflet says horrible things! But what do I have to do with it?

text.cn: 我们需要每个能拿武器的人。|形势很严峻。任何帮助我们都感激。
text.src: We need every man who can wield a weapon. Things are looking really dark now. We’d be grateful for any help.

text.cn: 我来这里是因为阿克塞尔。|我需要见他，所以可以说我们有|共同的目标。
text.src: The reason I came here is Axel. I need to see him, so you can say we have a common motive.

text.cn: 加入我们的军队。|一起我们更有机会拿下阿克塞尔。|这可不容易：我们派了最|好的刺客去，都失败了。
text.src: Join our army. Together we have more chances of getting Axel. Which isn’t easy at all: we sent our best assassins to him, but they all failed.

text.cn: 为什么？什么阻止了他们？
text.src: But why? What stopped them?

text.cn: 除了他身边总有一大群保镖，|而且你得穿过敌方领地才能到他那？
text.src: Apart from the fact he is always surrounded by a bunch of bodyguards, and that you have to cross a hostile territory to reach him?

text.cn: 是的，除了那些。
text.src: Yes, apart from that.

text.cn: 没人确切知道他的藏身处。|据说他把地下基地变成了繁|华的城镇，但我们还没找到。|暂时没有，但迟早会找到。|你加入吗？
text.src: No one knows for sure where his hideout is. They say he turned an underground base into a blossoming town, but we haven’t found it yet. We haven’t, but we sure will. Are you with us?

text.cn: 我们一起推翻阿克塞尔的暴政！
text.src: We’ll do away with Axel’s tyranny together!

text.cn: 谢谢你，陌生人。|你的事迹不会被遗忘。
text.src: Thank you, stranger. Your deeds will not be forgotten.

text.cn: 什么时候开始？
text.src: When do I start?

text.cn: 立刻。去巡逻边境。|确保没有敌方侦察兵穿过。
text.src: Immediately. Go patrol the border. Make sure no enemy scout crosses it.

text.cn: 你可以信赖我。
text.src: You can rely on me.

text.cn: 我需要考虑一下。
text.src: I need to think about it.

text.cn: 你可以随时离开，不像我们……
text.src: You are free to leave anytime, unlike us…

text.cn: 别逼我。我有自己的判断。
text.src: Don’t push me. I’ve got my own head on my shoulders.

text.cn: 你愿意加入我们吗？
text.src: Are you willing to join us?

text.cn: 我的人欠你一条命。|你真是个无畏的战士。|在派你执行重要任务前我们必|须先考验你。
text.src: My people owe you their lives. You are a truly fearless fighter. We had to test you before sending you on a serious mission.

text.cn: 现在你在战场上见过我了。|我会不惜一切代价找到阿克塞尔。
text.src: Now you’ve seen me in battle. I’ll do what it takes to reach Axel.

text.cn: 继续保持好表现，|就会有人介绍你认识他。|同时我们的人需要保护。|护送运送粮食到附近村庄的商队。
text.src: Keep up the good job and you’ll be introduced to him. In the meantime our people need protection. Escort the caravan that delivers food to the neighborhood villages.

text.cn: 听起来够简单。
text.src: Sounds easy enough.

text.cn: 一刻也不能放松警惕。|敌人会试图切断我们的补给。|但你不会孤身一人。祝好运！
text.src: Don’t get off your guard for a minute. The enemy will try to leave us without provision. But you won’t be alone. Good luck!

text.cn: 一切都会好的。
text.src: Everything’s gonna be all right.

text.cn: 补给能让我们再撑一阵了。|多亏了你！重大变革的时刻到了。
text.src: The provision will keep us going some more time. Thanks to you! The time of major changes has come.

text.cn: 别误会：很高兴能帮上忙，|但别忘了最终目标。
text.src: Don’t get me wrong: it’s great to be of some help to you, but let’s not forget about the ultimate goal.

text.cn: 敌人从山脉另一边获得支援。|如果我们堵住隧道，|就切断了他们的增援。
text.src: Our enemies get support from the other side of the mountain range. But if we block the tunnel, we’ll cut them off reinforcement.

text.cn: 你们之前为什么不做？|隧道在你们的领地上吧？
text.src: Why haven’t you done it before? The tunnel is on your territory, isn’t it?

text.cn: 我们有更重要的事：|战争不只是正面交锋。|现在是切断敌人动脉的时候了。|记住，那里由精英战士把守。
text.src: We had more important things to do: the war is not all about open confrontation. Now it’s time to block that artery of the enemy. Remember, it’s guarded by elite warriors.

text.cn: 你管那叫精英？我已经干掉一个了，|一点也不难。
text.src: Do you call those elite? I’ve already defeated one of them and it wasn’t hard at all.

text.cn: 他们就是这么拉新人的。|他们跟你说你多厉害然后邀|请你加入，对吧？
text.src: That’s how they get new people join their ranks. They’ve told you what a cool guy you are and offered you to become on of them, haven’t they?

text.cn: 是的……他们原话……|他们不像表面上那么简单。
text.src: Yes… Their exact words… They aren’t as simple as they let on.

text.cn: 恐怕我们没人能抽调来执|行这次行动。你只能独自去了。
text.src: I’m afraid, we have no one to spare for this operation. You’ll be on your own.

text.cn: 不是我第一次单独行动了。|等我凯旋。
text.src: It isn’t the first time I work alone. Expect me with victory.

text.cn: 你的行动证明了你的实力。|是时候给你一个真正的挑战了。
text.src: Your actions speak volumes about you. It’s time to give you a truly challenging task.

text.cn: 在托斯卡纳酒吧找他们的联络人。|暗号是：'长夜漫漫'，回答是：|'但黎明将至'。
text.src: Meet their contact at Toscana Bar. The password is: ‘The night is long’, and the reply is: ‘But the dawn is near’.

text.cn: 明白了。等我凯旋。
text.src: I got it. Expect me with victory.

text.cn: 你救的那个叛军告诉了我重要消息。|阿克塞尔的一名将军将带着少|数卫兵经过这里。|如果能活捉他，我们会得到大|量关于敌人的情报。
text.src: The rebel you’ve saved told me something important. One of Axel’s generals will be passing this place with only a few guards. If we get him alive, we’ll have a lot of valuable information about the enemy.

text.cn: 他会被抓到的。但这次行|动我们需要额外兵力。
text.src: He will be caught. But we’ll need additional forces for the operation.

text.cn: 我们考虑过了。拦截卡车和战|车会埋伏等候。
text.src: We thought about it. Barrage trucks and war transport will be waiting in ambush.

text.cn: 太好了。我不会让你失望的。
text.src: Good to hear that. I won’t fail you.

text.cn: 你给我们带来了好运，外乡人。|将军告诉了我们绕过守卫去|找阿克塞尔的路，|还透露了地下城镇的位置和通|行密码。
text.src: You’ve brought us luck, foreigner. The general has told us a way to get to Axel past the guards and he also revealed the location and the access codes to the subterranean town.

text.cn: 我不敢想象你用什么手段|让他开口的。
text.src: I dread to think just what you did to make him talk.

text.cn: 你不想知道。我们负责引开敌人，|你潜入秘密城镇杀了阿克塞尔。
text.src: You don’t want to know it. So, we are distracting the enemy and you are getting inside the secret town and killing Axel.

text.cn: 这就是我来的目的。告诉我，去哪？
text.src: That’s what I came here for. Tell me, where do I go?

text.cn: 来，我在你地图上标出安全路线。|最重要的是保密。|行动开始后保持无线电静默。
text.src: Here, let me draw the safe way on your map. The main thing is to keep it all secret. Keep radio silence once we start the operation.

text.cn: 走吧。
text.src: Let’s do it.

text.cn: 假设我是荷马。你想知道什么？
text.src: Suppose, I’m Homer. What do you want to know?

text.cn: 这才像话。你想知道什么？
text.src: Now you are talking. What do you want to know?

text.cn: 不是没人能找到，是没人活着回来。|我想我是少数走得那么远的好|奇人之一。
text.src: It’s not that no one can find it, it’s that no one has returned alive. I guess I’m one of the few curious people who have gone that far.

text.cn: 西边沼泽后面有一条通向海边的路。|就在那里我看到了一个巨|大的咚咚作响的机器怪物，|还冒着蒸汽。谢天谢地是晚上，|我安全回来了。
text.src: So, there is a passage behind the western swamp that leads to the seaside. That’s where I saw this huge thumping monster of a machine, with steam coming out of it. Thank God it was night, so I safely made it back.

text.cn: 我告诉你我看到了什么。|我打赌怪物在守什么东西。|如果你想看看，我是唯一能|带你安全穿过沼泽的人。
text.src: I’m telling you what I saw. I bet you, the monster is guarding something. If you want to see it, I’m the only one who can show you the safe way in the swamp.

text.cn: 喝几杯我就心软了！|告诉你浅水从哪开始。|看到那棵死树了吗？|那里可以安全穿过沼泽。
text.src: I get so softhearted after a few glasses! I’ll tell you where the shallow waters start. See this dead tree? That’s where it’s safe to cross the swamp.

text.cn: 你好。你知道哪里能找到荷马吗？
text.src: Good day. Do you know where I can find Homer?

text.cn: 让我请你喝一两杯，|听你讲个你那出名的故事。
text.src: Let me buy you a glass or two and hear one of your famous stories.

text.cn: 酒保，给我朋友来杯烈的。|好了，荷马，跟我说说那个|没人能找到的神秘地方吧。
text.src: Barmen, give my friend something strong. So, Homer, tell me about the mysterious place you’ve been to that no one could find.

text.cn: 说重点。
text.src: Get to the point.

text.cn: 真不敢相信我走了这么|远就听到这些废话！
text.src: I can’t believe I’ve gone so far to hear that nonsense!

text.cn: 抱歉，我反应过激了。|我真的需要知道那个怪物在守什么。|你知道怎么穿过沼泽吗？
text.src: I’m sorry, I overreacted. I really need to know what that monster is guarding. Do you know how to cross the swamp?

text.cn: 谢谢，好心人。
text.src: Thank you, kind man.

text.cn: 这里不常看到新面孔。
text.src: You don’t often see new faces around here.

text.cn: 你真想听我的故事？
text.src: Do you really want to hear one of my stories?

text.cn: 喝点东西，聊起来更顺畅。
text.src: A talk will go smoother, when you get something to drink.

text.cn: 哦！你会看到一棵死树——|安全的小路就从那里开始。|你可以从那里穿过沼泽。
text.src: Ooh! You’ll see a dead tree – that’s where the safe trail starts. You can cross the swamp there.

text.cn: 我需要到沼泽对面。|你知道哪里可以安全通过吗？
text.src: I need to get to the other side of the swamp. Do you know where it’s safe to cross it?

text.cn: 酒保，给我朋友来杯烈的。|好了，荷马，我怎么穿过沼泽？
text.src: Barman, give my friend something strong. So, Homer, how do I cross the swamp?

text.cn: 谢谢。酒保，再来一杯。
text.src: Thanks. Barman, one more please.

text.cn: 又来一个从大陆来的访客。
text.src: One more visitor from the continent.

text.cn: 早上好。但什么海不海的？！
text.src: Morning. But what’s that about sea?!

text.cn: 你在自由之地的首都！|你看到海了吗？
text.src: You are in the capital of the free land! Do you see any sea here?

text.cn: 谁都知道那个话痨。|他一喝醉就用他的童话故事|骚扰别人。
text.src: Everyone knows that wind-bag. He harasses people with his fairy-tales when he gets drunk.

text.cn: 去渔村试试。别那样看我——|其他村子住的都是渔民。|我们村是唯一的例外。
text.src: Try one of the fishing villages. Don’t look at me like that – all other villages are inhabited by fishermen. Our village is the only exception.

text.cn: 早上好，海上的人们！
text.src: Good morning, people of the sea!

text.cn: 这是个渔村，对吧？
text.src: This a fishing village, isn’t it?

text.cn: 不完全是。如果冒犯了你的爱|国感情那就抱歉了。我在找老荷马。|听说过他吗？
text.src: Not really. Sorry if I touched your patriotic feelings. I’m looking for old Homer. Ever heard of him?

text.cn: 那我去哪里找他？
text.src: So, where do I find him?

text.cn: 谢谢，我去找他。
text.src: Thanks, I’ll go look for him.

text.cn: 我没什么要告诉你的。
text.src: I’ve got nothing to tell you.

text.cn: 太糟了。
text.src: Too bad.

text.cn: 我们在这里捕鱼。
text.src: We are fishing here.

text.cn: 我明白了。
text.src: I see.

text.cn: 嗨。不坐下来跟我喝一杯阿南加吗？
text.src: Hi. Why don’t you sit down and drink a glass of ananaga with me.

text.cn: 谢谢，但我有事要做。
text.src: Thanks, but I’ve got things to do.

text.cn: 你请客的话，我就喝。
text.src: If you are buying it, I will.

text.cn: 哼！我才不替你付酒钱！
text.src: Hem! I’m not gonna pay for your drinks!

text.cn: 我不需要。
text.src: I’ll do without it.

text.cn: 嘿，旅行者。如果你有空的话，|我可以给你讲个故事。
text.src: Hey, traveler. I can tell you a story if you’ve got some time to spare.

text.cn: 说吧，我听着呢。
text.src: Go on, I’m all ears.

text.cn: 很久很久以前……在……呃呃呃呃
text.src: It happened a long long time ago…at…hrrrrrrr

text.cn: 让他睡吧。我先走了。
text.src: Let him sleep. I’ll go now.

text.cn: 我坐在这里自怨自艾。
text.src: I’m sitting here, feeling sorry for myself.

text.cn: 为什么？
text.src: Why’s that?

text.cn: 最近日子不好过啊……
text.src: Life’s been hell lately…

text.cn: 倒霉事总会发生。
text.src: Shit happens.

text.cn: 大海把各种人送到这里来……|怎么了？
text.src: The sea brings all sorts of people here… What’s up?

text.cn: 你好！
text.src: Hello!

text.cn: 他不会在一个地方待很久；|总是到处跑。你可能在北|边的村庄找到他。
text.src: He doesn’t live in one place for long; he is always on the go. You might find him in the northern village.

text.cn: 你好，呃……渔民们！
text.src: Hello, um… fishermen!

text.cn: 荷马住这儿吗？
text.src: Does Homer live here?

text.cn: 谢谢。
text.src: Thanks.

text.cn: 你想干什么？
text.src: What do you want?

text.cn: 是的，我认识他。
text.src: Yeah, I know him.

text.cn: 他从一个村开到另一个村，|谁知道他现在在哪。
text.src: He drives from one village to another, there’s no telling where he can be now.

text.cn: 你找我有什么事？
text.src: What do you want from me?

text.cn: 我需要一种特殊的东西，|看起来像这个。
text.src: I need a special thing that looks like this one.

text.cn: 我有。100金币就行。
text.src: I’ve got it. 100 coins are all I’ll ask for it.

text.cn: 我考虑一下。
text.src: I’ll think about it.

text.cn: 我没钱。
text.src: I don’t have money.

text.cn: 我同意。
text.src: I agree.

text.cn: 你能帮我们吗？
text.src: Would you help us?

text.cn: 我们的仓库被当地人占领了。
text.src: Our storehouse has been captured by the locals.

text.cn: 我们不想跟当地人闹翻，|所以请你来做。
text.src: We don’t want to fall out with the locals, so we are asking you to do it.

text.cn: 能帮你什么？
text.src: What can I do for you?

text.cn: 你们为什么不反击？
text.src: Why don’t you fight it back?

text.cn: 我看看能做什么。
text.src: I’ll see what I can do.

text.cn: 仓库现在空出来了吗？
text.src: Is the storehouse free now?

text.cn: 那个畜生？我怀疑……|就算被关着，他也不肯合作。
text.src: That beast? I doubt it… Even imprisoned, he refuses to cooperate.

text.cn: 一辆货车离开了渔村，正朝这边来。
text.src: A van has left the fishing village and is heading here.

text.cn: 不行，该死的当地人拼命抵抗。|也许跟他们领袖谈谈有用？
text.src: No, the damn locals are fighting like crazy. Perhaps talking to their leader will help?

text.cn: 他在哪？
text.src: Where is he?

text.cn: 谢谢，我去找他。
text.src: Thanks, I’ll find him.

text.cn: 谢谢你救了我。你是谁？
text.src: Thanks for saving me. Who are you?

text.cn: 谢谢你。你帮助赫尔的人们打|败了外来商人。
text.src: Thank you. You helped people of Hel defeat foreign merchants.

text.cn: 小事一桩。上车，|我带你去找你的人。
text.src: Doesn’t matter. Get in; I’ll take you to your men.

text.cn: 我有自己的目的，|但很高兴帮上了忙。
text.src: I’ve got my own motives, but I’m glad I was of help.

text.cn: 站住！谁？
text.src: Stop! Who is it?

text.cn: 没事，我不是你的敌人。
text.src: It’s ok; I’m not your enemy.

text.cn: 让我们看看。你是谁？
text.src: Let us decide that. Who are you?

text.cn: 我来这里是想跟你们谈谈仓库的事。
text.src: I’ve come here to talk to you about the storehouse.

text.cn: 哈！这么说，商人终于意|识到抓我们的领袖不是什么|聪明主意，准备放人了？
text.src: Ha! So, the traders realized that capturing our leader wasn’t a clever idea and they are ready to set him free?

text.cn: 他们抓了你们的领袖？|这我不知道……
text.src: They’ve captured your leader, you say? That’s something I didn’t know…

text.cn: 我们生活在困难时期。|仓库是我们跟那些卑鄙商人|谈判的唯一筹码。
text.src: We are living in difficult times. The storehouse is our only way of negotiation with the dirty merchants.

text.cn: 你们在谈什么？
text.src: What are you negotiating?

text.cn: 我们要他们释放我们的领袖。|如果他们放了，我们就离开仓库。
text.src: We want them to release our leader. If they do it, we’ll leave the storehouse.

text.cn: 太麻烦了。把你们全杀了更简单。
text.src: Too much trouble. It’d be easier to kill you all.

text.cn: 好的，我来帮忙。你们的领袖在哪？
text.src: All right, I’ll help you. Where is your leader?

text.cn: 如果知道，他早被救出来了。|这是你的任务——|查出他们把他关在哪。
text.src: If we knew, he’d be free long ago. It’s your task – to find out where they’re keeping him.

text.cn: 我试试。
text.src: I’ll try to.

text.cn: 进展如何？知道他们把我们的领|袖关在哪了吗？
text.src: How is it going? Do you know where they keep our leader yet?

text.cn: 我在处理了。
text.src: I’m working on it.

text.cn: 我改主意了。我直接用武力|拿下仓库。
text.src: I’ve changed my mind. I’ll just go and take the storehouse by force.

text.cn: 不敢相信我的眼睛。|这外乡人守信用，|我们的领袖回来了！
text.src: I can’t believe my eyes. The foreigner has kept his word and our leader is back with us!

text.cn: 好，同志。能拿多少拿多少，|随时回来。
text.src: Sure, comrade. Take as much as you can carry and come back anytime.

text.cn: 现在该你履行交易了。撤离仓库。
text.src: Now to your part of the deal. Leave the storehouse.

text.cn: 我会回来的。
text.src: I’ll be back.

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What’s up?

text.cn: 快了。
text.src: I’m almost there.

text.cn: 仓库清了，活干完了。
text.src: The storehouse is clear, the work is done.

text.cn: 好！这是你的报酬。
text.src: Good! Here’s your reward.

text.cn: 行。
text.src: Cool.

text.cn: 我有麻烦了，年轻人……
text.src: I’m in trouble, young man…

text.cn: 你怎么了？
text.src: What happened to you?

text.cn: 我丈夫去赶集就没回来。|我打赌他卖完货就跑去喝酒了。|我到处找他。
text.src: My husband has gone to the market and never returned. I bet he sold the goods and went on a drinking round. I’m looking for him everywhere.

text.cn: 不关我的事。
text.src: It’s not my problem.

text.cn: 我可以帮你找到他。
text.src: I can help you find him.

text.cn: 谢谢你，年轻人。我在佩奇等消息。
text.src: Thank you, young man. I’ll be waiting for the news in Perch.

text.cn: 你丈夫叫什么？
text.src: What’s your husband’s name?

text.cn: 他叫菲利蒙，现在可能|正在某个当地酒吧喝酒。
text.src: His name’s Philemon and he’s probably drinking now in some local bar.

text.cn: 知道了。我去查查酒吧。
text.src: I got it. I’ll go check the bars.

text.cn: 怎么了，伙计？
text.src: What’s up, man?

text.cn: 菲利蒙，你妻子担心死了，|你却在这里喝酒！
text.src: Philemon, your wife is all worried about you, and you are sitting here drinking!

text.cn: 我被她烦死了。男人就不|能跟朋友出去喝个晚上？！
text.src: I’m sick of her. Can’t a man have a night out with his friends?!

text.cn: 让我送你回家。
text.src: Let me walk you home.

text.cn: 我不想回家。你开始让我烦了，|伙计！
text.src: I don’t want to go home. And you are starting to get on my nerves, man!

text.cn: 别逼我用强。
text.src: Don’t make me use force on you.

text.cn: 如果我付钱，你能放过我吗？
text.src: Will you leave me alone, if I pay you?

text.cn: 不行，我答应你妻子带你回家。
text.src: No, I promised your wife to bring you home.

text.cn: 好的，我去。
text.src: All right, I’ll go.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Good.

text.cn: 就可怜可怜你吧。多少？
text.src: I’ll have pity on you. How much?

text.cn: 500金币够吗？
text.src: Will 500 coins be enough?

text.cn: 我不期望更多了。我拿着。
text.src: I didn’t expect more from you. I’ll take it.

text.cn: 你把我丈夫带回来了吗？
text.src: Have you brought my husband back?

text.cn: 没有。你为什么不去找他？
text.src: No. Why don’t you go and look for him?

text.cn: 还在找。
text.src: I’m still looking.

text.cn: 我找到他了。他在村里。
text.src: I found him. He’s in the village.

text.cn: 他在这里。安然无恙。
text.src: Here he is. Safe and sound.

text.cn: 不知道怎么谢你。|我这里有些东西，送给你。
text.src: I don’t know how to thank you. I’ve got some things for sale here; I’ll give them to you.

text.cn: 谢谢。回头见。
text.src: Thanks. See you.

text.cn: 嗨！我们是一对新婚夫妇——|康妮和布莱德……|能搭我们一程吗？|我们的车坏了，真的得回家。|我们愿意付钱。
text.src: Hi! We are a young married couple – Connie and Blyde… Could you give us a lift? Our car broke down and we really need to get home. We’re ready to pay.

text.cn: 不对，我闻到阴谋的味道了。
text.src: Nah, I smell rat here.

text.cn: 好，上车。
text.src: Sure, get in.

text.cn: 谢谢搭车。见见我们的朋友！|把车里的东西交出来。打劫！
text.src: Thanks for the lift. Meet our friends! And give us what you’ve got in the trunk. It’s a hold up!

text.cn: 我什么都不会给你。
text.src: I’m not giving you anything.

text.cn: 该死！原来你们就是一帮劫匪。|要什么随便拿，别杀我就行。
text.src: Damn! So, you are just a bunch of bandits. Take what you want, but don’t kill me.

text.cn: 哈哈！兄弟们，撤！
text.src: Ha-ha! Let’s get out of here, guys!

text.cn: 又轻信了别人一次……
text.src: So much for trusting people again...

text.cn: 想给生活加点料，|赚点钱或享受一下？|娱乐中心适合你。想了解更多？
text.src: Wanna spice up you life, earn some money or simply have a nice time? The Amusement Center is for you. Want to know more?

text.cn: 我没时间浪费。
text.src: I’ve got no time to waste.

text.cn: 说吧。
text.src: Go on.

text.cn: 娱乐中心是长途司机花钱享|受优质娱乐的地方。|我在你地图上标出来。就在这里。
text.src: The Amusement Center is a place, where long distance drivers go to get quality entertainment for their money. Let me show it on your map. It’s right here.

text.cn: 希望那个中心像他们说的那么好。
text.src: I hope the center is as good as they say.

text.cn: 你好，年轻人。你对建筑史|感兴趣吗？其实不重要。|我的大限将至，没人愿意|带这个老头去古代地下墓室。|那是一座具有伟大文化和建|筑价值的纪念碑，|我真的很想在那里度过最后的时光。|你能带我去吗？我会付钱的。
text.src: Good day, young man. Are you interested in history of architecture? Not that it matters, really. My end is near and no one wants to take the old man to the ancient crypt. It is a monument of great cultural and architectural value, and I would really like to spend my last hours there. Perhaps you will take me there? I’ll pay.

text.cn: 恐怕我帮不了你。
text.src: I’m afraid I can’t help you.

text.cn: 好的，我来帮忙。
text.src: All right, I’ll help you.

text.cn: 终于到了。谢谢你。|我会在那些古老的墓室中安息。
text.src: We are finally there. Thank you. I’ll find rest in one of those ancient chambers.

text.cn: 再见！
text.src: Good bye!

text.cn: 你能帮我们抓一个藏在活死|人镇的人吗？他是只老狐狸，|每次都让他溜了。
text.src: Will you help us catch somebody who’s hiding in the town of the dead? He’s a wily old fox and somehow he always get away.

text.cn: 不适合我。
text.src: Nah, it’s not for me.

text.cn: 总算来了点有意思的！|你为什么要找他？
text.src: At last something interesting for a change! Why do you want him?

text.cn: 这条路尽头以前有个娱乐中心，|但一帮输钱的劫匪一怒|之下把它毁了。那是附近唯|一的娱乐中心！所有劫匪都抓到了，|就差一个。他躲在活死人镇里！|帮我们，报酬丰厚。
text.src: There used to be an Amusement Center down the road, but a bunch of bandits who lost their money there destroyed it in a fit of rage. It was the only entertainment center in the neighborhood! We caught all the bandits, but one. He is hiding in the damn town of the dead! Help us and we’ll pay you generously.

text.cn: 我很乐意帮你做。
text.src: I’d be happy to do it for you.

text.cn: 你大概是来娱乐中心赢钱玩的吧……|很抱歉，我们没什么可提供的了。|有些劫匪在这里输了很多钱，|一怒之下把中心夷为平地。|但你不想空手而归吧？|让我给你出个谜语。|付100金币，你有机会翻倍。
text.src: You’ve probably come here to win some money and have fun in our Entertainment Center… I’m sorry to tell you that, but we have nothing to offer you. Some bandits lost a lot of money here and razed the center to the ground in a fit of rage. But you don’t want to leave this place empty-handed, do you? Let me propose you a riddle. Pay 100 coins and you’ll get a chance to double it.

text.cn: 真可惜。我不擅长猜谜。
text.src: What a shame. I’m no good at riddles.

text.cn: 总比没有好。来吧。给你钱。
text.src: That’s better than nothing. Go ahead. Here’s the money.

text.cn: 仔细听好了。开黑卡车的白|人司机在窄路上遇到开白卡|车的黑人司机。谁先死？
text.src: Listen carefully. A White driver on a Black truck met a Black driver on a White truck on a narrow road. Who’s gonna die first?

text.cn: 白人那个。
text.src: The White one.

text.cn: 答错了！开白卡车的黑人司|机是普通长途司机，|保养车很好但没时间洗自己。|开黑卡车的白人司机是劫匪，|打理自己很好但车况很差。|普通司机先死，因为这是生活，|不是童话，生活中坏人总是赢。
text.src: Wrong answer! The Black driver on a White truck is an ordinary long-distance driver, who looks well after his truck, but has no time to wash himself. A White driver on a Black truck is a bandit, who looks well after himself, but keeps his truck in a bad state. The ordinary driver will die first, because this is life, not a fairy tale, and in life bad guys always win.

text.cn: 我的钱包倒霉了。|但这谜语不对劲……
text.src: Too bad for my wallet. But that’s wrong kind of riddle...

text.cn: 黑人那个。
text.src: The Black one.

text.cn: 对了！开白卡车的黑人司机|是普通长途司机，|保养车很好但没时间洗自己。|开黑卡车的白人司机是劫匪，|打理自己很好但车况很差。|普通司机先死，因为这是生活，|不是童话，生活中坏人总是赢。
text.src: Right you are! The Black driver on a White truck is an ordinary long-distance driver, who looks well after his truck, but has no time to wash himself. A White driver on a Black truck is a bandit, who looks well after himself, but keeps his truck in a bad state. The ordinary driver will die first, because this is life, not a fairy tale, and in life bad guys always win.

text.cn: 蠢谜语。给我钱。
text.src: Stupid riddle. Give me my money.

text.cn: 娱乐中心没开。回去吧。
text.src: The Amusement Center isn’t working. Turn round.

text.cn: 真可惜……
text.src: What a shame…

text.cn: 你去哪？没看到路封了吗？
text.src: Where are you going? Don’t you see the road is closed?

text.cn: 劫匪闯进了军事基地，|弄到了很强的武器。|他们的威胁是真的！|如果我们不采取行动，|他们会占领我们的城镇。
text.src: Bandits broke into the military base and got some really powerful guns there. Their threats turned out to be real! If we don’t do anything, they’ll occupy our town.

text.cn: 只有两条路通向那里：|一条经过我们镇，|另一条经过劫匪窝。
text.src: Only two roads lead there: one of them is through our town, the other – through the bandits’ den.

text.cn: 战争时期，伙计！|镇子封锁了，直到我们解决|劫匪的问题。我们得自保。
text.src: It’s wartime, man! The town is closed until we sort it out with the bandits. We have to defend ourselves.

text.cn: 这里怎么了？你们为什么疯跑？
text.src: What’s going on here? Why are you running about like crazy?

text.cn: 祝你好运。顺便问一下，|怎么去东北方？
text.src: Good luck to you. By the way, how can I get to the north-east?

text.cn: 能让我过去吗？
text.src: Won’t you let me pass?

text.cn: 我该怎么办？
text.src: What am I to do?

text.cn: 你看不见吗？路封了！
text.src: Don’t you see? The road is closed!

text.cn: 你完了吗？
text.src: Are you done yet?

text.cn: 说你的事。
text.src: State your business.

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: Wazzup?

text.cn: 看看谁来了！又是那个搞笑的家伙！|又想找刺激了？这次可不会|轻易放你走！
text.src: Look who’s come! It’s the funny guy again! Want to tickle your nerves again? We won’t let you go so easily!

text.cn: 要用这座桥得付500金币。
text.src: You’ve got to pay 500 coins if you want to use the bridge.

text.cn: 又见面了！你的钱帮了大忙。|我们贿赂了镇上的守卫，|搬到了别的地方。都是用你的钱！|哈哈哈。但这不代表你可以随|便走这条路。过路费只要|500金币，已经是很大的折扣了，|信我们。
text.src: Glad to see you! Your money helped us a lot, you know. We bribed the guards in the town and moved to another place. All for your money! Ha-ha-ha. But it doesn’t mean you can drive here you please. The fee will be only 500 coins and that’s with a huge discount, believe us.

text.cn: 欢迎来到阿斯加德！
text.src: Welcome to Asgard!

text.cn: 什么风把你吹来了？
text.src: What brings you here?

text.cn: 谢谢帮忙。他们短期内应该|不会回来了。你需要什么？炸药？|要多少拿多少。没什么不能给你的。
text.src: Thanks for the help. I doubt they’ll come back soon after that. What do you need? Some explosives? Take as much as you need. There’s nothing we wouldn’t give you.

text.cn: 快点，我很忙。
text.src: Be quick, I’m busy.

text.cn: 太感谢了！现在终于可以不|用担心生命安全地休息了。
text.src: Thank you so much! Now we can finally take a rest without worrying about our lives.

text.cn: 看来你从很远的地方来。|来这里做生意还是冒险？
text.src: Looks like you’ve come from distant lands. Are you looking for business or adventures here?

text.cn: 你想干什么，流浪汉？
text.src: What do you want, tramp?

text.cn: 那我图什么？我要现金。
text.src: So, how about my motivation? I could use some cash.

text.cn: 又是你。怎么了？
text.src: You, again. Now what?

text.cn: 查到什么了吗？
text.src: Found out anything?

text.cn: 你想干什么，陌生人？
text.src: What do you want, stranger?

text.cn: 我在找一个住在遥远北方的人。|能给我指路吗？
text.src: I’m looking for someone who lives in the far north. Could you show me the way there?

text.cn: 还有一个问题：镇上没有汽油。|没有我们的向导你也找不到去|奥尔姆的路。如果你能为我们的商|队找到汽油，可以跟他们一起北上；|他们会给你指去奥尔姆的路。|现在去跟镇长谈。|告诉他鲨鱼派你来帮忙的。
text.src: There’s yet another problem: we have no petrol in town. And you won’t find your way to Ohlm without our guides. If you find petrol for our caravans, you can join them in their journey to the North; they’ll show you the road to Ohlm. Go talk to the mayor now. Tell him Sharky sent you to help with the problem.

text.cn: 好吧。
text.src: All right.

text.cn: 谢谢！你真的帮了我们镇子。|路过时随时来，我们的店铺|永远给你折扣。
text.src: Thanks! You really helped our town. Be our guest anytime you pass by and you can always rely on a discount in our shops.

text.cn: 既然汽油问题解决了，|你可以跟着我们的商队走。|他们会给你指路。
text.src: Now that we’ve solved the petrol problem, you can follow our caravans. They’ll show you the way.

text.cn: 再见。
text.src: Goodbye.

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What’s up?

text.cn: 这是第一桶油。
text.src: Here’s the first barrel of oil.

text.cn: 能帮你什么？
text.src: What can I do for you?

text.cn: 听说附近有一条穿过山脉|通往西边的隧道。是真的吗？
text.src: I heard there is a tunnel nearby that goes through the mountains and leads to the west. Is that right?

text.cn: 当然。
text.src: Absolutely.

text.cn: 能告诉我具体从哪开始吗？
text.src: Won’t you tell me where exactly it starts?

text.cn: 我在你地图上标出来。
text.src: Let me mark it on your map.

text.cn: 就这样？不需要我帮忙或付钱？
text.src: Just like that? And you don’t need my help or my money?

text.cn: 少教我怎么做生意，小子。
text.src: Don’t teach me how to manage my business, young man.

text.cn: 切！
text.src: Well I never!

text.cn: 又是你。
text.src: You again.

text.cn: 现在我明白你说的是什么生意了。|你有隧道门的钥匙吗？
text.src: Now I see what business you were talking about. Do you happen to have a key from the tunnel door?

text.cn: 也许有吧，如果我努力找的话。|那当然要花时间、|精力和损失利润……|10000应该够补偿了。
text.src: Perhaps I do, if I look really hard for it. It will certainly cost me time, efforts and lost profits… 10,000 should be enough to compensate it.

text.cn: 我买不起。
text.src: I can’t afford it.

text.cn: 好贵……好吧，我付。
text.src: That’s a lot of money... Oh well, I guess I’ll have to pay.

text.cn: 随时欢迎。
text.src: You are always welcome.

text.cn: 现在我可以去西边了。
text.src: I can go west now.

text.cn: 别忘了，钥匙要10000。
text.src: In case you forgot, the key costs 10,000.

text.cn: 我是酒保。有什么能帮你的？
text.src: I’m barman. Can I help you?

text.cn: 是的，也许你可以。|我一直在跟踪这个女孩，|她应该在这个镇停留过，|或者至少路过这里。
text.src: Yes, you probably can. I’ve been following this girl, she should have stopped by this town or at least she should have passed it on her way.

text.cn: 让我想想……嗯……|哦，对了！她来过！|我想她是穿过隧道走的。
text.src: Let me think…Ummm...Oh, yes! She’s been here! I think she’d left through the tunnel.

text.cn: 隧道？什么隧道？能指给我看吗？
text.src: The tunnel? What tunnel? Can you show it to me?

text.cn: 我们聊天时你怎么不喝点什么？
text.src: Why don’t you get something to drink while we are talking?

text.cn: 酒保，给我来一杯玛格丽特！|给那边的朋友也来点什么。|确保他的杯子永远是满的。
text.src: Barman, one margarita for me, please! And something for my friend over there. Make sure his glass is always full.

text.cn: 什么……！我……！你……！|呃呃呃呃
text.src: What the…! I’ll…! You’re…! Hrrrrr

text.cn: 看看你！你醉了，朋友。|钥匙在这里。也不难嘛。|我该去隧道了。
text.src: Look at you! You are drunk, my friend. Here is the key. It wasn’t that hard, after all. I’d better be going to the tunnel.

text.cn: 劫匪再也没法走这条路了。|我也一样。我最好另找一条路。|我去镇上打听一下。
text.src: Bandits will never be able to take this road again. Me neither. I’d better find another way. I’ll go ask about it in the town.

text.cn: 我听说探险家伊万曾住在这里。|我想去看看他的房子。
text.src: I heard here lived Explorer Ivan. I’d like to visit his house.

text.cn: 你来对地方了：伊万曾经和妻子、|儿子住在那栋房子里。|一切都好，直到那个可怕的夜晚，|他外出时劫匪杀了他的妻子。|劫匪也没一个活着离开。|那个勇敢的女人为保护儿子而死。|伊万带着男孩离开了镇子。|从那以后房子一直空着。
text.src: You’ve come to the right place: Ivan used to live in that house with his wife and son. All was well until that dreadful night when he was out of town and the bandits killed his wife. None of the bandits got out alive, either. That brave woman died protecting her son.  Ivan took the boy and left the town. The house has been empty ever since.

text.cn: 从没见过你描述的那种东西。
text.src: I’ve never seen anything that matches your glaring description.

text.cn: 等等！但我从一个朋友那里听说的，|他又是从他的朋友那里听说的……
text.src: Wait! But I heard it from one of my friends who heard it from one of his friends...

text.cn: 嗯，有个渔夫，他会讲海底|宝藏和守护宝藏的怪兽的故事。|不过没人能找到宝藏，|因为只有渔夫知道在哪里。
text.src: Well, there's a fisherman, who tells the tale of sea treasure and a monster that guards it. No one can find the treasure, though, because only the fisherman knows the place.

text.cn: 你说的是哪个讲故事的人？
text.src: What storyteller are you talking about?

text.cn: 想不起他名字了……
text.src: Can’t seem to remember his name...

text.cn: 说起来，我的记忆需要点动|力才能运转……
text.src: Come to think of it, my memory needs some motivation to get going...

text.cn: 我想起来了……肯定是老荷马。
text.src: It’s coming back to me now... It was old Homer definitely.

text.cn: 当然在海边——渔村里。|但还有另一个问题。|你看，镇上没有汽油，|商队没法北上。你一个人也找|不到去奥尔姆的路。
text.src: On the seashore, of course – in the fishermen’s village. But here comes another problem. You see, there’s no petrol in town, so our caravans cannot go North. And you won’t find the way to Ohlm alone.

text.cn: 我不明白你在说什么。|听着，你看起来是个勇敢的人。|如果你帮我们，你可以加|入我们的商队一起北上。|他们会给你指去奥尔姆的路。|先去跟镇长谈谈。|告诉他鲨鱼派你来帮忙的。
text.src: I don't understand what you are talking about. Listen, you seem to be a brave guy. If you help us, you can join our caravan and go North with them. They’ll show you the road to Ohlm. Go talk to the mayor first. Tell him Sharky sent you to help with the problem.

text.cn: 你吗？好吧，我们确实需要|一切能得到的帮助。
text.src: You? Well, we actually need all the help we can get.

text.cn: 就像那个老笑话：|枪打不响有20个原因。|第一个——没弹药。|呵……劫匪占了油井，|断了我们的油。汽油快用完了。
text.src: It’s like in the old joke: there were 20 reasons the guns didn’t shoot. The first one – there were no ammo. Heh… Bandits captured the oil derrick and cut us off the oil. Our petrol supplies are coming to an end.

text.cn: 我们没全力以赴，|因为忙着解决内部问题。|你看，我们的工会罢工了。
text.src: We didn’t fight as well as we could, because we were busy solving internal problems. You see, our trade union has gone on a strike.

text.cn: 一句话，是的。
text.src: In a word, yes.

text.cn: 我们会非常感激！
text.src: We will be very grateful!

text.cn: 但石油不会自己流出来！|那帮混蛋在酒吧喝酒，|明明可以去干活！
text.src: But oil isn’t going to flow just like that! The bastards are drinking in the bar, when they could actually do something!

text.cn: 我们在罢工！你看不见吗？
text.src: We are on a strike! Can't you see?

text.cn: 活累钱少。凭什么我们累死累活？|该死的镇长拿走所有利润！
text.src: Work is hard, pay is small. Why should we work our asses out? When the damn mayor gets all the profit!

text.cn: 是镇长毁了这座镇！|我们为什么要镇长？|尤其是他这种人。我们罢工了。|没什么好说的！
text.src: It’s the mayor who ravaged the town! Why do we need mayor in the first place? Especially somebody like him. We are on a strike. End of discussion!

text.cn: 别问了！
text.src: Don’t even ask!

text.cn: 我告诉过你了！他再也当|不了权威了。等我见到他要|踹他屁股。
text.src: I already told you! He’s not going to be an authority anymore. I’ll kick his ass when I see him.

text.cn: 当然！
text.src: Sure thing!

text.cn: 你说赚大钱。但那的工作条|件是地狱！
text.src: Tons of money you say. But the work conditions are hell there!

text.cn: 谁跟你说我们不想干活？|我们当然想。要是能有点启|动资金就好了。
text.src: Who told you we don’t want to? Of course we want to. If we could only get some start-up money.

text.cn: 人人都想要爱丽丝。|但谁也别想得到她！哈哈哈！
text.src: Everybody needs Alice. But no one is going to get her! Ha-ha-ha!

text.cn: 你真以为我们会让你离开？！|我们是劫匪，你没注意到吗……|给他点教训，兄弟们！
text.src: Do you really believe we’ll let you leave this place?! We are bandits, in case you didn’t notice… Let’s teach him some manners, guys!

text.cn: 她是你的朋友？
text.src: Is she a friend of yours?

text.cn: 我认识那女孩。换作我，|我不会跟她扯上关系。
text.src: I know that girl. I wouldn’t get involved with her if I were you.

text.cn: 她背后有危险的人。
text.src: There are dangerous people behind her.

text.cn: 她经常来这里办自己的事。|最后一次见到她时她往东去了。|我不建议你去那个方向。
text.src: She often comes here on some business of her own. The last time I saw her she was heading east. I wouldn’t recommend you going in that direction.

text.cn: 那里有个劫匪基地。|很大且防御坚固。|劫匪只听得懂枪的语言。你够强吗？|我可不太确定。
text.src: There’s a bandits’ base there. It’s large and well fortified. Bandits won’t negotiate other than in the language of guns. Are you strong enough for that? I’m not so sure.

text.cn: 炸掉那座桥！
text.src: Blow up that bridge!

text.cn: 那条通往军事基地的路上的那座。|如果你炸了它，敌|人就到不了我们镇了。
text.src: The one, on the road leading to the military base. If you destroy it, the enemy won’t get to our town.

text.cn: 首先，我们得找些炸药。|阿斯加德应该有。|他们毕竟是矿工。|我们得把炸药放在桥下。|当然守卫很严。但我相信你没问题。
text.src: First of all, we need to find some explosives. They should have some in Asgard. They are miners, after all. We’ll have to place the charge under the bridge. It’s well guarded of course. But I’m sure, you’ll be ok.

text.cn: 你找炸药来对地方了。|我们卖的是这一带最好的炸弹。
text.src: You’ve come to the right place for the explosives. We sell the best bombs in the area.

text.cn: 但我们目前有些问题，|近期无法生产炸药。|最近需求量太大了。
text.src: But we are having problems at the moment, so we won’t be able to produce any explosives in the near future. It’s been in great demand lately.

text.cn: 看在你顺眼的份上告诉你，|你可以在矿工村买到炸药。|当然质量差一些。
text.src: Just because I like you, I’ll tell you that you can buy some explosives in the miners’ village. The quality of their product is lower, of course.

text.cn: 需要炸药的不止你一个。|劫匪不断攻击我们抢夺物资！
text.src: You are not the only one who needs it. Bandits are constantly attacking us to get our supplies!

text.cn: 上墙！所有人！敌人来了！|嘿，如果你需要炸药，帮我们守住！
text.src: To the walls! Everyone! The enemy’s coming! Hey, if you need the explosives, help us defend it!

text.cn: 我们为什么不直接|拿了你的钱再把你埋了？
text.src: Why don’t we just take your money and bury your corpse?

text.cn: 你的幽默感真不错！|付钱走人。但再让我看到你，|就杀了你！
text.src: What I really like about you is your sense of humor! Pay and go now. But if I see you again, I’ll kill you, man!

text.cn: 哈哈哈！你开玩笑吧！|你闯进我们总部就开始发号施令！|好久没这么笑过了，|整天就是抢劫杀人……|好了，搞笑先生，|交10000走人。
text.src: Ha-ha-ha! You must be kidding! You come right into our headquarters and start ordering about! It’s been a while since I had such a good laugh with all the raids and murders… Oh, well, Mr. Funny Guy, pay 10,000 and go.

text.cn: 如果你能凑到钱，给我们送来。|现在从我眼前消失。
text.src: If you manage to get the cash, bring it to us. Now get out of my eyes.

text.cn: 真是个悲伤的故事……我先走了。
text.src: That was a sad story... I’d better go now.

text.cn: 拿钱。
text.src: Take the money.

text.cn: 对我来说太贵了。
text.src: The price is way too high for me.

text.cn: 该死！这下不好了。
text.src: Damn! That’s not good.

text.cn: 我在找海门。应该是个很大的东西。|他们说一看就知道。|应该就在这附近。
text.src: I’m looking for the Sea Gates, It should be something big. They say I’ll know when I see it. It must be somewhere around here.

text.cn: 我只好问别人了。
text.src: I guess I’ll have to ask somebody else.

text.cn: 快说！
text.src: Come on, fess up!

text.cn: 那么，那个讲故事的人叫什么？
text.src: So, what was the name of this storyteller?

text.cn: 那个该死的渔夫！别装傻！
text.src: The damn fisher! Don't play fool!

text.cn: 想想看。使劲想！
text.src: Try to remember. Try really hard!

text.cn: 给你100金币。
text.src: Here are 100 coins.

text.cn: 我现在没有东西能刺激你的记忆。
text.src: I’ve got nothing to motivate your memory with at the moment.

text.cn: 给你100金币。
text.src: Here are 100 coins.

text.cn: 我很快就给你弄到钱。
text.src: I’ll get you the money soon.

text.cn: 老荷马？哪里能找到他？
text.src: Old Homer? Where can I find him?

text.cn: 你想从我身上榨更多钱？
text.src: Are you trying to wring more money out of me?

text.cn: 我现在就去那里。
text.src: I’ll go there now.

text.cn: 鲨鱼派我来帮你解决问题。
text.src: Sharky sent me to help you with the problem.

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What’s the wrong?

text.cn: 你指望我一个人去打劫匪，|镇上所有男人都搞不定他们？
text.src: Are you expecting me to go and fight the bandits all on my own, when all men of the town couldn’t handle them?

text.cn: 所以，除了解决劫匪，|你还要我去让工人回来干|活或者找新工人？
text.src: So, besides getting rid of the bandits, you want me to go and make your workers get back to work or find you some new ones?

text.cn: 好的，先从简单的开始：解决劫匪。
text.src: All right, I’ll start with the easier one: the bandits.

text.cn: 放马过来！
text.src: Bring it on!

text.cn: 小事一桩。
text.src: Not a big deal.

text.cn: 我看看能对你的工人做什么。|我会试试劝劝他们。
text.src: I’ll see what I can do with your workers. I’ll try to talk some sense into them.

text.cn: 回去干活吧，伙计们。|别坐在这里了！
text.src: Let’s get back to work, men. Stop sitting here!

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What’s the matter?

text.cn: 他说镇子很穷，被劫匪糟蹋了。
text.src: He says the town is poor, the bandits have ravaged it.

text.cn: 但我真的需要……
text.src: But I really need to...

text.cn: 我得查查镇长到底怎么回事。
text.src: I’ll have to find out what’s the fuss about mayor.

text.cn: 你说得对——镇长是个贼和骗子。|我找到了他藏镇上钱的地方。
text.src: You are right – the mayor is a thief and a liar. I found where he keeps town’s money.

text.cn: 现在你们自己说了算了，|回去干活吗？
text.src: Now that you are your own bosses, are you going to work?

text.cn: 上车吧。我带你去油田。
text.src: Get in the truck then. I'll bring you to the oil mine.

text.cn: 现在我把这桶油带给米宁的人，|证明油田恢复生产了。
text.src: Now I'll bring this barrel to the Minin people as a sign that the oil mine is working again.

text.cn: 北方的路怎么样了？
text.src: What about the road to the North?

text.cn: 油田没人。你可以在那里工作，|赚大钱！
text.src: There’s no one at the oil mine. You can work there and earn tons of money!

text.cn: 随你便。我找别人来干你的活。
text.src: Suit yourself. I’ll find other people to do your job.

text.cn: 多少？
text.src: How much?

text.cn: 成交。上车。
text.src: Deal. Get in the truck.

text.cn: 我考虑一下。
text.src: I’ll think about it.

text.cn: 我需要跟爱丽丝谈谈！
text.src: I need to talk to Alice!

text.cn: 我知道她在里面。不带走她我不走。
text.src: I know she's there. I’m not leaving without her.

text.cn: 我才不管你是不是魔鬼转世！|我要得到我来的目的。
text.src: I don’t care if you are Devil incarnate! I’ll get what I came here for.

text.cn: 我在找一个叫爱丽丝的女孩。|中等身高，长得不错，|开着一辆颜色和设计都很特|别的卡车。
text.src: I’m looking for a girl named Alice. She’s average height, good looking and is driving a truck of unusual design and color.

text.cn: 不知道。但她有一些我急需的信息。
text.src: No. But she has some information I really need.

text.cn: 为什么？
text.src: Why so?

text.cn: 少废话。告诉我你知道什么。
text.src: Cut the crap. Tell me what you know.

text.cn: 你是不是偏执狂？|为什么到处看到危险？
text.src: Man, are you paranoid or what? Why do you see danger everywhere?

text.cn: 如果没有别的办法，我只好走了。|回头见！
text.src: I guess I’ll have to go, if there is no other way. See you!

text.cn: 明白了。我需要做什么才能被放行？
text.src: I see. What do I need to do to be allowed to pass?

text.cn: 什么桥？
text.src: What bridge?

text.cn: 我该怎么做？
text.src: How am I supposed to do it?

text.cn: 好计划，但你们为什么自己不做？|胆小鬼……
text.src: It is great plan, but why cannot you do it yourselves? Cowards...

text.cn: 我需要炸药。现在就要。生死攸关。
text.src: I need explosives. Now. It’s a question of life and death.

text.cn: 我告诉你，很紧急！
text.src: I’m telling you, it’s urgent!

text.cn: 但我真的需要。
text.src: But I really need it.

text.cn: 谢谢！
text.src: Thanks!

text.cn: 听说你们这里有炸药。
text.src: I was told you’ve got some explosives here.

text.cn: 不奇怪，阿斯加德什么都不肯卖。
text.src: Small wonders, considering Asgard won't sell anything.

text.cn: 又来了。一天不战斗都不行！|好吧，我帮你。
text.src: There you go again. Not a day without battle! All right, I'll help you.

text.cn: 太好了！
text.src: That’s great!

text.cn: 嗯……荣誉？
text.src: Hmmm... Honor?

text.cn: 呼！好险……
text.src: Phew! That was close...

text.cn: 等等。我准备好付钱了。
text.src: Hold it. I’m ready to pay.

text.cn: 没问题。我差不多凑够钱了。
text.src: Easy. I’ve almost got the right sum.

text.cn: 嘿，伙计们。为什么不让我过去？
text.src: Hey, guys. Why don’t you let me pass?

text.cn: 我没那么多钱。
text.src: I don’t have so much money.

text.cn: 给你钱。
text.src: Here’s the money.

text.cn: 我考虑一下。
text.src: I’ll think about it.

text.cn: 你在这里干什么？
text.src: And what do you think you're doing here?

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What's wrong?

text.cn: 有人闯进了父亲的家！
text.src: Somebody’s broken into father’s house!

text.cn: 我就知道出事了。|我看到一个形迹可疑的人在附|近窥探。肯定是他。|他往劫匪基地去了。
text.src: I knew something happened. I saw a suspicious-looking man prying about here. I bet it was him. He headed to the bandits’ base.

text.cn: 谢谢提示。
text.src: Thanks for the hint.

text.cn: 你是谁？我不认识你。
text.src: Who are you? I don’t know you.

text.cn: 你偷了我们家的珠宝！|这是对我祖先的侮辱！|我要求你归还不属于你的珍贵之物。
text.src: You’ve stolen our family jewels! What an insult to my forefathers! I demand you to return the precious thing that does not belong to you.

text.cn: 什么？胡说八道！
text.src: What? You talk rubbish!

text.cn: 可恶！我别无选择只能杀了你！
text.src: It’s outrageous! I have no other choice but to kill you!

text.cn: 有本事来抓我！
text.src: Catch me if you can!

text.cn: 你死定了！
text.src: You are a dead man!

text.cn: 我们是正经的考古学家，|但有些无赖妨碍我们挖掘。|如果你能赶走他们，|我们将不胜感激。
text.src: We are honest archeologists, but some rogues hinder us from our dig. We would be grateful, if you get rid of them.

text.cn: 我看看能做什么。
text.src: I will see what I can do.

text.cn: 自己解决吧。
text.src: Get through with it by yourselves.

text.cn: 听着，伙计，你看起来是个硬汉。|附近有些外乡人在挖宝。|他们几乎没什么防备。|我们可以一起赚大钱。
text.src: Listen, pal, you look like a tough guy. Some strangers are digging for treasures nearby. They are almost defenseless. We can earn a lot of money together.

text.cn: 算我一个。
text.src: I’m in.

text.cn: 我不会攻击无辜的人。
text.src: I won’t attack innocent people.

text.cn: 你在想什么？
text.src: What’s on your mind?

text.cn: 真的吗？好消息。人们正无聊呢。
text.src: Really? It is good news. People are bored.

text.cn: 你知道古罗马竞技场现在是|战斗竞技场了吗？
text.src: Do you know that the ancient Colosseum is a battle arena now?

text.cn: 那里见。玩得开心。
text.src: See you there. Have fun.

text.cn: 希望带来好消息。
text.src: I hope you bring good news.

text.cn: 太好了！我会让所有人都知道。
text.src: Great! I will make sure everybody get to know it.

text.cn: 我们在古罗马竞技场开|设了一个战斗竞技场。
text.src: We are opening a battle arena at the Colosseum.

text.cn: 回头见。
text.src: See ya.

text.cn: 什么风把你吹来了？
text.src: What brought you here?

text.cn: 好消息。我会去那里，还带上朋友。
text.src: Good news indeed. I will go there and bring friends with me.

text.cn: 我们在古罗马竞技场开|设了一个战斗竞技场。
text.src: We are opening a battle arena at the Colosseum.

text.cn: 那里见。
text.src: See you there.

text.cn: 科尔霍兹的人害怕了，拒绝收割。|如果他们离开田地，|明年我们就会短缺。|去看看那里出了什么事。
text.src: People of the Kolkhoz are scared and refuse to harvest. If they leave the fields, we’ll be short of supplies next year. Go and find out what happened there.

text.cn: 我来做。
text.src: I’ll do it.

text.cn: 不感兴趣。
text.src: I’m not interested.

text.cn: 嗯，你想知道什么？
text.src: Well, what do you want to know?

text.cn: 明白了。光、田地上的标记，|我听说过。你找对地方了。|我们会派考察队过去安抚民众。|你的任务完成了。这是你的报酬。|如果再看到类似的标记，|请一定通知我们。
text.src: I see. Lights, signs on the fields, I heard about it. You came to the right place. We will send an expedition there and calm the people down. Your mission is over. Here is your reward. If you ever see such marks again, do not hesitate to inform us.

text.cn: 人们看到天空中有光，|然后田里出现了奇怪的标记。|人们很害怕。也许你能帮忙。
text.src: People saw lights in the sky, and then some strange marks appeared on the fields. People are scared. May be you can help.

text.cn: 当然会发现更多。
text.src: Of course I will find more of them.

text.cn: 冷静一下，年轻人。我在听。
text.src: Calm down, young man. I'm listening.

text.cn: 托斯卡纳附近周期性地出现|大型标记！
text.src: Some large signs periodically appear near Toskana!

text.cn: 好，我们马上派考察队过去。
text.src: Fine, we'll send an expedition immediately.

text.cn: 太好了。
text.src: Great.

text.cn: 年轻人，你似乎在担心什么。|怎么了？
text.src: Young man, you seem to be worrying about something. What happened?

text.cn: 听着。我在神谕的岛上|看到了田地里非常奇怪的标记。
text.src: Listen. I was at the Oracle’s island and saw some really strange signs on the fields.

text.cn: 明白了！我正在调查这个现象。|你说伊格诺特。那离这里挺远。|但确实说得通。差点忘了，|这是你的报酬。
text.src: I see! I am currently investigating this phenomenon. Ignott, you say. That’s quite far from here. But it makes sense, after all. I almost forgot, here’s your reward.

text.cn: 谢谢。如果再看到类似的东|西我一定通知你。
text.src: Thanks. If I ever see something of a kind I’ll definitely inform you.

text.cn: 年轻人，你对我的工作贡献很大。|现在我很清楚下一次考察要|去哪里了。太兴奋了！
text.src: Young man, you contributed a lot to my work. Now I know perfectly well where the next visit will take place. I am so excited!

text.cn: 你想让我陪你一起去吗？
text.src: Do you want me to accompany you?

text.cn: 什么？哦不！我自己能搞定。|不过结果可能大不相同。|所以我想让你替我保管这份文件。|它有重大的历史价值！
text.src: What? Oh no! I can handle everything by myself. However the outcome may vary greatly. So I want you to keep this document for me. It is of a great historical value!

text.cn: 所以呢？我猜你附近有档案室。|把文件放那里吧。
text.src: So what? I guess you have archives somewhere around. Put your paper there.

text.cn: 说实话，我最近的研究|毁了我的名声。以前的同事|不再认真对待我了。|但你不一样！你看到了痕迹，|你会理解的！别推辞！|这些钱你也拿着。我不再需要了。
text.src: To tell you the truth, my recent research ruined my reputation. My former colleagues stopped to take me seriously. But you are different! You saw the traces, you will understand! Do not object! You may take this money as well. I won’t need it anymore.

text.cn: 好吧。给我吧。还有……祝你好运。
text.src: All right. Give it to me. And... Good luck.

text.cn: 周围发生了可怕的事情。
text.src: Something terrible is happening around here.

text.cn: 恶魔糟蹋了我们的田地。|我们没法再收割了。
text.src: Demons spoilt our fields. We cannot harvest anymore.

text.cn: 一天晚上我们看到田地上|方有恶魔之火。第二天早上，|我们在那里发现了邪恶的标记。
