text.src: One night we saw devilish fires over the fields. Next morning, we found there the mark of evil.

text.cn: 什么让你害怕？
text.src: What scares you?

text.cn: 到底发生了什么？
text.src: What exactly happened?

text.cn: 我会去那里查看这些标记。
text.src: I will go there and examine these marks.

text.cn: 太诡异了。我得离开这里！
text.src: It is too strange to me. I gotta get out of here!

text.cn: 我在古罗马竞技场开设战斗竞技场。|世界各地最强的战士都会在那里|战斗！问题是没人知道我们。|一点宣传会很有帮助。|你能去附近的城镇告诉人们吗？
text.src: I am opening a battle arena at the ancient Colosseum. Best warriors from all over the world will fight there! The trouble is that nobody knows about us. A little publicity would help us much. Could you visit local towns and tell people about it?

text.cn: 也许有点意思。
text.src: Well, it may be interesting.

text.cn: 现在不行。
text.src: Not right now.

text.cn: 你帮了大忙！这是你的报酬。|现在我们需要人来展示真正的战斗。|你愿意再帮我们一次吗？|进入竞技场赢一场就行！
text.src: You were of a great help! Here’s your reward. Now we need somebody to show the real fight. Will you agree to help us one more time? Just enter the arena and win!

text.cn: 不！太麻烦了！
text.src: No! Too much trouble!

text.cn: 我会让你的生意兴隆。
text.src: I will bring your business to the prosperity.

text.cn: 那场打斗太精彩了！|这是你的报酬，老规矩。|你为竞技场做了很多。|我决定让你入股。|只要10000你就成为我的合|伙人。这可是难得的机会！|你会得到一半利润。
text.src: That was a hell of a fight! Here’s your reward, as usual. You made a lot for the Colosseum. I made up my mind to share my business with you. For a mere 10’000 you will become my companion. It is a rare occasion! You’ll be receiving half of its profit.

text.cn: 一大笔钱。我得考虑一下。
text.src: It is a large sum. I have to think it over.

text.cn: 那你同意付10000吗？
text.src: So, do you agree to pay 10'000?

text.cn: 好的，给你钱。
text.src: Yes, here’s the money.

text.cn: 不，我还没那么多钱
text.src: No, I am not that rich yet

text.cn: 嘿伙计！我欠你的。|上次见面你救了我的生意。|来，这是你的那份利润。
text.src: Howdy man! I owe you some. Last time we met you saved my business. Here, that’s your part of the profit.

text.cn: 跟你做生意很高兴。
text.src: It was nice having business with you.

text.cn: 没见过你。你找我们有什么事？
text.src: I haven't seen you around. What do you need from us?

text.cn: 我找本·斯罗特尔。
text.src: I look for Ben Throttle.

text.cn: 那到底是谁？
text.src: Who the heck is that?

text.cn: 一个简单的问题。干嘛这么粗鲁？
text.src: It was a simple question. Why being rude?

text.cn: 抱歉，今天不顺。|你那个本是干什么的？
text.src: Sorry, I had a hard day. What does this Ben of yours do?

text.cn: 他是个探险家。
text.src: He is an Explorer.

text.cn: 明白了。你是那些怪人之一。
text.src: I see. You are one of the weirdos.

text.cn: 什么？
text.src: Sorry?

text.cn: 别装傻。谁都知道探险家跟魔|鬼有来往！所以他们才住在远|离人群的地方。
text.src: Don't play fool. Everybody knows that the Explorers consort with the devil! That's why they live far from other people.

text.cn: 你知道去哪找，对吧？
text.src: You know where to find one, don't you?

text.cn: 不知道。不过听说附近住着个女巫。|如果你不珍惜灵魂的话，|她也许能给你指路！
text.src: No, I do not. However, I heard a witch lives in the neighborhood. She may show the way, if you do not treasure your soul!

text.cn: 谢谢！你管好你自己的灵魂吧。
text.src: Thanks! You'd better care about yours.

text.cn: 谢谢你，伙计！劫匪疯了，|我们好几周没法送这批货了。
text.src: Thank you, man! The raiders gone mad, we couldn't deliver this cargo for weeks.

text.cn: 很容易。
text.src: That was easy.

text.cn: 卸完货了。准备出发。|准备好了告诉我们。
text.src: We got unloaded. So we are about to set off. Tell us, when you are ready.

text.cn: 等一下，我得休息一下给车加油。
text.src: Wail a minute, I got to take a rest and refuel my car.

text.cn: 现在就走。
text.src: Let's go right now.

text.cn: 准备好了吗？
text.src: Are you ready now?

text.cn: 滚开，无知的农民！|这不是你待的地方。
text.src: Get out of here, ignorant farmer! It is not a place for your kin.

text.cn: 你帮了我们一个忙，|现在可以要报酬了。
text.src: You made us a favor, now you can ask for a reward.

text.cn: 听说本·斯罗特尔住在附近。|我能跟他谈谈吗？
text.src: I was told Ben Throttle lives nearby. Can I talk to him?

text.cn: 你说得对。他的房子在南边。|我在你地图上标出来。
text.src: You are right. His house is to the south from here. Let me mark it on your map.

text.cn: 终于，我要知道我是谁了。
text.src: Finally, I will learn who I really am.

text.cn: 你需要什么？
text.src: What do you need?

text.cn: 我在找一个女孩。|她叫爱丽丝。你知道她现在在哪吗？
text.src: I am looking for a girl. Her name is Alice.Do you happen to know where she is now?

text.cn: 爱丽丝来过，但几个小时前|去了波尔图。
text.src: Alice was here, but she left for Porto several hours ago.

text.cn: 谢谢，我会继续找。
text.src: Thanks, I will keep searching.

text.cn: 怎么了？
text.src: What's wrong?

text.cn: 你怎么敢问？看看你自己。|我们镇是这个被上帝遗弃的世|界里最后的文明堡垒。|我不会允许任何农民弄|坏我们博物馆里的珍贵展品！|滚开，下等人。
text.src: How dare you ask? Look at yourself. Our town is the last resort of civilization in this God forsaken world.  And I will allow no farmer to break any of the priceless exhibits we have there, in the museum! Go away, low life.

text.cn: 我以为博物馆是对公众开放的。|对陌生人这种态度，|你怎么好意思自称文明？
text.src: I was expecting the museum to be open for public. How can you call yourself civilized with such an attitude toward strangers?

text.cn: 嗯，抱歉，陌生人……你说得对。|我刚才有点过分。|让我道歉并提出一个交易。|你似乎正是我们执行危险任|务所需要的人。帮我们，|我们就合作。
text.src: Hem, sorry, stranger... You are right. I was a bit harsh. Let me apologize and offer you a deal. You seem to be the very man we need for a dangerous mission. Help us, and we will cooperate.

text.cn: 你们都疯了。为什么不能直|接回答我的问题？|好吧，说说你们那个'任务'。
text.src: You are all crazy. Why can't you just answer my question? All right, tell me of that 'mission' of yours.

text.cn: 最近路不太平。确保我们商|队安全往返波尔图。|如果同意，去找我们的管家。
text.src: The roads became dangerous lately. Make sure our caravan gets to Porto and back in safety. If you agree, go speak to our steward.

text.cn: 我来做。
text.src: I'll do it.

text.cn: 伊万，是你吗！？|不敢相信……不，你不是他。|对不起，年轻人，我认错人了……|你找我有什么事？
text.src: Ivan, that's you!? I cannot believe... No, you are not him. Sorry, young man, I mistook you for someone I used to know... What do you need from me?

text.cn: 我继父被杀了，但他勉强说|出了你的名字。这些是我真|正父亲的遗物。他和你一样|是探险家。
text.src: My stepfather was killed, but he managed to spell your name. Here are my real father things. He was an Explorer, like you.

text.cn: 我就知道你终会来的！
text.src: I knew you would finally come!

text.cn: 什么意思？
text.src: What do you mean?

text.cn: 你长得像你父亲。难怪我认错人了。
text.src: You look like your father. Small wonder I mistook you for him.

text.cn: 慢着。解释一下。
text.src: Slow down. Explain yourself.

text.cn: 你想知道自己是谁，来对地方了。|你父亲叫伊万·戈。|他是个伟大的探险家！|他重新发现了无数城镇和发明。
text.src: You came to the right place, if you want to know, who you are. Your father's name is Ivan Go. A great Explorer he was! He rediscovered countless towns and inventions.

text.cn: 你不是认真的吧。
text.src: You cannot be serious.

text.cn: 但我确定。相信我，|你周围的世界都是伊万的功劳。|多年前，我们生活在黑暗中，|没有无线电也没有电。|我们无法与其他聚落联系。|我们恐惧而孤独。|是他带我们走向了光明。
text.src: But I am. Believe me, the world around you is the merit of Ivan. Years ago, we dwelled in darkness with no radio or electricity. There was no way for us to contact with other people settlements. We were scared and lonely. But he led us to the light.

text.cn: 说实话，我从不知道我父|亲有多了不起。我甚至不知|道自己有父亲。除了可怜的彼得……
text.src: Actually, I never knew how great my father was. I didn’t even know I had one. Except for poor Peter...

text.cn: 是时候了解了。
text.src: It’s high time to learn.

text.cn: 对了。他发生了什么？死了吗？
text.src: Right. What happened to him? Is he dead now?

text.cn: 没人知道。他就那样消失了。|当时他是真正的英雄，|没人敢伤害他。而且真|正有那本事的人也不多。|伊万把他的卡车改造成了一个奇迹，|而且很危险。
text.src: Nobody knows. He just disappeared one day. He was a real hero then, so no one would dare to harm him. Besides, there were few who really could. Ivan made a real wonder of his truck, and a dangerous one.

text.cn: 你是说他可能还活着？
text.src: You mean he may still be alive?

text.cn: 我一直希望有人来问这个问题。|是的，我觉得他可能还活着。
text.src: I always hoped someone would come and ask that question. Yes I think he may be alive.

text.cn: 那我必须找到他！|给我指路。你知道他失|踪的什么线索？
text.src: I have to find him then! Show me the way. What do you know about his disappearance?

text.cn: 在此之前我只有直觉。|但我觉得我认得你那张光盘。
text.src: I had no clues but my gut feeling until now. But I think I recognize that disk of yours.

text.cn: 不就是块塑料吗。能帮我们什么？
text.src: It is just a piece of plastic. How can it help us?

text.cn: 远不止如此！这张光盘是一本书，|运气好的话，是伊万的日记！|不幸的是，几乎没办法读它……|除非……对了！去米宁你父|亲的房子。在那里你应该能|找到读取设备。我留在这里|做些研究。
text.src: It is much more than that! The disk is a book, and with any luck, it is Ivan’s diary! Unfortunately, there is almost no way one can read it... Except may be... Yes! Go to your father’s house in Minin. There you must find the machine that reads. I will stay here and make some researches of mine.

text.cn: 谢谢指路。我会查清楚的。
text.src: Thanks for the guidance. I’ll find everything out.

text.cn: 你好，年轻人。
text.src: Greetings, young man.

text.cn: 你是本·斯罗特尔吗？|我在找一样你也许了解的东西。|是一张塑料光盘，|其中一面可能有I G和2的标记。
text.src: Are you Ben Throttle? I’m looking for a thing you might know something about. It’s a plastic disc and it may have symbols I G and 2 on one of its sides.

text.cn: 让我想想。确实有人向我兜|售过你描述的那种光盘。|我告诉他米德加德的人可|能对那东西感兴趣。
text.src: Let me think. Somebody did offer me to buy a disc like the one you described. I told him people in Midgard might be interested in that sort of thing.

text.cn: 我本来希望你有……|不管怎样，谢谢提示。
text.src: I was hoping you have it... Thanks for a hint, anyway.

text.cn: 你没忘记老头子！|真高兴又能见到你！
text.src: You haven’t forgotten the old man! I’m so glad to see you again!

text.cn: 我想知道伊万·戈在旅途中|是否见过飞行船。|他有没有跟你提过？
text.src: I wonder if Ivan Go saw flying ships in his travels. Did he tell you anything about them, by any chance?

text.cn: 他确实说过。我们以前常|坐在草地上交换故事。|他会跟我讲天上的光、|闪亮的光盘之类的废话。|他提到过塞尔，然后我跟他说……
text.src: He did, in fact. We used to sit on the grass and swap stories. He would tell me about the lights in the sky, the shining discs and that sort of rubbish. He mentioned Seil, and I told him...

text.cn: 是塞尔！我很想听完你的故事，|但我真的该走了。
text.src: Seil it was! I’d love to hear the end of your story, but I really need to be going now.

text.cn: 但这真的很重要！|既然你提到了，我想起了一个传说，
text.src: But it is really important! Now that you mentioned it, I remembered one legend,

text.cn: 旅途中我见多了。|你吓不到我。我有非常重|要的事情要办。
text.src: I saw a lot during my travels. You cannot surprise me. I have a matter of utmost importance to attend to.

text.cn: 等等。这正是我要你读的原因。|我觉得你可能比任何人都更能|理解它。比我更懂……|求你了，读吧。
text.src: Wait. That’s exactly why I want you to read it. I have a feeling that you may understand it better than anyone else. Better than me... please, read it.

text.cn: 好吧……给我吧。
text.src: Oh well... Give it to me.

text.cn: 什么？你在跟我说话？
text.src: What? Are you talking to me?

text.cn: 你知道哪里能找到一个叫爱|丽丝的女孩吗？
text.src: Don't you know where I can find a girl named Alice?

text.cn: 没有，丽莎从没来过这里。|也许她在路上被劫匪袭击了。|他们的巢穴就在海边
text.src: No, Lisa never came here. Probably she was attacked by raiders on her way here. Their hide-out is at the seashore

text.cn: 我去查查。
text.src: I'll go check this out.

text.cn: 所以他们派你来护送商队……|你看起来不怎么壮，不过无所谓。
text.src: So, the sent you to protect the caravan... You don’t look tough, but who cares.

text.cn: 等你看我出手就知道了。
text.src: Wait, till you see me in business.

text.cn: 好的。我在你地图上标出目的地。|路上要小心。有几处适合伏|击的地方。清楚了吗？
text.src: Ok. I'll mark the destination point on your map. You have to be careful on your road there. There are a couple of good places for an ambush. Am I clear?

text.cn: 从来没有这么准备好过。|什么时候出发？
text.src: More than ever. When are we setting out?

text.cn: 如果你准备好了就现在出发。|但也可以等你做最后的调整。
text.src: Right now, if you are ready. But we can wait for you to make some last adjustments.

text.cn: 我有几件事要办。等等我。
text.src: I have a couple of things to do. Wait for me.

text.cn: 我准备好了。
text.src: I am ready to go.

text.cn: 准备好了吗？
text.src: Are you ready now?

text.cn: 谁在那里？我没等人来。
text.src: Who's there? I do not expect anyone.

text.cn: 你是那个女巫吗？
text.src: Are you the witch?

text.cn: 真没礼貌，年轻人。|你总是别人说什么就信什么？
text.src: How rude of you, young man. Do you always believe in what people say?

text.cn: 抱歉，我没有冒犯之意……|我找本·斯罗特尔，他……
text.src: Sorry, I meant no offence... I look for Ben Throttle, he ...

text.cn: 不介意。据我所知，|本住在米德加德附近。|去那里问问吧。还有，学着礼貌点。
text.src: No offence taken. As much as I know, Ben lives somewhere around Midgard. Ask there. And learn to be more polite.

text.cn: 谢谢。你帮了大忙。
text.src: Thank you. You were of a great help.

text.cn: 你好。
text.src: Good day.

text.cn: 我需要按这张图纸升级我的卡车。
text.src: I need to upgrade my truck according to this scheme.

text.cn: 让我看看……啊……不行，做不了。
text.src: Let me take a look... aha... No, it’s not going to work out.

text.cn: 为什么？图纸不清楚吗？
text.src: But why? The scheme is non clear?

text.cn: 不，图纸没问题。|但做这种活需要的工具非常昂贵。
text.src: No it is ok. But, the instruments I’m going to need for that kind of work are very expensive.

text.cn: 钱不是问题。
text.src: Money is not a problem.

text.cn: 另外，我们还需要一种稀有材料——|复合合金，现在已经不生产了。|不过也许能从古代工艺品中获取。
text.src: Besides, we’ll need a rare material – composite alloy, which is not produced anymore. Hopefully, it is possible to obtain if from ancient artifacts.

text.cn: 去哪找？
text.src: Where can I find it?

text.cn: 你应该在古代机械中找找。
text.src: You should look in the ancient machinery.

text.cn: 我想知道哪里能找到这种东西。|你知道我需要什么样的机械吗？
text.src: I wonder where I can get such a thing. Any idea, what kind of machinery do I need?

text.cn: 你会通过泛蓝的光泽认出它。|事实上，竞技场的战士经常|放旧工艺品进去。|可能正是你需要的。|记住带15000现金作为工钱。
text.src: You’ll recognize it by a bluish tint. In fact, warriors in the Colosseum often put old artifacts in. It might just be what you need. And remember to bring me 15,000 cash for the work.

text.cn: 好。至少我知道去哪找了。
text.src: Sure. At least I know where to look now.

text.cn: 如果你还想升级卡车，|把复合合金和15000现金带来。
text.src: If you still want to upgrade your truck, bring me the composite alloy and 15,000 cash.

text.cn: 是的，我记得。
text.src: Yes, I remember that.

text.cn: 我把钱和合金带来了。
text.src: I brought you the money and the alloy.

text.cn: 看看这个！够升级一整排车了！|如果你让我留下剩下的材料，|我只要10000就行。
text.src: Look at that! It’s going to be enough to upgrade a whole bunch of cars! I’m ready to work for only 10,000 if you let me keep the rest of the material.

text.cn: 好了。
text.src: There you are.

text.cn: 要花几个小时。在这里等。
text.src: It’s going to take a couple of hours. Wait here.

text.cn: 好吧。
text.src: All right.

text.cn: 看看吧！
text.src: Check it out!

text.cn: 现在终于能看到沙漠那边是什么了。
text.src: Now I can finally see what lies beyond the desert.

text.cn: 怎么样，勇士？准备好战|斗和胜利了吗？
text.src: What’s up, brave guy? Ready to fight and win?

text.cn: 也许吧，如果报酬够好的话。|你有复合合金做的工艺品吗？
text.src: I might, if the reward is good enough. Have you got any artifacts made of composite alloy?

text.cn: 让我想想……我车里有一个。|你赢了就归你。但这是死斗。|赢家通吃。成交？
text.src: Let me think… I’ve got one in my truck. You can have it if you win. But it’s going to be a death-match. The winner takes it all. Deal?

text.cn: 成交。
text.src: Deal.

text.cn: 怎么？准备好在竞技场跟我打了？
text.src: What is it? Ready to fight me on the Arena?

text.cn: 只要报酬值得就行。|你有复合合金吗？
text.src: I am, as long as the reward is worth fighting for. Have you got composite alloy?

text.cn: 如果你只在乎报酬，|那就不算真正的战士。|去问那位女战士。|她赢过很多场战斗，|也许有你需要的东西。
text.src: You aren’t a true warrior, if it’s only the reward you are interested in. Go ask the lady warrior. She’s won a lot of battles; she may have the thing you need.

text.cn: 谢谢。
text.src: Thanks.

text.cn: 你想干什么？我很忙！
text.src: What do you want? I'm busy!

text.cn: 最近有人向你兜售过一种光|盘形状的奇怪东西吗？
text.src: Has anybody offered you to buy a strange-looking object in a form of a disc lately?

text.cn: 确实有人来兜售过你描|述的那种东西。但我们不感兴趣，|他就继续往北走了。
text.src: In fact, somebody did offer to buy the kind of object you described. But we weren’t interested, so he went on, to the north.

text.cn: 往北，你说……谢谢信息。
text.src: To the north, you say… Thanks for the information.

text.cn: 你有卡车吗？
text.src: Do you have a truck?

text.cn: 太好了！我们正要惩罚侵|扰我们土地的劫匪，|需要所有高手帮忙。你来吗？
text.src: Great! We are about to punish raiders, who infests our land, and we need every hotshot to help us. Are you with us?

text.cn: 是的，重装甲的！
text.src: Yes, a heavily armored one!

text.cn: 干吧！
text.src: Let’s rock!

text.cn: 不，你自己干。
text.src: No, do it yourself.

text.cn: 年轻人，能请你帮我一个小忙吗。
text.src: Young man, could you please do me a small favor.

text.cn: 我有一份给谢尔戈的重要商业提案，|但没想到今天能见到他，|所以把必要的文件都留在家里了。
text.src: I have an important business offer to Sergo, but I didn’t expect to see him today so I left all necessary papers at home.

text.cn: 请尽快带我去加油站，|好让我收集所有文件向谢尔|戈提出方案。你不用等我；|我可以搭邻居的车。
text.src: Please bring me to the filling station as fast as possible, so that I could collect all documents and make an offer to Sergo. You will not have to wait for me; I can find a car at my neighbors.

text.cn: 看情况……我在听。
text.src: It depends… I’m listening.

text.cn: 你到底要我做什么？
text.src: What exactly do you need from me?

text.cn: 上车，带路。
text.src: Get in, lead the way.

text.cn: 不，太远了。我父亲在家等我。
text.src: No, that’s just too far. My father is waiting for me at home.

text.cn: 你毁了我一生中最重要的交易！|滚开！
text.src: You have spoiled the most important deal in my life! Go away!

text.cn: 冷静点，伙计……
text.src: Easy, man...

text.cn: 你可以开快点。我赶时间！
text.src: You could drive faster. I am in a hurry!

text.cn: 付钱然后下车。
text.src: Just pay and get out of my car.

text.cn: 我会找个更灵活的司机带我回索斯。
text.src: I’ll find a more agile driver to bring me back to Sowth.

text.cn: 你真是个粗人！
text.src: Man, you’re such a boor!

text.cn: 看来是同路人。只要99金币，|我就能告诉你古代医院的位置。|里面可能有很多好东西！
text.src: A fellow traveler I see. For a mere 99 coins, I could show you the location of ancient hospital. It probably contains tons of useful stuff!

text.cn: 我才不把钱浪费在那上面。
text.src: I won’t waste my money on that.

text.cn: 说吧，给你钱！
text.src: Talk, here’s the money!

text.cn: 我是个老兵。以前人们听到我的名|字就发抖。那都是过去的事了……|我现在坐在这里靠讲故事挣钱。|短故事10金币一个。
text.src: I’m an old soldier. People would shudder at the sound of my name. It’s all in the past now... I’m sitting here and tell stories for money. It’s 10 coins for a short one.

text.cn: 不
text.src: No

text.cn: 试试吧。
text.src: Let’s give it a try.

text.cn: 注意你的油表，伙计。|如果在荒郊野外没油了，你会死的！
text.src: Watch your truck fuel level, pal. If you stop in the middle of nowhere, you’ll die!

text.cn: 骗子，我早就知道了！
text.src: Cheater, I knew it already!

text.cn: 还要更多指导？好吧，15金币！
text.src: Want some more guidance? Well, it’s 15 coins!

text.cn: 不用了！
text.src: No thanks!

text.cn: 什么15？！给你。
text.src: What 15?! Here you are.

text.cn: 记住！被敌方车辆包围时——|别停下！疯狂移动让他们打不中你。
text.src: Remember! When you’re surrounded by enemy cars – do not stop! Move like a crazy so that they couldn’t hit you.

text.cn: 嗯，有意思……
text.src: Hem, interesting...

text.cn: 又是你？你倒是真好奇。|想多听就给20金币。
text.src: You again? You are curious indeed. Hand over 20 coins if you want to know more.

text.cn: 不！
text.src: No!

text.cn: 拿着……
text.src: Take it...

text.cn: 想开快就走在路上。|泥地和沙地会让你慢很多。
text.src: If you want to drive fast – keep your truck on the road. Dirt and sand will slow you greatly.

text.cn: 我会考虑的。
text.src: I’ll consider this.

text.cn: 你似乎喜欢我的故事。|下一条25金币。
text.src: You seem to you like my stories. Next one is 25 coins.

text.cn: 浪费钱。
text.src: It’s a waste of money.

text.cn: 你真是个有趣的人。
text.src: You are truly interesting person.

text.cn: 当地的农民一点也不懂做生意。|你可以轻松买到便宜货，|然后以双倍价格卖给他们邻居！
text.src: Local farmers do not understand a thing in the commerce.  You can easily buy cheap goods and sell them at a double price to their neighbors!

text.cn: 谢谢建议。
text.src: Thanks for the advice.

text.cn: 你需要什么？你已经是大|人了不需要建议！|好吧，给我30金币。|最后一次帮你。
text.src: What do you need from me? You are adult enough to do without advices! All right, give me 30 coins. It’s the last time I help you.

text.cn: 我确实不需要建议。
text.src: I can do well without advices indeed.

text.cn: 给你钱。
text.src: Here’s the money.

text.cn: 仔细听着，小子。|你在这个破酒吧跟我浪费时间。|你要是聪明一点，|早就挣够钱买辆好卡车去探险了。|好吧，给你个建议：|去找个植物学家，证明你不是懒汉。
text.src: Listen carefully, boy. You waste you time talking with me in this dirty bar. If you were a little bit cleverer, you’d already earn enough money to buy a better truck and went exploring. Well, to the advice: find a botanist and prove that you are not a loafer after all.

text.cn: 你帮了大忙。
text.src: You were of a great help.

text.cn: 你好，旅行者！我整天坐这里|种植物。最近它们病了。|需要治疗并放进新温室。|请帮我找些药来，|好救救我心爱的植物！|附近有个旧医院。|作为报酬，你可以得到我挖|地时发现的旧武器。
text.src: Greetings, traveler! I sit here all day cultivating plants. They grew ill lately. They need to be cured and placed in a new greenhouse.  Please bring me some medicine and so that I could save my beloved plants! There was an old hospital nearby. As a reward you’ll get old weaponry I found while digging around.

text.cn: 我尽力找到你需要的东西！
text.src: I’ll try to find what you need!

text.cn: 我车里有药品。
text.src: I’ve got some medicine in the trunk.

text.cn: 跟我无关。
text.src: It doesn’t concern me.

text.cn: 你找到了吗？
text.src: Have you found it?

text.cn: 不。
text.src: No.

text.cn: 看看谁在那。希望你有生|意上的提议。
text.src: Look who’s there. I hope you’ve got some business proposal.

text.cn: 是的，我是谢尔戈。|你一定是彼得的儿子。|你长大了，自从上次见你。
text.src: Yes, I am Sergo. And you must be Peter’s son. You’ve grown up since I last saw you.

text.cn: 让我看看你的货。| 嗯，我出100金币。同意吗？
text.src: Let us take a look at your merchandise.| Well, I'll give you 100 coins. Do you agree?

text.cn: 你好，先生。您是谢尔戈吗？|我从格卢霍耶给您带了包裹。
text.src: Good day, Sir. Arent you Sergo by chance? I brought you a package from Glukhoe.

text.cn: 这是我第一次跑。谈谈生意？
text.src: That’s my first trip. Shall we talk business?

text.cn: 可以。正是父亲说的。
text.src: That’ll do. Exactly what the father told me.

text.cn: 好货，一如既往。
text.src: Good merchandise, as usual.

text.cn: 很高兴听到这个。
text.src: I'm glad to hear it.

text.cn: 去吧，孩子。让我为你骄傲。
text.src: Go, son. Make me proud of you.

text.cn: 我马上回来。
text.src: I'll be right back.

text.cn: 希望如此。
text.src: I hope so.

text.cn: 回头见。
text.src: See ya.

text.cn: 想喝点什么吗，年轻人？
text.src: Want something to drink, young man?

text.cn: 当然知道！拿去吧，完好无损。
text.src: Of course I know! Take it, it is in perfect state.

text.cn: 索斯的酒保派我来取东西。|你知道什么意思。
text.src: The barman of Sowth sent me to get something from you. You know what I mean.

text.cn: 你后备箱没地方了，|我放在你车旁边的箱子里。
text.src: There's no room in your trunk, so I'll leave it in a box by your car.

text.cn: 太感谢了。现在我要去追杀|费利克斯！
text.src: Thanks a lot. Now I will hunt Felix down!

text.cn: 太感谢了。现在我要去追杀|费利克斯！
text.src: Thanks a lot. Now I will hunt Felix down!

text.cn: 你不是从格卢霍耶来的吗？
text.src: Aren't you from Glukhoe?

text.cn: 我们已经知道了，向你致哀。|我们生活在一个危险的世界，|年轻人。
text.src: We already know and we condole with you. We live in a dangerous world, young man.

text.cn: 没听说过他……去埃泰尔纳试试，|很多商人去那里。|你能从他们那里打听到消息。|不过你找这个人干什么？
text.src: Never heard of him... Try Aeterna, many traders visit it. You can learn something from them.  But what do you need from this man?

text.cn: 有人袭击了那里，所有人都死了！|我父亲……
text.src: Someone attacked it, everybody is dead! My father...

text.cn: 我能搞定。你听说过探险家|本·斯罗特尔吗？
text.src: I can handle it. Have you heard about Ben Throttle the Explorer?

text.cn: 他能把我的生活还给我。|再见了，各位。我会想念你们的。
text.src: He can give me my life back. Farewell, people. I will miss you.

text.cn: 怎么了？你看起来很糟。
text.src: What’s wrong? You look awful.

text.cn: 太可怕了！谁干的？|没有帮派经过索斯。|我们会注意到的。
text.src: That's terrible! Who could have done this? No gang passed through Sowth. We would have noticed.

text.cn: 冷静点！他们有足够的实力|消灭村庄的守卫者，杀你轻而易举。
text.src: Calm down! Having enough power to destroy the defenders of the village, they will easily kill you.

text.cn: 我也恨那些劫匪！|但你怎么找到他们？|似乎没有目击者。
text.src: I hate the raiders too! But how can you find them? There seem to be no witness of the crime.

text.cn: 费利克斯是个危险的人……|不过我看你不在乎。|他住在一个防御严密的小村庄里。|简直就是个基地。
text.src: Felix is dangerous man... However, you don't care, as I can see. Well, he resides in a small well-defended village. A base, I would say.

text.cn: 其实我们跟他算是有过停火协议……|我们付钱，他不伤害我们的村民。
text.src: Actually, we had a truce of a kind with him... We pay him and he does not harm our villagers.

text.cn: 但现在你要去攻打他们的老巢！|好吧，我也想除掉这个费利克斯，|所以我会帮你！你需要更好的武器。|去特罗伊茨克找酒保。|他欠我个人情。
text.src: But now you are going to attack their lair! Well, I also want to get rid of this Felix, so I will help you! You gonna need a better weapon. Go to Troitsk and talk to the barman. He owes me something.

text.cn: 格卢霍耶被烧毁了！|所有人都死了……我父亲……
text.src: Glukhoe is burnt down! Everybody is dead... my father...

text.cn: 那他们是走了另一条路！|我必须找到他们为父亲报仇！
text.src: They came another way then! I must find them and avenge my father!

text.cn: 说话之前想清楚！|他们是杀人犯！他们会付出代价！
text.src: Think twice before talking like this! They are murderers! They will pay!

text.cn: 仔细想想，我知道凶手的名字。|只可能是费利克斯！
text.src: Come to think of it, I know the name of the murderer. It can only be Felix!

text.cn: 现在我确定就是他和他那伙人！
text.src: Now I know for sure it was him and his gang!

text.cn: 现在协议已经撕毁了！|我已经在战场上遇到他并赢了！
text.src: Now the treaty is broken! I have already met him on the battlefield and won!

text.cn: 太感谢了！
text.src: Thanks a lot!

text.cn: 有什么好消息吗？
text.src: Well, any good news?

text.cn: 谢谢你除掉了他的团伙。|拿着这些钱作为我们的谢意。|你也可以拿走我的武器。|希望它对你比对我更有用。
text.src: Thank you for relieving us of his gang. Take this money as a sign of our gratitude. You can also leave my weapon. Hope it will serve you better than me.

text.cn: 费利克斯不会再找你麻烦了。|他像狗一样跑了！
text.src: Felix won't trouble you anymore. He ran like a dog!

text.cn: 再见了，好人。我会记|住你的善意的。
text.src: Farewell, good man. I will remember your kindness.

text.cn: 嘿伙计！能请你帮个忙吗？
text.src: Howdy, man! May I ask you a favor?

text.cn: 我在这里有生意，|需要有人带我熟悉这些地方。
text.src: I have a business here and I need someone to show me the way around these lands.

text.cn: 不关你的事。我给的钱足够|让你闭嘴。
text.src: It is none of your concern.  I pay well enough to keep your mouth shut.

text.cn: 谁说的？你来吗？
text.src: Says who? Are you in?

text.cn: 随你便，小子。我想我们还会再|见的。
text.src: As you wish, boy. I think we shall meet again.

text.cn: 你在跟我说话？啊，当然！
text.src: Are you talking to me? Ah, yes of course!

text.cn: 什么生意？
text.src: What kind of business is it?

text.cn: 有猫腻。你一脸贼相。
text.src: I smell fish. You have a look of a criminal on you.

text.cn: 为什么不？我来帮你。
text.src: Why not? I will help you.

text.cn: 我不想和劫匪有任何瓜葛。别管我。
text.src: I do not want to have anything in common with raiders. Leave me be.

text.cn: 再见。
text.src: Bye.

text.cn: 欢迎你，流浪者。
text.src: I welcome you, Vagrant.

text.cn: 抱歉，看来是我认错人了。
text.src: I apologize, it seems as if I was mistaken.

text.cn: 好。
text.src: Yes.

text.cn: 不了。
text.src: No.

text.cn: 我在找活儿干，你这儿有|什么能给我的吗？
text.src: I'm looking for a job, maybe you will find something for me?

text.cn: 我想找份活儿干，|不过只干一小阵子。
text.src: I'm looking for a job but not for long.

text.cn: 附近住着一个惯偷。|要他人头，赏金%3d。|这活儿你接吗？
text.src: In the neighborhood a recidivist thief lives. Reward for his hand is - %3d. Will you take this mission?

text.cn: 有什么活儿吗？
text.src: What is about the work?

text.cn: 这儿有零活儿可干吗？
text.src: What's about part time job here?

text.cn: 有人烧了我们的种子，|还往水井里下毒。|十有八九是敌人的奸细。|干掉他，%3d就归你。干不干？
text.src: Somebody burns out our seeds and poisons water well.The most probably it is enemy spy. Kill him and you will get %3d. Do you agree?

text.cn: 有活儿交给我吗？
text.src: Do you have a job for me?

text.cn: 有任务交给我吗？
text.src: Do you have some mission for me?

text.cn: 城郊有个疯子到处乱窜，|专设埋伏吓唬村民。|他算不上什么狠角色，|可老百姓怨声载道。|干掉他，%3d就归你。|愿意帮忙吗？
text.src: In the outskirts drives one madman, he sets ambushes and frightens villagers. He is not dangerous but people complain. Kill him and you will get %3d. Will you help us?

text.cn: 我想打听打听有什么活儿。
text.src: I would like to know about the job.

text.cn: 我想找份钱多活儿轻的差事。
text.src: I would like to find easy work for good money.

text.cn: 需要把一批研究资料和零件|送到%2n聚落。|货到付款。这趟活儿给%3d，|报酬不算少。这趟货你接吗？
text.src: It is necessary to take some research data and pieces to settlement %2n. You will be paid at the place. %3d is not bad money for this mission. Will you deliver this cargo?

text.cn: 听说在这儿能找到活儿干？
text.src: I was said to be able to get a job here?

text.cn: 听说手脚麻利的人在这儿能|找到活儿干。
text.src: An acute and fast man is said to be able to find a job here.

text.cn: 我们有个包裹要送到%2n聚落。|你顺路的时候捎过去就行，|不急着要。送到付你%3d。|能指望你吗？
text.src: We have a package for the settlemen %2n. Deliver it when you will go by this settlement. It is not an urgent case. You will be paid %3d. Can I reckon on you?

text.cn: 这包裹就是该交给你的吧？
text.src: Is it you whom I have to deliver this package?

text.cn: 对，就是这个。东西都齐了？
text.src: Yes, here. Is everything in its place?

text.cn: 这儿能找点活儿干吗？
text.src: Maybe I can find some work here?

text.cn: 我缺钱，什么活儿都接。
text.src: I need money, so I can take any mission you give me.

text.cn: 好吧。一个人赶路太危险，|正好我有个朋友要去%2n。|护送他一程，到了地方付你%3d。|去吗？
text.src: Ok. It is very dangerous to drive alone but one of my friends need go to %2n. Escort him and you will be paid %3d at arrival. Will you go?

text.cn: 有什么活儿能给我介绍介绍吗？
text.src: Can you tell me anything about a job?

text.cn: 有什么零活儿能给我介绍介绍吗？
text.src: Can you tell me anything about part time missions?

text.cn: 这儿有位老兄跟邻城做买卖，|常要送样品过去。|护送他去%2n，|顺便盯紧身后的尾巴。|哦对了！报酬是%3d。|准备护送了吗？
text.src: Here one man trades with the neighboring city and carries there commodity samples. Escort him to %2n and trace for the tailers. Oh, yeah! The reward is %3d. Are you ready to escort him?

text.cn: 我缺钱。这城里有什么活|儿的门路吗？
text.src: I need money. What is heard about the job in this city?

text.cn: 有什么新鲜事儿吗？
text.src: What's the news?

text.cn: 总体上没什么新鲜的。|这些天一直风平浪静。
text.src: In general there is nothing new. Everything is quiet for many days.

text.cn: 行，回见。
text.src: Ok, see you next time.

text.cn: 我遇到麻烦了，我跟%2b|NNN起了过节
text.src: I have a problem, I have differences with with group %2bNNN

text.cn: 我看你把%2b惹毛了才被他们当|成敌人NNN我有几个熟人，|只要你肯出身上财产的百分|之%3d，我就能去跟市政|会的人打声招呼。你带钱了吗？
text.src: I think you have tried a lot that %2b declared you its enemyNNN I have some friends and for %3d percent of your money I can talk to people from the city council. Do you have money about you?

text.cn: 我需要帮忙。我和%2b有个|问题始终谈不拢，眼下NNN
text.src: I need help. %2b and I can't reach an agreement on one question and nowNNN

text.cn: 我知道%2b不想跟你打交道。|只需一点小小的辛苦费——|你财产的百分之%3d——|我就能帮你在他们中间把威|信立起来。钱备好了吗？
text.src: I know that %2b don't want to deal with you. For a modest reward %3d percent of your money I can help you to acquire authority among them. Have you prepared the money?

text.cn: 我看这儿该有活儿干。
text.src: I think that somebody has offered a job here.

text.cn: 我看这儿有轻松的活儿干吧？
text.src: I think, somebody has offered a soft job here?

text.cn: 土匪狩猎季开张了。|每干掉一辆车奖励%3d。|赏金等赛季结束一并结清。|要给你登记吗？
text.src: Hunting season for bandits is declared. Every destroyed vehicle will bring you %3d. All money will be given to you after the end of the season. Should I register you?

text.cn: 我看这么大的城，|总该有我的活儿吧？
text.src: I think in this big city there is some job for me?

text.cn: 我看这么大的城，|总该有赚头不错的活儿吧？
text.src: I think in this big city there is some profitable job for me?

text.cn: 土匪简直无法无天了！|他们闯进我们的地盘，|还把手伸进我们的仓库。|得好好教训他们一顿。|杀几个立立威，杀鸡儆猴。|注意抓紧时间，每干掉一个|得%3d。敢接吗？
text.src: Bandits have lost all the shame! They invade our territory and come into our stocks. It need teach them a good lesson. Kill a couple of them to terrify them. Keep the time and you will get %3d for every one of them. Will you take risks?

text.cn: 你这儿是不是有点那个……|你懂我什么意思吧？！
text.src: Maybe you have something... Do you understand what I mean?!

text.cn: 行，小点声。这有个包裹。|我想你看得出来，|这是上等货色的走私品。|卖你%3d，不过你能转手|卖出高得多的价……|前提是你能活着。买吗？
text.src: Ok, quiet. Here is a package. I think you have realized that they are smuggled goods of premium quality. It costs %3d, but you can sell it far more expensive... if you stay alive. Will you buy it?

text.cn: 呃……给我留着，我这就回去取钱。
给我吧，我知道上哪儿出手。
text.src: Give it to me I'll find where to sell it.

text.cn: 我想把一个包裹卖给识货的人。
text.src: I would like to sell to some serious people one package.

text.cn: 小点声，别招来不必要的注意。|你想卖多少？
text.src: Keep quiet, you will attract superfluous attention. How much do you want for it?

text.cn: 我原价出，不赚你一分。
text.src: I sell it with no benefit for myself.

text.cn: 这单生意，多少得让我赚一点吧。
text.src: Maybe I can somehow make money on this deal.

text.cn: 我卖双倍价。
text.src: I sell it for dual price.

text.cn: 行，我收了！这是你应得的%3d！
text.src: Ok, I'll take it! Here is your well-deserved %3d!

text.cn: 什么？！你还敢要价？！|听着，这货我要白拿！|再多说一句，我就告诉卫|兵你在这儿卖的什么玩意儿。|滚远点。
text.src: What?! How much do you want?! Listen to me, I will take it for no money! Say a word and I will tell the guards what you sell here. Get away from here.

text.cn: 回见。
text.src: Goodbye.

text.cn: 我只对埋在这个地区的各种|古物感兴趣。
text.src: I'm only interested in different ancient artifacts hidden in this region.

text.cn: 我这儿有条消息卖给你。|我不想惹麻烦，城里还有买卖要做。|我车上也没装寻宝探测器。|依我看，这附近有个地方值|得探一探。我可以帮你在地|图上标出来——当然，|前提是你想要。
text.src: I have some information for you. I don't need troubles I have business in the city. I don't have treasure detector in my vehicle. I think you need explore one place here. I can mark it on the map, if you want, of course.

value.src: Scope sight with brighten optics and antiglare protection

value.cn: 涡流场发生器式磁力弹射器
value.src: Magnetic catapult on the base of curling field generator
Rolled armored plates with additional cementation

value.cn: 运动芯片（占用部分油箱）
value.src: Sport chip occupies the part of fuel tank

value.cn: 双重芯片（占用部分油箱）
value.src: Double chip occupies the part of fuel tank

value.cn: 三重芯片（占用部分油箱）
value.src: Triple chip occupies the part of fuel tank
Nuclear warhead with double electronic navigation

value.cn: 四重芯片（占用部分油箱）
value.src: Quadra chip occupies the part of fuel tank

fullDiz.cn: %1n城里有人请我护送一|辆车去%2n城，报酬%3d。
fullDiz.src: In the city %1n people asked to escort vehicle to city %2n for %3d.

fullDiz.cn: %1n镇的一位居民请我沿|途保护他的车前往%2n城，|答应付我%3d。
fullDiz.src: Citizen of town %1n asked me to defend his car during the road to city %2n and promised to pay %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 需要护送一支运输队从%1n|聚落前往%2n城。|一切顺利的话，我能拿到%3d。
fullDiz.src: It is necessary to convoy transport from human settlement %1n to the ciyu %2n. If everything is going to be allright I will get %3d.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城的商人要沿商|路前往%2n聚落。|落单的司机常遭袭击，|于是我答应护送他，|换取不算丰厚的报酬%3d。
fullDiz.src: Merchant from city %1n goes along trading route in settlement %2n. Lonely drivers are often attacked so I agree to protect him for modest reward %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 在%1n城，我答应干掉一个敌人，|换取报酬%3d。
fullDiz.src: In city %1n I have agreed to kill enemy for reward %3d.

fullDiz.cn: %1n聚落的居民经常|遭到一个狡猾土匪的袭扰。|我会帮他们除掉这个祸害，|报酬%3d。
fullDiz.src: Dwellers from settlement %1n are frequently attacked by cunning bandit. I will help them to get rid of him for %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 帮%1n城除掉一个恶棍后，|我将得到%3d。
fullDiz.src: I will get %3d when I free city %1n from one scoundrel.

fullDiz.cn: 在%1n城，一颗土匪的人|头能换%3d。
fullDiz.src: In city %3d one may get %1n for the head of one bandit.

briefDiz.cn: 找到愿意收购走私货的买主。
briefDiz.src: Find people who wish to purchase the smuggled goods.

fullDiz.cn: 我车上装满了走私货。|得随便找座城把它出手了。
fullDiz.src: My car is full of smuggled goods. It needs to sell them in any city.

fullDiz.cn: 当地酒吧里肯定有人乐意收|购我的违禁货。
fullDiz.src: In local bar surely there is a man who are ready to purchase my illegal goods.

fullDiz.cn: 趁没人知道我车上藏了什么，|得尽快随便找座城把货出手。
fullDiz.src: Until nobody knows that I hid in my vehicle it needs to be sold to as soon as possible in any city.

fullDiz.cn: 我得找一座城，把货卖出最|大的利润。
fullDiz.src: I need find city where I can sell goods with maximum profit.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城出赏金：|在该地区每击杀一名土匪，|我就能领%3d。
fullDiz.src: City %1n will pay me for evet one killed bandit in region %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 土匪已经无耻到了极点！|得给他们点颜色瞧瞧。|更何况%1n城还会为我在该|地区每击杀一名土匪支付%3d。
fullDiz.src: Bandits have lost any shame! It needs totaech them good lesson. The more especially that city %1n will pay you for every killed bandit in region %3d.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城当局为道路安全大动干戈，|祭出的头号手段就是肃清行动。|在指定区域内每摧毁一辆敌方车辆，|可获得%3d。
fullDiz.src: Authority of city %1n cross swords for road security. As a main event there is Mop-up operation. Destruction of every enemy vehicle in pointed area will bring %3d.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城正在严打犯罪。|在该区域内每击杀一名土匪，|我就能得到%3d。
fullDiz.src: In city %1n seriously fight with crime. For every killed bandit in this area I will get %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 只要付出我财产中不大的一个|百分比，%2b就肯跟我讲和。
fullDiz.src: For moderate percent of my money group %2b are ready to make peace with me.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城托我把一些研究资|料和零件送到%2n聚落。|到达后我将获得%3d。
fullDiz.src: City %1n ask me take some research pieces in settlement %2n. On arrival I will get %3d.

fullDiz.cn: 把包裹送到%2n后，|我将获得%3d。|收货的人正等着呢，|不过看在这笔钱的份上，|我不用赶得太急。
fullDiz.src: I will get %3d when I deliver package %2n. They are waiting for it but for this kind of money I'm not going to be pressed for time.

fullDiz.cn: %1n城有个家伙愿意付%3d，|让我替他把最好的东西|捎给住在%2n聚落的朋友。
fullDiz.src: One fellow from city %1n is ready to pay %3d if I send his's best to a friend who lives in settlement %2n.

fullDiz.cn: 为了%3d的报酬，|我得把%1n发来的信件邮|件送到%2n聚落。
fullDiz.src: For reward %3d  I have to deliver mail with letters from %1n to settlement %2n.

fullDiz.cn: 参照点附近可能埋着值钱的古物。|没有寻宝探测器，这活儿干不成。
fullDiz.src: Near the reference point one may find valuable artifact. You can't accomplish this task without treasure detector.

fullDiz.cn: 按打听来的情报和地图上的地|标前进。没有寻宝探测器，|这活儿干不成。
fullDiz.src: Go by acquired information and landmark on the map. You can't accomplish this task without treasure detector.

fullDiz.cn: 古代文明留下了大量宝贝，|只需循着地标去找。|不过没有寻宝探测器，|这任务八成完不成。
fullDiz.src: A lot of valuables are left from ancient civilizations one need only follow the landmark. It's unlikely to accompish this mission without treasure detector.

fullDiz.cn: 到地图上标记的地点进行搜寻。|没有寻宝探测器，这活儿干不成。
fullDiz.src: Reach the place marked on the map and make searching. You can't accomplish this task without treasure detector.

fullDiz.cn: 丑角放出了他那群走狗。|必须宰了他们。
fullDiz.src: Harlequin sent out his curs. They have to be killed.

fullDiz.cn: 丑角是从杰里科来的。必须除掉他。
fullDiz.src: Harlequin came from Jericho. He's got to be eliminated.

fullDiz.cn: 丑角必须死。
fullDiz.src: Harlequin must die.

fullDiz.cn: 现在我知道是谁放狗咬我了。|他必须死。在城东能找到他。
fullDiz.src: Now I know who set at me those curs. He must die. You can find him in the east side of the city.

fullDiz.cn: 加菲尔德下令袭击并劫下车队。
fullDiz.src: Garfield ordered to attack and capture the caravan.

briefDiz.cn: 去见猫帮老大加菲尔德。

fullDiz.cn: 我得跟猫帮老大加菲尔德谈谈，|说服他雇我。
fullDiz.src: I need to talk to Cats' Boss Garfield and convince him to hire me.

briefDiz.cn: 向凯蒂汇报车队得手的消息。
briefDiz.src: Report to Kitty about the caravan's capture.

fullDiz.cn: 车队到手了，我得向凯蒂汇报。
fullDiz.src: The caravan is captured, I need to report to Kitty about it.

fullDiz.cn: 我得给猫帮干活，|好换来卡车的汽油和零配件。
fullDiz.src: I need to work for the Cats' gang to get petrol and spare parts for the truck.

fullDiz.cn: 猫帮杀过来了。必须干掉他们。
fullDiz.src: Cats are attacking. They must be killed.

fullDiz.cn: 凯蒂被抓走关到了老农场。|我得干掉守卫救她出来。
fullDiz.src: Kitty was captured and taken to the old farm. I need to kill the guards to set her free.

briefDiz.src: Reach the place of the negotiations.

fullDiz.cn: 约好在老路口碰头。我得赶到那儿。
fullDiz.src: We agreed to meet at the old crossroads. I need to get there.

fullDiz.cn: 凯蒂走了。我得等狗帮到来，|然后把这笔账栽到猫帮头上。
fullDiz.src: Kitty left. I need to wait for the Dogs and put the blame on the Cats.

fullDiz.cn: 只要给个由头，这两帮人就会|自相残杀。
fullDiz.src: Given a reason, the gangs will eliminate each other.

briefDiz.cn: 向牧师打听翻山越岭之路。
briefDiz.src: Find the way over the ridge from the Reverend..

fullDiz.cn: 牧师答应给我指点迷津。|也许他说的就是翻山的路？
fullDiz.src: The Reverend promised to show the Way. What if he meant the way over the ridge?

fullDiz.cn: 利己者到手了。得把他押回|去交给波恩。
fullDiz.src: We have the Egoist. He needs to be taken back to Borne.

fullDiz.cn: 利己者在圣拉斐尔。|我得干掉护卫才能抓到他。
fullDiz.src: The Egoist is in Saint-Rafael. I need to kill the guards to get to him.

fullDiz.cn: 狗帮需要利己者。|我该先跟波恩谈谈。
fullDiz.src: The Dogs need Egoist. I should talk to him first.

briefDiz.cn: 找到通往山岭另一侧的隧道。
briefDiz.src: Find the tunnel that leads to the other side of the mountain ridge.

fullDiz.cn: 牧师说明了如何使用这条隧道。
fullDiz.src: The Reverend explained how to use the tunnel.

briefDiz.cn: 找到通往圣拉斐尔的路。

fullDiz.cn: 利己者在山岭另一头的圣拉斐尔。|我得赶过去。
fullDiz.src: The Egoist is in Saint-Rafael over the ridge. I need to get there.

fullDiz.cn: 利己者袭击了凯蒂。|他必须付出代价。
fullDiz.src: Egoist attacked Kitty. He has to pay for it.

briefDiz.cn: 把货物送到杰里科的酒保乔手里。
briefDiz.src: Deliver cargo to barman Joe in Jericho.

fullDiz.cn: 有人托我把包裹带给乔。|乔得付500金币。
fullDiz.src: I was given package for Joe. Joe will have to pay 500 coins.

fullDiz.cn: 这是我跟波恩的最后一面。|我们俩之间，只能活下来一个。
fullDiz.src: This is my last meeting with Borne. Only one of us will survive it.

fullDiz.cn: 该离开这座城了。|我得跟牧师道个别。
fullDiz.src: It's time to leave town. I need to say goodbye to the Reverend.

fullDiz.cn: 最后一战将在猫帮的焦宅附近打响。
fullDiz.src: Last fight will be near the burnt house of Cats.

fullDiz.cn: 我无缘无故挨了打。|袭击者必须付出代价。
fullDiz.src: I was attacked without reasons. Attackers must pay for it.

fullDiz.cn: 狗帮把乔抓走了……必须去救他。
fullDiz.src: Dogs have seized Joe... You need to rescue him.

fullDiz.cn: 手无寸铁，但也必须逃出去……
fullDiz.src: There is no weapon, but you must escape...

briefDiz.cn: 好好教训一下这些不速之客。
briefDiz.src: Teach the guests a lesson of good manners.

fullDiz.cn: 这座角斗场的规矩很简单：|谁被顶出地上画的圈，谁就死。|我要做的，就是把对手顶出那条线。
fullDiz.src: Rules of this gladiator arena are easy: one who trespasses beyond the circle drawn on the ground will be killed. All I have to do is only to jab out enemy beyond the line.

briefDiz.src: Normalize the situation at the boundary.

fullDiz.cn: 解决了外来者的问题，|我就能赢得萨姆的绝对信任。
fullDiz.src: When I solve the problem with guest actors I'll get absolute trust of Sam.

briefDiz.src: Go along the road and avoid traps.

briefDiz.cn: 在管道丛中找到隐秘道路。
悄悄摸到图书馆，躲过卫兵。
briefDiz.src: Drive creepingly to the Library and pass the guards.

fullDiz.cn: 如果万事通说的是真话，|这里一定有我要的地图。|就差一点点，我就能找到去|埃德蒙顿的路了。|有一点很清楚：通往图书|馆的正门大道对我已经关死了。
fullDiz.src: If Wiseguy said the truth, here must be maps I want. Just a little and I'll find road to Edmonton.  One thing is clear, the main road to the Library is closed for me.

briefDiz.src: It's time to return with books for reward.

fullDiz.cn: 该弄到手的都弄到了。|趁卫兵还没盯上我，赶紧走人。
fullDiz.src: Now I know everything I need. It's time to leave until guards are not interested in me.

fullDiz.cn: 图书馆附近的废墟里能翻到不|少好东西。
fullDiz.src: In the ruins near the Library one may find a lot of interesting things.

briefDiz.cn: 完成萨姆的第一个任务。

fullDiz.cn: 这里没人知道梦想之城埃德蒙顿，|它就在桥的另一头。|但要到那儿，我得先赢得萨|姆的信任。所以拼了命也得把这封|信送到他朋友手上。
fullDiz.src: Here nobody knows about dreamy city of Edmonton which is situated directly past the bridge.  But in order to reach it I'll have to win Sam's confidence. So I'll have to make a fierce effort to deliver this message to his friend.

briefDiz.cn: 盯紧那辆形迹可疑的车辆。

fullDiz.cn: 萨姆是个肮脏的叛徒加胆小鬼，|是时候让这个世界摆脱他了。
fullDiz.src: Sam is dirty betrayer and coward it's time to free the world from him.

fullDiz.cn: 必须制止这场走私买卖。
fullDiz.src: It's necessary to stop contraband trade.

fullDiz.cn: 用尽手中远古坦克的全部火力，|趁机器人还没把周围的一切|夷为平地，先把它们全军歼灭。
fullDiz.src: Use the all weapons power of ancient you have to annihilate robots army before they destroyed all things around.

fullDiz.cn: 看起来这趟活儿有多危险就有多赚。
fullDiz.src: It seems that this mission is going to be as profitable as dangerous.

fullDiz.cn: 但愿这片废墟里还留着一点对我有|用的信息。
fullDiz.src: I hope that in this ruins there is even a little piece of useful information for me.

fullDiz.cn: 这事看来不只是送个包裹那么简单。|在这个腐朽又凶险的地方，|这是又一场可以下注的赌局。|那又怎样，我可不习惯落在最后。
fullDiz.src: It seems that the case here is not about the package. In this putrid and hazardous region it is the next game on which one may bet. So what I'm not used to arrive the last one.

fullDiz.cn: 想赢，至少得跑进前三。
fullDiz.src: To win it you have to take at least the third place.

fullDiz.cn: 该回去了。这些胶卷就是我的成|绩单。另外，萨姆也能从中|搞到有用的情报。
fullDiz.src: It's time to return. These films will demonstrate my success. Besides Sam can get the useful information.

briefDiz.src: Put thick dot in this case.

fullDiz.cn: 萨姆跟这家伙之间有什么过节|不重要，重要的是我必须拿下。|我要赢得老大的信任——|俗话说得好，为达目的，不择手段。
fullDiz.src: It is not important what the reason of problems between Sam and this fellow I have to cope with is. I need to win confidence of my boss and as the saying is - the end justifies the means.

briefDiz.src: Take view of the new place.

fullDiz.cn: '……埃德蒙顿是北美大陆|最大的贸易中心之一……|那里有八百多家商铺……|油价还特别便宜……|'我手里的小册子上是这么写的。|我想住在这样的城市！|在那儿挣钱，比好起动机|打着的发动机还快。|唉！埃德蒙顿，我的梦想之城！|我这就来找你！！！|唯一让我发愁的是，|谁也说不准这城到底在哪儿，|哪条路能通到那儿。|我找了这么久，都是白费力气。|但愿在这个地区能打听到点有|用的消息。
fullDiz.src: '...Edmonton city is known as one of the biggest trade centers of North America continent... there are more than 800 shops there... and very low fuel prices...' It was written so in the booklet I had. I want to live in this city! There one may make money faster than engine starts with good starter. Eh! Edmonton is the city of my dream! I hurry to you!!! The one thing which saddens my life is that there is no definite location where this city is situated. What road leads to it? For a long time I try to find it but in vain. I hope I can get some useful information in this region.

fullDiz.cn: 独眼托我帮她除掉土匪。|老朋友开口，我总不好回绝。
fullDiz.src: One-eyed asked to free her from bandits. I cann't offend by refusal old friend.

briefDiz.src: Find out situation in local bar.

briefDiz.cn: 查清古老胶卷失窃的来路。
briefDiz.src: Find the place where ancient volumes were stolen from.

fullDiz.cn: 这些胶卷里的内容相当有意思。|得查清它们是从哪儿偷来的，|说不定那儿还剩下一些。
fullDiz.src: These films contain exceptionally interesting information. It needs to find out where they were stolen from because some others may have left there.

fullDiz.cn: 我不信这儿就没有能赚一票的东西。
fullDiz.src: I don't believe that here there is nothing to be sold with profit.

fullDiz.cn: 独眼出什么价都不肯交出她的东西。|看来只能动手硬抢。
fullDiz.src: One-eyed won't give at any price what belongs to her. I will have to use force.

briefDiz.src: Get rid of bandits and betrayers.

briefDiz.cn: 跟巡逻队一起巡查城郊。

fullDiz.cn: 双胞胎里一个善一个恶。|可哪个是哪个来着？……管他呢。|多一桩活儿，多一笔赏金。
fullDiz.src: One twin is kind, the other is evil. But who is who?... I don't care. One more case one more reward.

fullDiz.cn: 我得拼尽全力，才能收拾|掉这坨铁疙瘩。
fullDiz.src: I have to do my best to get rid of this metal stuff.

fullDiz.cn: 这些机器人是打哪儿冒出来的？|这么穷凶极恶？得给他们改|改程序了。
fullDiz.src: Where do these robots come from? So evil-minded? They have to change the program.

briefDiz.cn: 挡住机器人对城市的进攻。
briefDiz.src: Counter the robots attack on city.

fullDiz.cn: 机器人太多了。碉堡里装的火|力比我的车猛，我就从那儿|顶着打吧。
fullDiz.src: There are too many robots. Pillbox is equipped with more powerful weapons than my vehicle. I'll try to repulse an attack from there.

fullDiz.cn: 有人出钱请我调解家庭纠纷。
fullDiz.src: I'm paid for settling family relations.

fullDiz.cn: 看样子这家伙就是本地那个土匪。|这种人我见得多了，有办法对付。
fullDiz.src: It seems that this man is a local bandit. I have some experience to cope with such men.

fullDiz.cn: 独眼帮里出了内鬼。|他跟本地土匪暗通款曲，|还帮着张罗各种非法勾当。|我得逼他露出马脚，引蛇出洞。
fullDiz.src: There is a betrayer in One-eyed's gang. He makes clandestine dealings with local bandits and helps organize illegal machinations. I have to force him to make a mistake and draw the badger.

fullDiz.cn: 这不只是一场比赛，|这是一场我必须赢下的较量。
fullDiz.src: It is not just a race this is a contest that I must win.

fullDiz.cn: 风行者是位跑惯了江湖的老旅行家，|他知道路该怎么走。|关键是我得跟得上。
fullDiz.src: Wind is an old traveller. He knows where to go. The main thing is to keep pace.

fullDiz.cn: 我得去见见这片土地的统治者。|也许我要找的东西就在她手里。
fullDiz.src: I have to talk to the ruler of local lands. Maybe she has what I'm looking for.

fullDiz.cn: 独眼的车队走不了太远。|加把劲的话，我能追上他们。
fullDiz.src: One-eyed's caravan can not go too faraway. I could catch up them if I hurry up.

fullDiz.cn: 独眼急着找我。我得赶紧回去，|越快越好。
fullDiz.src: One-eyed needs me urgently. I have to return and the sooner the better.

fullDiz.cn: 灯塔找到了。剩下的唯一问题就是：|这玩意儿到底怎么点亮？
fullDiz.src: Lighthouse is found. One thing that has left is only to understand how to turn it on?

fullDiz.cn: 通向工厂的路已经找到，|现在可以把这里好好摸个遍了。
fullDiz.src: Now when the road to the factory is found I can explore everything here.

fullDiz.cn: 这些乱石滚下来，|怕是比榴弹炮还要命。|把油门踩到底，冲过去！
fullDiz.src: These cobblestones can turn out to be more dangerous than howitzer. Bend the throttle with all your might!

briefDiz.src: Find the way get to factory.

fullDiz.cn: 通往加拿大的路总算向我敞开了。|可要是不把机器人挡住，|它们会一路追着我们跑。|所以我得帮萨姆找到远古武器，|否则等我找到埃德蒙顿，|这帮该死的铁疙瘩早把它拆|成零件了。
fullDiz.src: Finally road to Canada was opened for me. But the robots will run upon our heels if we don't stop them. So I have to help Sam to find the weapon of Ancient otherwise these damned metal sruff destroy Edmonton before I can find it.

fullDiz.cn: 萨姆骗了我，但这事儿不|能就这么算了。坑我的人，|一个都别想白坑。
fullDiz.src: Sam has deceived me but I won't leave it this way. Not a single meanness should go unpunished.

fullDiz.cn: 只要端掉这座工厂，|加拿大境内的机器人就算除干净了。
fullDiz.src: When I destroy factory I will liquidate all robots in Canada.

fullDiz.cn: 那货躲在飞行器里想弄死我，|就因为我在地面上打不着他。|不过没什么大不了的——|他的铁鸟迟早得落地，|到时候我就送他上路。
fullDiz.src: Coward cattle on flying vehicle try to kill me because I can't fire at him from the ground. But nothing serious sooner or later his machine must land and that time I will kill him.

fullDiz.cn: 这地方古怪，住的人也古怪。
fullDiz.src: Strange people inhabit these strange lands.

fullDiz.cn: 如今这艘渡船是我过河去追|萨姆的唯一指望。
fullDiz.src: Now ferry is the only way to cross the river and catch up Sam.

fullDiz.cn: 我这阵子专跟这些怪物打交道。|可惜连件战利品都剥不下来，|连他们身上那几件褂子都拿不走。
fullDiz.src: I am in luck with these monsters. It is a pity I can't take trophies I even can't take jackets from them.

fullDiz.cn: 这地方透着股邪门。|要么抓个舌头回来审问，|要么就得跟当地人搭话。
fullDiz.src: Absolutely strange place. It needs to capture prisoner for interrogation or to talk to locals.

briefDiz.src: Puzzle out situation with lost child.

fullDiz.cn: 在乡间找找知情人，|看谁知道走失孩子的下落。
fullDiz.src: Find in the country witnesss who know something about lost child.

briefDiz.src: Give traveller a lift to city.

fullDiz.cn: 捎那位旅行者去奥特诺。|算不上什么难事，|路上有个人做伴也热闹些。
fullDiz.src: Give traveller a ride to Otno. Not the most hard mission but it's more cheerful during the travell.

fullDiz.cn: 给抛锚的车送零配件去。
fullDiz.src: Bring spares for broken vehicle

briefDiz.cn: 田里出现了奇怪的符号。
briefDiz.src: There are strange signs at the fields.

fullDiz.cn: 人们都说是奇观。|值得亲眼看一看，|回头好在酒吧里讲给姑娘们听。
fullDiz.src: People say that it is a wonderful event. It's worth seeing to tell about it in the bar with girls.

briefDiz.cn: 回城给大家讲讲这件事。

fullDiz.cn: 岂能让这种小白脸在马路上|抢到我前头去。
fullDiz.src: I cannot allow this teddy boy outrides me on the road.

fullDiz.cn: 看来光有机器人的壳子还不够，|还得学它的做派，|否则基地的安保系统会把我轰成渣。
fullDiz.src: It turns out that it's not enough to have figure of robot it also needs to imitate his behavior otherwise the security system of Base will destroy me.

briefDiz.cn: 继续追查机器人的源头。
briefDiz.src: Continue to search for robots source.

fullDiz.cn: 那座工厂并不是怪物们的真正源头，|炸了它也只是聊胜于无。|机器人的数量会减少，|但绝不会绝根。得找到它们的老巢。
fullDiz.src: Factory wasn't the major source of monsters and its destruction helped us a little. The number of robots will become smaller but they won't entirely disappear. We need search the center.

fullDiz.cn: 摧毁基地的机会只有一次。|要成功，就必须找到给基地|供电的发电机，然后把它炸上天。
fullDiz.src: I will have only one attempt to destroy the Base. If I want to reach the goal I have to find Generator which powers the Base and blow it up.

fullDiz.cn: 过终点线，我从来都是第一个——|只不过对手还不知道罢了。|我会证明给他看。
fullDiz.src: I always come to the finish line first, simply my rival doesn't know about it. I will demonstrate it.

briefDiz.cn: 把外乡人从机器人手里救出来。

briefDiz.src: Go with Mechanic to his home.

fullDiz.cn: 说不准哪种更高尚：|是搭救落难的外乡人，|还是再歼灭一窝机器人？我全都要。
fullDiz.src: I don't know what is more high-toned to help stranger in deep water or to annihilate another group of robots? I will do both.

fullDiz.cn: 我找到了个买零配件的大主顾。|看样子这倒霉蛋打算把零件|攒到一块儿，拼辆新车来替|代撞烂的那辆。这对我是好事——|他的零件需求量大着呢。
fullDiz.src: I have found an excellent spares buyer. It seems that this luckless man is planing to put them all together and create a new vehicle instead of the crashed one. It's good for me - he will need a lot of spares.

fullDiz.cn: 这就是那台我早就想干掉的飞|行机器。是时候动手了！
fullDiz.src: Here is the flying machine which I have wished to destroy for so long. Now it's time to do it!

briefDiz.src: Get flexible tubing for fluid system.

fullDiz.cn: 机修工有个端掉机器人基地的妙计：|伪装成它们的一员混进基地去。|唯一的问题是，得先把他手里那台|趴窝的怪物修到能转的程度。
fullDiz.src: Mechanic has a super plan how to destroy the Base of robots. He offers to find a way into their base camouflaging as one of them. The only thing is to get into working conditions the nonworking monster which he has.

briefDiz.src: Run away from the Base at full speed.

fullDiz.cn: 发电机炸了。机器人清完了。|该撤离这地方了。
fullDiz.src: Generator is destroyed. All robots liquidated. It's time go away from here.

briefDiz.cn: 找到进入机器人基地的路。
briefDiz.src: Find a way into Base of robots.

fullDiz.cn: 现在（顶着机器人的外|壳）我能进机器人基地了。
fullDiz.src: Now (in robot appearance) I can enter the robots' Base.

fullDiz.cn: 知己知彼，百战不殆。|比方说，查查这机器人急匆|匆地赶去哪儿，说不定能派上用场。
fullDiz.src: You need to know all about the enemy. For example it will be useful to find out where this robot hurries?

fullDiz.cn: 成为竞技场的合伙人。
fullDiz.src: Become the Colosseum’s joint owner.

fullDiz.cn: 我应该把这个包裹交给我父|亲的朋友 谢尔戈。
fullDiz.src: I should deliver this package to Sergo, my father's friend.

fullDiz.cn: 在竞技场让大家见识一场真|正的战斗。
fullDiz.src: Show everyone a real fight at the Colosseum.

fullDiz.cn: 考古学家们正在挖掘什么有|趣的东西……他们几乎没有防备。|这是赚点钱的好机会。
fullDiz.src: Archeologists dig for something interesting... They have almost no defense. It is a perfect opportunity to earn some money.

fullDiz.cn: 通知埃特纳的人关于竞技场的事。
fullDiz.src: Inform Aeterna’s people of the Colosseum

fullDiz.cn: 现在我确信 本 就是我要找的人。|问题是去哪里找他。
fullDiz.src: Now I know for sure that Ben is the man I need. The question is where to find him.

briefDiz.cn: 寻找探险家 本·斯罗特尔

fullDiz.cn: 我的人生已成废墟。|要重新拼凑完整，|我必须了解我亲生父亲的更多事。|我唯一的希望就是 本·斯罗特尔，|不管他究竟是谁……
fullDiz.src: My life is in ruins. To make it whole again I have to learn more about my real father. My only hope is Ben Throttle, whoever he is...

fullDiz.cn: 也许能在某个当地聚落的酒吧里|找到 荷马。
fullDiz.src: Probably, Homer may be found at the bar of one of the local settlements

fullDiz.cn: 也许能在某个当地聚落的酒吧里|找到 荷马。
fullDiz.src: Probably, Homer may be found at the bar of one of the local settlements

fullDiz.cn: 仓库被极端分子占领了。|我必须救出他们的首领才能|得到我需要的东西。
fullDiz.src: The warehouse is occupied by the extremists. I must free their leader in order to get what I need.

briefDiz.cn: 在奥尔姆打听首领被关在哪里。
briefDiz.src: Find out in Olme where the leader is kept.

briefDiz.cn: 把首领带回他的人那里。
briefDiz.src: Bring the leader to his people.

fullDiz.cn: 当地的掠夺者妨碍考古学家挖掘。|我必须除掉他们。
fullDiz.src: Local raiders hinder archeologists from digging. I have to get rid of them.

fullDiz.cn: 要得到我需要的东西，|一个办法就是消灭所有挡我路的人。
fullDiz.src: One way to get what I need is to destroy all that oppose me.

fullDiz.cn: 有个商人想重新开张竞技场。|我可以帮一把。
fullDiz.src: Some businessman wants to reopen the Colosseum. I can help.

fullDiz.cn: 通知米德加德的人关于竞技场的事。
fullDiz.src: Inform Midgard’s people of the Colosseum.

fullDiz.cn: 通知波尔图的人关于竞技场的事。
fullDiz.src: Inform Porto’s people of the Colosseum.

fullDiz.cn: 返回竞技场领取你的报酬。
fullDiz.src: Return to Colosseum to get your reward.

fullDiz.cn: 返回竞技场领取你的报酬。
fullDiz.src: Return to Colosseum to get your reward.

fullDiz.cn: 找到并查看那些标记。
fullDiz.src: Find and examine the signs.

fullDiz.cn: 集体农庄的田地上出现了神|秘的标记。
fullDiz.src: There are mysterious signs on the Kolkhoz' fields.

briefDiz.cn: 把标记的事告诉科学家
briefDiz.src: Tell the scientists about the signs

fullDiz.cn: 把这事告诉米德加德的科学家，|他们会查清楚这里到底发生了什么。
fullDiz.src: Tell the scientists of Midgard will find out what is happening here.

fullDiz.cn: 我做成了人生中第一笔生意。|父亲知道了一定会很高兴。
fullDiz.src: I made the first bargain in my life. Father will be happy to learn about it.

briefDiz.src: Free the warehouse from the bandits

fullDiz.cn: 仓库被匪徒占领了。|我必须想办法把他们赶走。
fullDiz.src: The warehouse id occupied by the bandits. I must find the way to drive them away.

fullDiz.cn: 集体农庄的农夫们被吓坏了，|不肯去收割庄稼。
fullDiz.src: Kolkhoz' farmers are scared and refuse to harvest.

briefDiz.src: Bring Rich farmer to the filling station.

fullDiz.cn: 我把富农带到加油站后，|他会给我报酬。
fullDiz.src: Rich Farmer will reward me when I bring him to the filling station.

fullDiz.cn: 阿斯加德酒吧里总有人知道|翻越群山的路。
fullDiz.src: Someone at the Asgard’s bar must know the way to cross the mountains.

briefDiz.src: Go to the bar and name the password.
Buy some explosives at the Asgard.
Buy some explosives at the miners’ village.

fullDiz.cn: 这批货物必须不惜一切代价送达。|我的任务是护送它，确保万无一失。
fullDiz.src: This cargo must be delivered at all cost. My mission is to accompany it and make sure nothing happens to it.

fullDiz.cn: 炸药有了，我只需要把它放到正|确的位置。
fullDiz.src: I have the explosives. All I need is to place it at the right place.

briefDiz.src: Free the oil mine from the bandits.

fullDiz.cn: 首先我得找到通往 阿克塞|尔 地盘的路。然后再决定|怎么对付他！
fullDiz.src: First I have to find a way to the Axels land. Then I’ll decide what to do with him!

briefDiz.cn: 找到并摧毁匪徒的营地。

fullDiz.cn: 我得跟着这辆车回它的老巢。|绝不能攻击这辆车。
fullDiz.src: I got to follow this one to the base. I must not attack this car.

briefDiz.cn: 本 最后出现在米德加德
briefDiz.src: Ben was last seen in Midgard
Find the entrance to the tunnel.

fullDiz.cn: 既然我知道入口在哪了，|穿过它应该不成问题。
fullDiz.src: Now that I know, where the entrance is, there should be no problem in crossing it.

briefDiz.cn: 在索斯找到 费利克斯。

fullDiz.cn: 很快我就能见到 本·斯罗特尔，|了解我的身世之谜。
fullDiz.src: Soon I'll meet Ben Throttle and learn the truth of my origin.

briefDiz.src: Buy the key from the barman.

fullDiz.cn: 我敢肯定酒保知道那扇门锁了。|他甚至可能有钥匙。
fullDiz.src: I am sure the barman knows that the gate is locked. He may even have the key to it.

briefDiz.cn: 把她从掠夺者手中救出来。
在51区打听 爱丽丝 的下落。
briefDiz.src: Ask about Alice at the Area 51.

fullDiz.cn: 原来 爱丽丝 和匪徒有牵连。|我也不算意外，但还是……
fullDiz.src: So Alice is connected with the bandits. Not that I am surprised, but still...

briefDiz.cn: 在赫尔维蒂亚抓住 爱丽丝。

fullDiz.cn: 爱丽丝 很快就要为她的所作所为付|出代价！我清楚她在哪！
fullDiz.src: Soon Alice will pay for all she has done! I know exactly where she is!

briefDiz.cn: 在米德加德寻找 爱丽丝
在波尔图寻找 爱丽丝
在北方追上 爱丽丝

fullDiz.cn: 看来 费利克斯 没有杀我父亲。|我唯一的线索就是 爱丽丝。|她是罪行的目击者。
fullDiz.src: Felix seems to be innocent of killing my father. My only trace is Alice. She is the witness of the crime.

fullDiz.cn: 父亲留下的线索指向一片遥|远的土地，那里住着无所不|知的先知。
fullDiz.src: The trace, left by my father leads to the distant land, where the all-knowing Oracle lives.

fullDiz.cn: 父亲可能还活着！|无论如何我都要找到他。|也许在他的房子里能找到些线索，|那房子在米宁。
fullDiz.src: My father may still be alive! I will find him no matter what.|Some traces may be found at his house in Minin.

briefDiz.cn: 在马雷齐亚找到猩红之晨的招募人。

fullDiz.cn: 猩红之晨正在招募新兵。|加入他们就能接近 阿克塞尔。
fullDiz.src: The Crimson Dawn is enlisting new recruits. To become of them is a sure way get closer to Axel.

briefDiz.cn: 在图斯找到独立城镇联邦的招募人

fullDiz.cn: 独立城镇联邦需要人手来对抗| 阿克塞尔 的军队。|只要我加入他们，|就能一起粉碎这个暴君！
fullDiz.src: The Commonwealth of the Independent Towns needs help to fight with Axels’ forces. If I join them, we will crush the tyrant!

fullDiz.cn: 海门就在遥远的北方某处。|米宁的商队会给我指路。
fullDiz.src: Somewhere in the far north the Sea Gate are located. The caravan from Minin will show me the way to that region.

fullDiz.cn: 油田的工人正坐在米宁的酒吧里。|我必须说服他们回去干活。
fullDiz.src: The oil mine workers are sitting in the Minin’s bar. I must convince them to return back to work.

briefDiz.src: Find a place for the ambush.

fullDiz.cn: 迟早会有人用这条隧道。|我就在这里埋伏，抢到钥匙！
fullDiz.src: Sooner or later, someone will use the tunnel. I will ambush him and get the key!

briefDiz.cn: 跟着商队去它的目的地。
briefDiz.src: Follow the caravan to its destination.

fullDiz.cn: 猩红之晨通过隧道源源不断|地获得资源和兵力。|一旦夺取隧道，独立城镇联|邦就能与外界建立稳固的联系，|同时切断敌人的补给线。|为了崇高的理想，|隧道的守卫者必须死。
fullDiz.src: CD keeps receiving resources and manpower via the tunnel. Once captured, it will grant CIT the firm connection with the outside world.  And at the same time it will cut the enemy supplies flow. The tunnel’s guardians must die for the sake of high ideals.

fullDiz.cn: 我的行动没有逃过人们的眼睛。|很快我就能见到独立城镇联|邦的高层了！
fullDiz.src: My actions did not go unnoticed. Soon I will meet with the high leaders of the CIT!

briefDiz.cn: 和 阿克塞尔 见面

fullDiz.cn: 真相揭晓的时刻就要到了。|很快我就能和 阿克塞尔 |面对面了！
fullDiz.src: The moment of truth is near. Soon I will meet Axel face to face!

briefDiz.cn: 在扎伊姆卡弄到强力武器

fullDiz.cn: 我得消除匪徒袭击的威胁，|才能通过佩斯特。|我唯一能想到的办法就是炸|掉通往他们基地的桥。
fullDiz.src: I have to eliminate the threat of bandits’ attacks to go through Pest. The only way I can think of is to blow up the bridge leading to their base.

briefDiz.src: Set the oil mine free from the bandits

fullDiz.cn: 我得让油田恢复生产，|米宁的人才会给我指北方的路。
fullDiz.src: I will need to restore the work of the oil mine, so that the people of Minin show me the way north.

briefDiz.cn: 争取一个大派系的支持。
briefDiz.src: Enlist the support of a major faction.

fullDiz.cn: 看来麻烦不小。爱丽丝 是|当地某个犯罪头目的女人。|没有帮手很难把她弄到手。|该找些强有力的盟友了。
fullDiz.src: It sounds like trouble. Alice is a girl of some local crime leader. It will be too hard to get her without support. It’s high time to find some powerful allies.

briefDiz.cn: 争取一个大派系的支持。
briefDiz.src: Enlist the support of a major faction.

fullDiz.cn: 看来我单枪匹马对付不了 |阿克塞尔。该找些强有力的盟友了。
fullDiz.src: It looks I won’t be able to get Axel all by myself. It’s high time to find some powerful allies.

briefDiz.src: Collect enough money to pay the fee

fullDiz.cn: 匪徒同意让我通过他们的地盘，|条件是 10000 金币。
fullDiz.src: The bandits agree to let me pass trough their land for 10000 coins.

fullDiz.cn: 看来匪徒唯一听得懂的语|言就是枪声！
fullDiz.src: Looks the only language the bandits understand is the sound of the gunshots!

fullDiz.cn: 村庄遭到袭击！我的车离战场最近。|我必须帮忙。
fullDiz.src: The village is under attack! My vehicle is the closest to the battle location. I must help.

fullDiz.cn: 我觉得有猫腻。我必须让矿|工们干活！而这里有人在骗我！
fullDiz.src: I smell rat. I must make the miners work! And someone here lies to me!

briefDiz.cn: 带 爱丽丝 逛逛当地的村庄。

fullDiz.cn: 一个漂亮的姑娘要我陪她。|她看起来像个犯罪分子，|不过谁在乎呢。
fullDiz.src: A pretty girl asked to accompany her. She has a look of a criminal on her, but who cares.

fullDiz.cn: 我必须去见托斯卡纳的叛军，|打探他们掌握的消息。|运气好的话，他们会有|助于我们击败 阿克塞尔 的情报。
fullDiz.src: I must meet the rebels of Toskana and learn all they have to tell. With any luck, they have information that will help us to defeat Axel.

briefDiz.src: Deliver the canister of oil to Minin.

fullDiz.cn: 这桶油标志着油田重新开工了。|我必须把它送到镇上。
fullDiz.src: This canister is a symbol of the fact that that the oil mines is working again. I must deliver it to the town.

briefDiz.cn: 把雇来的工人带到油田。
briefDiz.src: Bring hired workers to the oil mine.

fullDiz.cn: 只要我把这些人带到油田，|他们就会开始干活。
fullDiz.src: As soon as I bring these guys to the oil mine, they will begin to work.

fullDiz.cn: 我必须找到通往先知之地的海|底隧道入口。
fullDiz.src: I must find the entrance to the undersea tunnel that leads to the Oracle's land.

briefDiz.cn: 把叛军领袖送到赫尔维蒂亚。
briefDiz.src: Deliver the rebels’ leader to Helvetia.

fullDiz.cn: 希望他掌握的情报真的值得|付出这一切牺牲。
fullDiz.src: I hope the information he has really worth all the sacrifices.

briefDiz.cn: 在佩斯特打听去米宁的路
briefDiz.src: Ask road to Minin in Pest

briefDiz.cn: 把猩红之晨的将军送到赫尔维蒂亚。

fullDiz.cn: 这是最后一块拼图。|我们会让将军说出 阿克塞|尔 的弱点。
fullDiz.src: That is the last piece of the puzzle. We will make the General tell us about Axel’s weak point.

briefDiz.src: Deliver workers to the oil mine.

fullDiz.cn: 现在工人们自己做主了。|他们乐意去油田干活。|我倒想知道为什么？
fullDiz.src: Now the workers are masters of their own fate.  And they gladly agreed to go working on the oil mine. I wonder why?

fullDiz.cn: 我有了隧道大门的钥匙。|只要打开它就行了。
fullDiz.src: I have the key to the tunnel’s gate. I only have to open it.

fullDiz.cn: 我的任务是巡逻边境，|以防敌人出现。
fullDiz.src: My mission is to patrol the border in case the enemy appears.

fullDiz.cn: 看来我得到别处去找工人了。
fullDiz.src: Guess I should try to find workers somewhere else.

fullDiz.cn: 当地人决心吓跑掠夺者。|也许我该帮他们一把。
fullDiz.src: The locals made up their minds to scare the raiders away. Maybe I should help them.

fullDiz.cn: 那条线索断了。希望本还能|想出别的办法。
fullDiz.src: That trail was cold. I hope Ben will come up with another plan.

fullDiz.cn: 该回图斯接新任务了。
fullDiz.src: It’s time to return to Touse for a new assignment.

fullDiz.cn: 该回图斯了。
fullDiz.src: It’s time to return to Touse.

briefDiz.src: Try to cross the chasm somewhere else.

fullDiz.cn: 我必须穿过那条深谷。|有两座桥：一座在佩斯特镇，|另一座在匪徒的地盘。
fullDiz.src: I have to cross that chasm. There are two bridges. One is the town Pest, another one is at the bandits’ territory.

briefDiz.cn: 跟着商队去它的目的地。

fullDiz.cn: 如果我跟着那辆车到它的目的地，|大概就有机会偷到钥匙。
fullDiz.src: If I follow that car to its destination, I will probably find an occasion to steal the key.

fullDiz.cn: 不管凶手藏在哪，|我都会找到他并惩罚他！
fullDiz.src: Wherever the murderer is hiding, I’ll find and punish hum!

briefDiz.cn: 和米德加德的管家谈谈。

fullDiz.cn: 在几名独立城镇联邦精锐战|士的陪同下，我必须活捉猩|红之晨的将军。
fullDiz.src: Accompanied by several elite CIT’s warriors, I must capture Crimson Dawn’s general.

briefDiz.cn: 打听 阿克塞尔 的消息。

fullDiz.cn: 我得向当地人打听 阿克塞|尔 的事，尤其是去哪里能找到他。
fullDiz.src: I must ask the locals about Axel. Especially where I can find him.

briefDiz.cn: 打听 爱丽丝 的下落

fullDiz.cn: 人人都认识 爱丽丝。|我只要打听就能找到她。
fullDiz.src: Everybody knows Alice. I only need to ask and I will find her.

fullDiz.cn: 米宁或许有人知道海门的事。
fullDiz.src: Someone in Minin can know about the Sea Gate.

briefDiz.cn: 在阿斯加德打听隧道的事。
briefDiz.src: Ask in Asgard about the tunnel.

fullDiz.cn: 那里总有人知道怎样、|在哪里可以翻越群山。
fullDiz.src: Someone there must know how and where one may cross mountains.

fullDiz.cn: 她自找的！
fullDiz.src: She asked for it!

briefDiz.cn: 把 菲利蒙 送回家。

fullDiz.cn: 他叫 菲利蒙。请把他带回来！|我太爱他了。
fullDiz.src: His name is Philemon. Please bring him back! I love him so much.

briefDiz.cn: 把标记的事报告给米德加德

fullDiz.cn: 德鲁伊提到了奇怪的标记。|去看看吧。
fullDiz.src: The druid mentioned strange signs. Let’s take a closer look.

fullDiz.cn: 那位隐居的德鲁伊远离人群|独自生活。我该去拜访他，问声好。
fullDiz.src: The hermit druid is living alone far from friends. I should pay him a visit to say hello.

briefDiz.cn: 给植物学家送些药品和木材
briefDiz.src: Bring some medicine and some wood to the botanist

fullDiz.cn: 我能在镇上买到木材，|但药品要去哪里找呢？
fullDiz.src: I can buy some wood in the town, but I wonder, where may I find any medicine?

fullDiz.cn: 一个老兵提到了植物学家。|也许我得去找他。
fullDiz.src: Old soldier told something about the botanist. Probably I have to find him.

fullDiz.cn: 医院是寻找药品的好地方。
fullDiz.src: The hospital is the right place to look for medicine.

fullDiz.cn: 我得在米德加德找到那个怪人。
fullDiz.src: I must find the strange man at the Midgard.

briefDiz.cn: 把材料和 15000 金币交给师傅。
briefDiz.src: Give materials and 15'000 coins to the master.

briefDiz.cn: 和 本 谈谈外星人的事。
briefDiz.src: Talk to Ben about the aliens.

fullDiz.cn: 本 知道很多关于 伊万·|戈 冒险的故事。|希望其中某个故事能给我指路。
fullDiz.src: Ben knows a lot of stories about Ivan’s adventures. Hopefully one of these stories will show me the way.

fullDiz.cn: 老人要我把他送到古代遗迹。|我想他打算死在那里。真够阴森的。
fullDiz.src: The old man asked to bring him to the ancient ruins. I think he is going to die there. Creepy.

briefDiz.cn: 帮助 康妮 和 布莱德。

fullDiz.cn: 一对奇怪的夫妇要我送他们回家。|这么简单的活儿他们却给了一|大笔钱。
fullDiz.src: A strange couple asked to bring them home. They offer a lot of money for such a simple task.

fullDiz.cn: 据那男孩的广告说，|娱乐中心简直就是天堂。去看看吧。
fullDiz.src: According to the boy’s advertisements, the Entertainment Center is just a paradise. Let’s check it out.

fullDiz.cn: 先知彻底疯了。他打算摧毁一切，|从我下手。我绝不能让这种事发生！
fullDiz.src: The Oracle is completely mad. He plans to destroy everything, starting with me. I cannot allow this to happen!

fullDiz.cn: 塞尔的发电站是强大的干扰源。|它干扰了先知的信号，|使他无法控制轨道武器。
fullDiz.src: Power station at the Seil is a source of powerful noise. It jams the Oracle’s signals and he cannot get control over the orbital weapon.

briefDiz.src: Take the disk away from the thief.

fullDiz.cn: 那窃贼还不知道他的对手是谁。|光盘会是我的。
fullDiz.src: That thief doesn’t know who he up against is yet. The disk will be mine.

fullDiz.cn: 我必须找到北上的路。|米宁的人知道怎么走。
fullDiz.src: I must find the way north. People of Minin know how to get there.

briefDiz.src: Find somebody to work on the oil mine.

fullDiz.cn: 光解放油田还不够让它运转起来。|现在我还得找人去干活。
fullDiz.src: Liberating the oil mine was not enough to make it work. Now I must find somebody to work on it.

fullDiz.cn: 父亲家里被翻得乱七八糟。|一定有人看到了发生了什么。|我去酒吧问问。
fullDiz.src: Everything is upside down at my father’s house. Somebody must have seen what had happened. I’ll ask in the Bar.

briefDiz.cn: 在利布里姆找到 爱丽丝。

fullDiz.cn: 爱丽丝 偷了光盘往西去了。|我必须不惜一切代价抓住她！
fullDiz.src: Alice has stolen the disks and left to the west. I must catch her at all costs!

briefDiz.cn: 把第二张光盘交给先知。
briefDiz.src: Deliver second disk to the Oracle.

fullDiz.cn: 先知用它就能破译 伊万·|戈 的日记。
fullDiz.src: Using it the Oracle will decipher Ivan Go’s diary.

briefDiz.cn: 在废弃的小镇追上那个逃跑者。
briefDiz.src: Catch the runner at the abandoned town.

fullDiz.cn: 那匪徒藏在废弃的小镇某处。|如果我杀了他，村民会付钱给我。
fullDiz.src: The bandit is hiding somewhere at the abandoned town. The villagers will pay me if I kill him.

fullDiz.cn: 只有先知可能拥有足以摧毁|污染源的强大武器。
fullDiz.src: Only the Oracle may possess the weapon powerful enough to destroy the source of the contamination.

fullDiz.cn: 窃贼无处可去，只能去51区。|我会在那里逮住他！
fullDiz.src: The thief have nowhere to go, but to the Area 51. I’ll get him there!

fullDiz.cn: 她朝阿斯加德方向走了。
fullDiz.src: She left somewhere at the direction of Asgard.

fullDiz.cn: 通往海门的路要经过沼泽。|我必须找到穿过它的路。
fullDiz.src: The way to the Sea Gate lays through the swamp. I must find the way to cross it.

fullDiz.cn: 他一定有第二张光盘！
fullDiz.src: Most certainly he has the second disk!

fullDiz.cn: 有人偷了 鉴赏家 的杰作。|唯一识货的人就是 大师。
fullDiz.src: Someone stole a masterpiece from Aesthete. The only man who appreciates that kind of goods is Virtuoso.

briefDiz.cn: 从 诡术师 手里拿回杰作。

fullDiz.cn: 一个叫 诡术师 的人是这起|盗窃的幕后主使。|我得抓住他，把杰作物归原主。
fullDiz.src: Someone by the name of Trickster is the organizer of this theft. I am to catch him and return the masterpiece to its owner.

fullDiz.cn: 要拿到报酬，我得把杰|作还给 鉴赏家。|不过，也许有人愿意出更高的价。
fullDiz.src: To get a reward, I must return the masterpiece to Aesthete. However, there may be someone else to offer a higher price.

fullDiz.cn: 只有我能阻止这场吞噬世界的疯狂。|我要安装这个装置来降低污染程度。|这是我的使命。
fullDiz.src: I am the only one who can stop the madness, happening with the world. I will install the device that will lower the level of contamination. This is my destiny.

fullDiz.cn: 外星飞船一直藏在这里。|他们为了争夺新领土杀了无数人类。|我必须阻止他们！|希望摧毁这台机器能让先知|重新掌控轨道武器。
fullDiz.src: The alien ship was hiding here all the time. They killed many humans in quest for new territories. I must stop them! Hopefully, the destruction of this machine will allow the Oracle to take control over the orbital weapon.

fullDiz.cn: 我偷了他的货物后，|老大可能给我惹大麻烦。|我必须先下手为强。
fullDiz.src: The Boss may cause me a lot of trouble, after I had stolen his cargo. I must strike first.

briefDiz.cn: 带着货物回到 诡术师 那里。
briefDiz.src: Return to Trickster with the cargo.

fullDiz.cn: 外星人一定知道怎么停止那可|怕的装置。他们是我最后的指望了。
fullDiz.src: The aliens must know how to stop that horrible device. They are my last resort.

fullDiz.cn: 线索指向塞尔。有人在这里|附近见过那艘外星飞船。
fullDiz.src: The trace leads to Seil. Somewhere around here the alien vessel was seen.

fullDiz.cn: 我打听到一支装载贵重货|物的商队很快就要南下，|几乎没有护卫。这是个好机会。
fullDiz.src: I learned that the caravan with the precious cargo will soon go south almost unguarded. It is a good chance.

fullDiz.cn: 我必须假扮叛军，|向独立城镇联邦的特工传递假情报。
fullDiz.src: I must personate the rebel and misinform the CIT’s agent.

fullDiz.cn: 我得回马雷齐亚接新任务。
fullDiz.src: I have to return to Marezzia for a new assignment.

briefDiz.cn: 打击独立城镇联邦的补给线。

fullDiz.cn: 现在我得去袭击独立城镇联|邦的补给商队。这肯定能打|击敌人的士气。
fullDiz.src: Now I must attack the caravan with CIT supplies. It will definitely lower the enemy morale.

fullDiz.cn: 这只老狐狸快要识破我的身份了！|我绝不能让这种事发生。
fullDiz.src: That old fox is about to break my cover! I cannot allow this.

fullDiz.cn: 既然我知道 爱丽丝 在哪，|就绝不会让她跑了！
fullDiz.src: Now that I know, where Alice is, I won’t let her go!

briefDiz.cn: 和 阿克塞尔 决斗。

fullDiz.cn: 在竞技场上和 阿克塞尔 |一较高下的时刻到了。|老天，我等这一刻等了太久。
fullDiz.src: The time has come for me to fight with Axel on the arena. Man, I’ve been waiting for this moment for so long.

briefDiz.cn: 在塞尔抓住 爱丽丝。

fullDiz.cn: 原来被 爱丽丝 欺骗的不|止我一个。阿克塞尔 也在找她。|他告诉了我她最后的踪迹，|在塞尔附近。奇怪她怎么会去那里，|那不是自投罗网吗。
fullDiz.src: So, I was not the only one to be cheated by Alice. Axel is also looking for her. He pointed out her last location to me, somewhere near Seil. I wonder why she went there, she may easily be caught.

fullDiz.cn: 我需要从修道院送些葡萄酒过去。|但我觉得这个差事没那么简单。
fullDiz.src: I need to deliver some wine from the monastery. But I think there’s mire in this assignment than that.

fullDiz.cn: 如果我随便摧毁几辆独立城|镇联邦的车辆，就能让敌人|神经紧绷。
fullDiz.src: If I destroy several CIT’s vehicles at random, it will make the enemy nervous.

fullDiz.cn: 现在该干点大的了。|袭击村庄肯定能激怒敌人。
fullDiz.src: Now it’s time for more serious matters. Attacking the village is a sure way to enrage the enemy.

briefDiz.cn: 把第二张光盘交给先知。
briefDiz.src: Deliver the second disk to the Oracle.

fullDiz.cn: 终于，第二张光盘到手了，|我可以去伊格诺特和先知谈谈了。
fullDiz.src: Finally, with the second disk at my disposal, I can go to Ignott and speak with the Oracle.

fullDiz.cn: 女修道院长有任务交给我。|我必须猎杀异端和异教徒。
fullDiz.src: The prioress has a mission for me. I must hunt down and kill the heretic and the pagan.

fullDiz.cn: 现在我得去救出叛军领袖。
fullDiz.src: Now I must save the rebel’s leader.

briefDiz.cn: 杀死独立城镇联邦的领袖。

fullDiz.cn: 我把独立城镇联邦的领袖诱|入了圈套。现在我得把他们全|干掉来结束这场战争。|然后从 阿克塞尔 手里领赏。
fullDiz.src: I lured the CIT’s leaders into the trap. Now I must kill them all to end this war. And to get a reward from the hands of Axel.

briefDiz.cn: 和 阿克塞尔 见面。

fullDiz.cn: 终于等到了！我现在是战争英雄，|很快就能见到 阿克塞尔 了！
fullDiz.src: It finally happened! I am a war hero now and soon I will meet Axel!

fullDiz.cn: 送货是件轻松活儿。|不算刺激，但报酬还不错。
fullDiz.src: Delivering the cargo is an easy job. Not very exciting yet rewarding enough.

briefDiz.src: Return the junk back to Marezzia.

fullDiz.cn: 事情开始变得有趣了。|不知道我得把这堆老机器来|回拖多少趟。
fullDiz.src: It is starting to get interesting. I wonder how many times I am supposed to drag that old machinery back and forth.

fullDiz.cn: 马雷齐亚肯定有新任务在等我。
fullDiz.src: Surely, a new assignment is waiting for me at the Marezzia.

fullDiz.cn: 马雷齐亚肯定有新任务在等我。|不知道我是不是离 阿克塞|尔 越来越近了。
fullDiz.src: Surely, a new assignment is waiting for me at the Marezzia. I wonder if I am getting any closer to Axel.

fullDiz.cn: 我奉命杀光所有叛军。|我不确定是否该这么做……|这真是太残忍了……
fullDiz.src: I am ordered to kill all the rebels. I doubt if I must... it is a really evil deed...

briefDiz.cn: 在修道院打听 爱丽丝 的下落。

fullDiz.cn: 我听说修道院的修女们知|道的比她们说的多。|如果她们真的藏了 爱丽丝，|这次她跑不掉了！
fullDiz.src: I heard the Cloister nuns know more than they say. And if they are really hiding Alice, she won’t escape this time!

briefDiz.cn: 在米德加德讲讲标记的事
briefDiz.src: Tell in Midgard about the signs

fullDiz.cn: 米德加德的科学家们肯定|会对田地上出现的神秘痕迹感兴趣。|运气好的话我还能因为通风|报信得到奖赏。
fullDiz.src: The scientists of Midgard will surely get interested in the mysterious traces that appeared on the field. With any luck I will be rewarded for telling them.

briefDiz.src: Take a look at the field.

fullDiz.cn: 我觉得那片农田值得一看。|不知道是什么把人吓成那样。
fullDiz.src: I think it’s worth looking at the field. I wonder what scared people so much.

fullDiz.cn: 要赢得德鲁伊的信任，|我必须清除圣所里的怪物。|奇怪，我一直以为怪物不存在。
fullDiz.src: To earn the trust of the druids, I must cleanse their sanctuary from monsters. Weird, I always thought that the monsters don’t exist.

briefDiz.src: Get in touch with peaceful indigenes.

fullDiz.cn: 我在这里遇到的第一批人可|一点也不友好。得找些更和善的人。
fullDiz.src: The first people I met there were not friendly at all. I should look for someone more peaceful.

fullDiz.cn: 这里总有人知道先知的下落。|问题是去哪里找到他或她。
fullDiz.src: Someone here must know the Oracle whereabouts. The only question is where to find him or her.

fullDiz.cn: 这里总有人知道先知的下落。|问题是去哪里找到他或她。
fullDiz.src: Someone here must know the Oracle whereabouts. The only question is where to find him or her.

fullDiz.cn: 我现在知道去先知那里的路了。|很快就能见到他。
fullDiz.src: I know the way to the Oracle now. Soon I’ll meet him.

fullDiz.cn: 乌卢克已经有一阵子没有消息了。|我得去调查一下那里出了什么事。
fullDiz.src: No news was heard from Uluk for some time now. I am to investigate, what had happened there.

fullDiz.cn: 铁之子计划推翻德鲁伊。|他们需要除掉领袖。|我答应把大德鲁伊引出城，|作为交换他们告诉我先知的下落。
fullDiz.src: The Children of Iron plan to overthrow the druids. So they need to get rid of their leader. I agreed to lure the High druid out of the Town in exchange for the Oracle whereabouts information.

briefDiz.src: Bring the Druid to the ambush.

fullDiz.cn: 并非所有乌卢克的人都向铁|之子屈服。我得帮助德鲁伊们逃离。
fullDiz.src: Not all the people of Uluk submitted to the faith of the Children of Iron. I have to help druids to escape.

fullDiz.cn: 我听说住在塞斯的大德鲁伊|知道先知的下落。
fullDiz.src: I was told that the High Druid, residing at Seth knows the Oracle whereabouts.

fullDiz.cn: 现在我有了两张光盘，|也许终于能弄清父亲的命运了。|希望日记里的内容能给我指路。
fullDiz.src: Now that I have the two disks, I may finally learn the fate of my father. I hope the contents of the diary will lead me to him.

fullDiz.cn: 只要杀死住在遗迹旁的怪物，|神谕信徒就会放我过去。|作为证明，我得把它的头带回去。
fullDiz.src: The Oracle Disciples will let me pass if the monster, living by the ruins, will be killed. As a proof, I must bring them its head.

fullDiz.cn: 先知能帮我，但我得先帮他恢|复记忆。然后他就知道怎么|解读我手里这张光盘了。
fullDiz.src: The Oracle may help me, but first I must help him to regain memory. Then he will know how to read the disk I have.

fullDiz.cn: 一些奇怪的人在把守通往先知的路。|我得想办法过去。
fullDiz.src: Some strange fellows are guarding the way to the Oracle. I must pass them by somehow.

briefDiz.src: Upgrade the truck to cross the desert.

fullDiz.cn: 要穿越沙漠，我的卡车得改进一下。|图纸有了，现在需要有人来做。
fullDiz.src: My truck needs to be improved if want to cross the desert. I have the blueprints, now I need someone to do the job.

fullDiz.cn: 现在我有了两张光盘，|终于能破译 伊万·戈 的日记了。|希望里面的内容能帮我查出|是谁摧毁了我的村庄，|以及怎么找到他们！
fullDiz.src: Now that I have the two disks, I can finally decipher Ivan Go’s diary. I hope its contents will help me to find out who has destroyed my village and how to find them!

fullDiz.cn: 第二张光盘可能藏在父亲家里。|也许上次我漏掉了。
fullDiz.src: The second disk may be hidden at my father’s house. Probably, I haven’t noticed it first time.

briefDiz.cn: 和 本 谈谈光盘的事。
briefDiz.src: Talk to Ben about the disk.

fullDiz.cn: 著名的探险家 本·斯罗特|尔 也许知道第二张光盘在哪。
fullDiz.src: Ben Throttle, the famous Explorer may know where to find the second disk.

briefDiz.cn: 和 爱丽丝 谈谈

fullDiz.cn: 先知说 爱丽丝 知道的比她说|出来的多。不管怎样我得|回到她那里，问问第二张光盘的事。
fullDiz.src: The Oracle claims that Alice knows more than she says. Anyway I must return to her and ask about the second disk.

fullDiz.cn: 只有我从死者之城带回任意|两件神器，先知才肯和我说话。
fullDiz.src: The Oracle will only talk to me if I bring him any two artifacts from the Town of the Dead.

briefDiz.src: Go to the Town of the Dead.

fullDiz.cn: 我只知道巢穴的大概位置。|但我无论如何都会找到它。
fullDiz.src: I only know the approximate location of the lair. But I will find it anyway.

briefDiz.src: Get in touch with the locals.

fullDiz.cn: 首先我得找人给我指路。|只希望这里真的有人住……
fullDiz.src: First of all I must find someone to show me the way. I only hope people do live here...

fullDiz.cn: 这里住的人真够奇怪的。|我得找个明白点的人来回|答我的问题。
fullDiz.src: Really strange people live here. I must find someone saner to have my questions answered.

fullDiz.cn: 伊万 走了这条路。我只知道方向。|但我会找到他的，|或者找到他的遗骸……
fullDiz.src: Ivan went this way. I only know the direction. But I will find him, of what has left of him...

fullDiz.cn: 凯夫的人缺少石油。|没有石油，机器就转不起来，|车辆也无法巡逻保护居民。
fullDiz.src: People of Kef are short of oil. Without it, the machines won’t work and the vehicles will not be able to patrol and protect citizens.

fullDiz.cn: 我希望帮了这些人后，|他们会告诉我去哪里找我要的东西。|再说，我也不能眼睁睁|看着他们送命！
fullDiz.src: I hope, when I help these people, they will tell me where I can find what I need. Moreover, I cannot let them die just like that!

fullDiz.cn: 外星飞船就是差点让地球生|命灭绝的污染源。|为了幸存者，必须摧毁它。
fullDiz.src: The alien ship is the source of contamination that almost wiped out the life on our planet. It must be destroyed for the sake of survivors.

fullDiz.cn: 道路被一个满是暴徒的军事|基地堵住了。打一仗是唯一的出路。
fullDiz.src: The path is blocked by the military base full of aggressive people. Battle is the only way to go.

fullDiz.cn: 科学家提到了外星飞船。|我得亲眼去看看！
fullDiz.src: The Scientist mentioned alien spacecraft. I have to go and see it with my own eyes!

fullDiz.cn: 外星飞船就是差点让地球生|命灭绝的污染源。|为了幸存者，必须让它停下来。|这件事一定有和平解决的办法。
fullDiz.src: The alien ship is the source of contamination that almost wiped out the life on our planet. It must be stopped for the sake of the survivors. There must be a peaceful solution of this matter.

fullDiz.cn: 这些人救了我的命。|我想他们的领袖想要我做点|什么作为回报。
fullDiz.src: These people saved my life. I think their leader wants something from me in return.

diz0.cn: 在加拿大炎热的丛林里，为争夺古代北美人的宝藏，日夜都在进行着激烈的厮杀。林间道路的急转弯与机器人留下的传送门，把这片远古森林变成了一座死亡迷宫。想在这里活下来，你得有响尾蛇般的反应速度和长在后脑勺上的眼睛。
diz0.src: In the hot jungle of Canada day and night serious battles for the treasures of ancient North Americans are in full swing. Sudden turns of wood roads and teleports the heritage of robots turn this relict forest into the labyrinth of death. You should have the reflexes of rattlesnakes and eyes on the back of your head to survive here.

diz0.cn: 很久以前，这座岛成了几十艘船只的沉没之地。没人知道这一切是怎么发生的。也许在那个遥远的年代，船只不仅在海上航行，还能在海上飞。如今它们的残骸在无边的水面上默默生锈。但每年一次，世界上最强的战士都会来到这座承载着远古荣耀的岛屿展开厮杀。和从前一样，赢家通吃。
