diz0.src: A long time ago this island became the wreckage place for dozens of ships. It's unknown how it could have happened. May be in those ancient times ships sailed not only by sea but also flew over sea. Now their wrecks disgracefully rust in the endless water. But once a year the best warriors of the world come to the island of ancient glory to join the battle. As before the winner gets everything.

diz0.cn: 外星人仍在持续观察着地球。在保留地里，来自世界各地最残忍嗜血的斗士为了取悦外星入侵者而互相厮杀。但这种日子长不了——迟早会有顶尖斗士被加冕为冠军，站到Neri面前。到时候，就该轮到他们了！
diz0.src: The outlanders continue their observing the Earth. In the reservation the most cruel and slaughterous people from all over the world fight each other to please and entertain the extraterrestrial invaders. But it can not last for long because sooner or later the top-rank fighter will be named champion and appear before Neri. And then it will be their turn!

diz0.cn: 在沙漠的中心，弱者没有立足之地。沟里的水浇不灭烧红的发动机，子弹也拦不住滚烫的心。烈日比激光更灼人，复仇的渴望比油泵抽油更快地让血液沸腾。前进吧，为沙漠战斗而生的人！胜利正在等着你！
diz0.src: In the heart of the desert there is no place for weak people. The water from the ditch won't cool the red-hot engine and bullet won't stop the hot-tempered heart. The sun burns fiercer than the laser and the thirst of revenge speeds up the blood faster than the fuel pump drives fuel to the engine. Go ahead, born for the desert battles! The victory is waiting for you!

value.cn: 这些流窜的盗匪无恶不作。无论是独行的旅人还是武装商队，都可能成为他们的猎物。
value.src: There is nothing sacred for these vagrant bandits. They can attack any victim whether it be lone traveler or armed caravan.

value.cn: 这个秘密组织汇聚了文明世界最危险的战士。他们为钱而战，但恪守自己的荣誉信条。
value.src: This secret union includes the most dangerous fighters of the civilization. They fight for money and observe code of honor.

value.cn: 他们满世界游历寻找刺激，仿佛生活还不够危险。遭遇突发战斗时，他们随时可能加入进攻方或防守方。
value.src: They drive all over the world and search for jollies as if life was not dangerous enough. During the sudden battle they can join either attackers or defenders.

value.cn: 如今他们的数量已所剩无几，但若能遇到一位探险家，任何困境中都能指望得到愉快的交谈和帮助。
value.src: In these latter days there are very little of them left but if you succeed to meet Explorer you can count on a cheerful conversation and help in any trouble.

value.cn: 官僚们控制着该地区全部合法化的强盗行径、贸易和赌博。他们集一切可以想象的罪恶于一身。
value.src: Bureaucrats control the whole legal banditism, trade and gambling in the region. They inhere all evil that can only be imagined.

value.cn: 美洲原住民的小型保留地。烟草贸易和自制纪念品是他们的主要营生。
value.src: Small reservations of indigenous inhabitants of America. Tobacco trade and home-made souvenirs are their main forms of activities.

value.cn: 因为过去的某些劣迹以及与各路帮派和自由佣兵的关系，敌人称他们为秘密联盟。人们有理由相信联盟专门销赃，而且对走私货物贸易毫不羞耻。
value.src: Foes call them Secret Alliance for some offences of the past and for relations with various gangs and freelancers. With reason is believed that Alliance fence and is not ashamed of smuggled goods trade.

value.cn: 规模不大却野心勃勃的组织，怀抱着文明复兴的理想。为达成这一神圣目标，是他们的行动未必合法的唯一借口。
value.src: Small but very ambitious group propelled by a good idea of civilization renaissance. Desire to reach the sacred goal is the only excuse of their not-always-legal actions.

value.cn: 农夫们像祖先一样耕种土地。粮食永远是必需品，也因为他们身上实在榨不出更多油水，所以在这个危险的世界里过得还算太平。
value.src: Farmers work on the Earth as their ancestors in the past. Food is always required and as there is nothing more to take from them they peacefully live in the dangerous world.

value.cn: 失落城市的居民生活在加拿大的丛林中。他们与世界失去联系并非因为大河阻隔，而是因为他们的兴趣在于宗教而非物质。
value.src: The dwellers of the lost cities live in jungle of Le Canada. They have lost relations with the rest of the world not because of the Great River but because their interests is in the area of religious rather than material.

value.cn: 被称为机器人的机械怪物摧毁人类聚居地。因此他们被迫组成小社群，不断躲藏，为自己的性命担惊受怕。
value.src: Mechanic monsters, known as robots, destroy the human settlements. That is why they are forced to live in small communities and constantly hide and tremble for their lives.

value.cn: 一群人在锈迹斑斑的飞行机器旁建起了小村庄。他们的行为比大多数加拿大丛林居民还要古怪得多。
value.src: Group of people built a small village near the rusty flying machine. Their behavior is far more strange than that of most dwellers of La Canada jungle.

value.cn: 这个社群里的人把守护老工厂和附近的矿井当作毕生的目标。
value.src: This community includes people who choose as a life goal to service the old factory and the mine near it.

value.cn: 它们是没有意识的机械造物。无人知晓它们如何出现在这片大陆上，也不知道它们追求什么目标。唯一清楚的是——它们带来死亡与毁灭。
value.src: They are senseless mechanic creatures. It is unknown how they appeared on the continent and what aims they are trying to reach. One thing is pretty clear - they bring death and destruction.

value.cn: 他们满世界游历寻找冒险，仿佛生活还不够危险。战斗中他们可能加入任何一方。
value.src: They drive around the world seeking for adventures, as if life isn't dangerous enough as it is. In a fight they can join any side.

value.cn: 他们满世界游历寻找冒险，仿佛生活还不够危险。战斗中他们可能加入任何一方。
value.src: They drive around the world seeking for adventures, as if life isn't dangerous enough as it is. In a fight they can join any side.

value.cn: 官僚们控制着该地区的所有劫掠者、贸易和赌博。他们集一切可以想象的恶习于一身。
value.src: Bureaucrats controls all brigands, trade and gambling in the region. They have all imaginable vices.

value.cn: 官僚们控制着该地区的所有劫掠者、贸易和赌博。他们集一切可以想象的恶习于一身。
value.src: Bureaucrats controls all brigands, trade and gambling in the region. They have all imaginable vices.

value.cn: 一个规模不大却野心勃勃的团伙，坚信文明终将复兴。为了达成这一目标，是他们那些未必合法的行动的唯一借口。
value.src: A small, but ambitious band, that believes in the revival of civilization. Their determination to reach this goal is the only excuse for their not-always-legal actions.

value.cn: 一个规模不大却野心勃勃的团伙，坚信文明终将复兴。为了达成这一目标，是他们那些未必合法的行动的唯一借口。
value.src: A small, but ambitious band, that believes in the revival of civilization. Their determination to reach this goal is the only excuse for their not-always-legal actions.

value.cn: 美洲原住民的保留地。烟草和手工艺品贸易是他们的唯一营生。
value.src: Reservations of the native Americans. Tobacco and handicraft trade is their only occupation.

value.cn: 任何人都可能成为这些劫掠者的猎物。他们通常以小股团伙出击。
value.src: Anyone may fall a victim to these raiders. They usually attack in small groups.

value.cn: 他们满世界游历寻找冒险，仿佛生活还不够危险。根据局势不同，他们随时可能成为敌人或盟友。
value.src: Traveling the world in search of adventures, as if life is not dangerous enough, they may easily become foes or allies, depending on the situation.

value.cn: 如今他们的数量已所剩无几。但若遇到这些高尚的人，任何困境中都能指望得到帮助。
value.src: Nowadays their numbers grew thin. But if you met one of these noble guys, you may expect help in any situation.

value.cn: 独立商人，热衷于与任何人做生意。
value.src: Independent traders, eager to trade with anyone.

value.cn: 新世界最危险的战士组成了这一令人敬畏的派系。他们为钱而战，但严格遵守自己的信条。
value.src: Most dangerous warriors of the new world form this respectful faction. They fight for money but strictly honor their code.

value.cn: 艰难时世常催生各种教派，其中一些确实非常危险。
value.src: Hard times often give birth to the different sects, some of which are really dangerous.

value.cn: 农夫们像祖先一样耕种土地。除了蔬菜一无所有，劫掠者很少袭击他们。
value.src: The farmers cultivate the land as their ancestors. Having nothing but their vegetables, they rarely get attacked by raiders.

value.cn: 普通人因为技师们的知识和怯懦而厌恶他们。
value.src: Simple people dislike Technicians for their knowledge and cowardice.

value.cn: 靠石油贸易赚钱的诚实商人。如今他们在寻找新的未知领地以觅得稀有商品。
value.src: Honest traders that make money on the oil trade. Now they search new unexplored territories for rare merchandise.

value.cn: 这一派系因与匪徒的关系而闻名。据说他们专门销赃。
value.src: This faction is known for their relations with the bandits. Supposedly, they deal with stolen goods.

value.cn: 众多地方帮派之一，意图控制瓦特兰。他们设法渗透进了古老的军事基地，从而获得了取之不尽的各类武器。
value.src: One of the many local gangs, willing to take control over the Vaterland. They managed to get inside the ancient military base, which gave them unlimited access to all kinds of weapons.

value.cn: 向整个克莱地区收保护费的敲诈者。多年来一直如此，似乎所有人都习以为常。
value.src: Racketeers that toll the whole Krai. It’s been that way for many years and seems to suit everybody.

value.cn: 没人知道这些人从死寂的海洋中捞出了什么。但渔民们似乎对自己的生活相当满意。
value.src: No one knows what these people manage to fish from the lifeless waters of the ocean. But the fishers seem quite happy with their lives.

value.cn: 在魅力非凡的领袖阿克塞尔的感召下，阿尔根人与邻邦交战。他们还雇佣各种雇佣兵。
value.src: Inspired by the charismatic leader Axel, people of Argen are fighting with their neighbors. They also use the services of mercenaries of all kinds.

value.cn: 忠诚邻邦的突然进攻团结了利布里姆的人民。如今他们为独立而浴血奋战。与公开冲突相比，他们更倾向于间谍和破坏活动。
value.src: The sudden attack of loyal neighbors united the people of Librium. Now they are fiercely fighting for independence.  They prefer espionage and sabotage to open struggles.

value.cn: 这个神秘的组织在世界各地都有信徒。
value.src: This mysterious organization has adepts all over the world.
The defenders of the local crime Boss.

value.cn: 自然之子，遵照古老教派的法则生活。
value.src: Children of the nature, who live according to the ancient cult laws.

value.cn: 前德鲁伊，离开教派后成立了崇拜机器的新教派。
value.src: Ex druids, that left the faction to form their own sect of machine worshippers.
Small sect of the Oracle worshippers.

value.cn: 地狱之火的造物，能碾碎石头、伐倒最高的树木。遭遇这些怪物必死无疑。
value.src: The creations of hellfire able to crush stones and fell the tallest trees. Meeting with these abominations spells sure death.

value.cn: 奥西亚的原住民，经历漫长战争后正在重建家园，但不知为何始终无法成功。
value.src: Natives of Oasia, they are rebuilding their hometown after a long war, but for some reason they cannot succeed.

value.cn: 长期遭受沙漠劫掠者袭击之苦的人们。
value.src: People, constantly suffering from the attacks of the desert raiders.

value.cn: 漫长的战争似乎已经结束，但袭击仍在继续。这片土地永无宁日。
value.src: The long war seems to be over but the attacks continue. There’s no peace in these lands.

value.cn: 又称"记忆守护者"。这些老人离开了城镇，躲着所有人。
value.src: Also known as the Keepers of the Memory, the old people left towns and are hiding from everybody.

value.cn: 涅里，来自外太空的客人。
对阿克塞尔的统治不满的阿尔根人。
value.src: People of Argen not content with Axel’s rule.
The leader of the Crimson Dawn.

value.cn: 一位周游世界的美丽姑娘，追寻着某种自己的目标。
value.src: Pretty girl that travels the world pursuing some goal of her own.

value.cn: 秘密城镇锡安的守卫者。
value.src: Defenders of the secret town of Zeon.

value.cn: 辛克斯。一个没有固定居所的怪人。
value.src: Sinx. A strange fellow, who has no permanent residence.

value.cn: 他们控制着该地区大部分的石油生产。
value.src: They control most of the oil production of the region.

value.cn: 居住在沙漠深处的人们，研究着沙漠的奥秘。
value.src: People, living deep in the desert and studying its mysteries.

value.cn: 一群狂人出没于沙漠。他们只求他人或自己一死。
value.src: A group of madmen haunts the desert. They only seek death to others or to themselves.

value.cn: 厌倦了犯罪的匪徒们，在丛林深处找到了安宁。
value.src: Tired from the crimes, these bandits found peace in the middle of the jungle.

value.cn: 即便在乌鲁克的族人中，也仍有忠诚的德鲁伊。
value.src: Even among the Uluk’s people there still are loyal druids.

value.cn: 与商人开战的帮派。也许他们与渔民结盟了。
value.src: The gang that wages war with the traders. Probably, they are allied with the Fishermen.

value.cn: 你已成为某一派系的敌人。
value.src: You have become enemy to one of groups.

value.cn: 狩猎结束。所有敌人已被击杀。

value.src: New book appeared in the Log.

value.cn: 这里记录了玩家经历的所有|重大事件。

value.cn: 书籍中存放着各种资料来源，|例如旧报纸、杂志和书籍。
value.src: In Books are stored different data sources, for example, old newspaper, magazine and books.

value.cn: 与各派系保持友好关系|是在这个世界生存的关键。|在此部分你可以查看谁尊敬你、|谁又想杀你。
value.src: The maintenance of friendly relations with different groups is essential element of survival in the world. In this part you can follow up who respects you and who dreams of killing you.

value.src: In statistics you always can find out the distance you have driven through, the number of enemies you have destroyed and amount of money you have earned and number of shots you have made.

value.src: To change the vehicle body you should click Body change button and then select the body from the list. Herewith the truck view and description (in the left part of the screen) will change. When you choose the body click Buy button on the icon. The purchase confirmation window opens.

value.cn: 要购买新车辆，请点击「购|买车辆」按钮。在窗|口中你可以从所有可用车|辆中挑选喜欢的，并更换颜色。|点击「选择」确认你的选择。
value.src: To buy a new vehicle you should click Vehicle purchase button. In the window you can choose the any car you like from all available and change its color. Confirm your choice by clicking Select.

value.cn: 选择你喜欢的颜色和涂装，|然后点击按钮为车辆喷漆。
value.src: Choose colors and style you like and click button to repaint the vehicle

value.cn: 点击「加满油箱」可完全加满油箱。|如果你想控制购买油量，|点击「自定义加油」。|用滑块选择合适的油量并确认购买。
value.src: Click Full fuel to fuel up the full tank. | If you want to control the amount of purchase fuel click Manual Fuel. Using slider bar select the appropriate amount of fuel and confirm the purchase.

value.cn: 点击「全部修理」按钮可修|理车辆所有部件（或在金币|允许范围内）。点击「自定|义修理」可修理车辆的单独部件。|你将看到所有部件的修理列|表及修理费用。点击所需部|件即可修理。|如需查看部件的修理程度，|点击该部件名称旁的「微调」按钮。|用滑块调整修理程度并点击|部件名称。|弹出提示中会显示详细信息。
value.src: Click Repair all button to repair all details of vehicle (or for the rest money). Click Manual repair to repair separate part of the vehicle. You will see the repair list of all part and cost of repair. Click the needed part to repair it. | If you want to see the repair level of the part click fine tuning button on the name of this part. By slider bar adjust the level of repair and click the part name. | On the pop-up hints you will see the detailed information.

value.cn: 只有弹药有限的武器才能装填。|这主要涉及重型火炮和导弹发射器。|点击「全部装填」可装填车|辆上的所有武器。|点击「自定义装填」可选择|要装填的武器。你将看到武|器列表和所有可装填的火炮。|点击火炮即可装填。|点击「微调」可设置炮弹或导|弹的数量。用滑块调整数|量并确认购买。|弹出提示中会显示装填的详细信息。
value.src: Only guns with limited ammunition are reloaded. This mostly concerns heavy cannons and missile launchers. | Click Full reload to reload all guns on the vehicle. | Click Manual reload to select the guns to be reloaded. You will see weapon list and all guns that can be reloaded. Click gun to reload it. | Click fine tuning to setup the number of shells or missiles. Using the slider bar adjust the number and confirm the purchase. | On the pop-up hints you will see the detailed information about reload

value.cn: 购买确认窗口打开后，|你需要将旧驾驶室槽位（左|侧）中的所有物品移到新驾|驶室槽位（右侧）。|可以手动拖放或使用「全部|转移」按钮。你还可以查看|新驾驶室的武器槽位和其他装|备数量，并了解交易的最终费用。|如果不想购买点击「取消」。|如果确认交易点击「购买」。|此时屏幕左半侧槽位中剩|余的所有物品将随旧驾驶室|一同出售。
value.src: Purchase confirmation window opens and you should move all items from the slots of old cabin (left side) to the new cabin slots (right side). You can make it manually or use Move all button. You can also look at the number of weapon slots and other equipment of the new cabin and to find out the final cost of the deal. If you don't like anything click Cancel. If you are sure of the deal click Buy. | In this case all remained items in slots of the left half of the screen will be sold with the old cabin.

value.cn: 购买确认窗口打开后，|你需要将旧车厢槽位（左|侧）中的所有物品移到新车|厢槽位（右侧）。|可以手动拖放或使用「全部|转移」按钮。你还可以查看|新车厢的武器槽位和其他装备数量，|并了解交易的最终费用。|如果不想购买点击「取消」。|如果确认交易点击「购买」。|此时屏幕左半侧槽位中剩|余的所有物品将随旧车厢一同出售。
value.src: Purchase confirmation window opens and you should move all items from the slots of old body (left side) to the new body slots (right side). You can make it manually or use Move all button. You can also look at the number of weapon slots and other equipment of the new body and to find out the final cost of the deal. If you don't like anything click Cancel. If you are sure of the deal click Buy. | In this case all remained items in slots of the left half of the screen will be sold with the old body.

value.cn: 购买确认窗口打开后，|你需要将旧卡车槽位（左|侧）中的所有物品移到新卡|车槽位（右侧）。|可以手动拖放或使用「全部|转移」按钮。你还可以查看|新卡车的武器槽位和其他装备数量，|并了解交易的最终费用。|如果不想购买点击「取消」。|如果确认交易点击「购买」。|此时屏幕左半侧槽位中剩|余的所有物品将随旧卡车一同出售。
value.src: Purchase confirmation window opens and you should move all items from the slots of old truck (left side) to the new truck slots (right side). You can make it manually or use Move all button. You can also look at the number of weapon slots and other equipment of the new truck and to find out the final cost of the deal. If you don't like anything click Cancel. If you are sure of the deal click Buy. | In this case all remained items in slots of the left half of the screen will be sold with the old truck.

value.cn: Ex Machina世|界中的城镇和村庄是贸易、|科学和最重要生活活动的中心。|在这里你可以修理和给卡车加油、|补充武器弹药，与当地居民交谈。|点击屏幕顶部的按钮即可进入酒吧、|商店或车间。
value.src: Cities and villages in Ex Machina world are the centers of trade, science and most important life. Here you can repair and fuel your truck, replenish the weapon supplies, to talk to local residents. | Click button at the top of the screen and you will enter Bar, Shop or Repair shop.

value.cn: 你经常需要光顾酒吧以接|受和完成任务。|屏幕右侧显示当前酒吧里所有|访客的图标。访客中常有人|愿意给你简单任务并支付报酬。|点击角色图标开始对话。
value.src: You will have to visit Bar often to receive and complete missions. | In the right side of the screen there are icons of all current visitors of Bar. Very often somebody from the visitors is ready to give you simple mission and pay for it. Click on the character icon to begin the dialogue.

value.cn: 在此窗口你可以看到角色的大|幅图像、他的台词以及你可|选择的回应。|你可以用鼠标或键盘数字选择回应。|只能通过选择对话中相应的台|词来关闭此窗口。
value.src: In this window you see the large character image his cues and your available answers. | You can choose answer using mouse or keyboard numbers. You can only close this window by selecting the appropriate cue of the dialogue.

value.cn: 左上角是雷达。你可以在上|面看到敌人（红点）、|你的车辆（正中央）、|镜头视角方向（扇形）和导航点。|导航点的距离显示在雷达右|侧的数字上（数字颜色对应|导航点颜色）。
value.src: In the left upper corner there is Radar. You can see enemies on it (red points), your car (right in the middle), the direction of camera view (sector) and landmarks. The distance to the landmark is shown by figures on the right from radar (figure color corresponds the landmark color).

value.cn: 速度表以数字和模拟形式显|示卡车的实际速度。|倒挡开启时数字变为红色。
value.src: Speedometer shows the actual truck speed in digital and analog form. When the reverse gear is turned on the figures become red.

value.cn: 结构值代表车辆的整体完整状态。|如果不注意其数值你可能会死。|结构值危急时红色指示灯会闪烁。|你可以在世界各地的车间修理。
value.src: Construction is the consistency status of your vehicle. If you don't look for its level you can die. When the construction level is critical red indicators shows it. You can repair in repair shops all over the world.

value.cn: 也要留意燃料液位，|否则可能陷入困境。|油箱空了时车辆靠备用电|池以极低速度移动。|燃料危急时红色指示灯会闪烁。|你可以在世界各地的车间加油。
value.src: Also keep an eye on fuel level otherwise you can turn out to be in difficult situation. With empty fuel tanks the vehicle moves very slowly using the backup batteries. When the fuel level is critical red indicators shows it. You can fuel your vehicle in repair shops all over the world.

value.cn: 屏幕顶部有卡车车厢和驾驶|室的布局图。不同颜色显|示这些部件的装甲状态（绿|色=完好，红色=严重损坏）。
value.src: In the upper part of the screen there is a layout view of truck body and cabin. Different colors show the Armor condition of these parts (green - perfect condition, red - heavy damages).

value.cn: 当你的任务有时间限制时，|计时器会出现。
value.src: Timer appears if you mission is limited in time

value.cn: 图标上有武器的布局图、|其组编号以及弹匣中的弹药量。|每次射击后显示弹匣弹药|量的绿色条会减少。|弹匣空了时自动开始装填，|装填期间无法射击。|你可以随时手动装填（默认|设置下按R键）。|装填期间弹药条变色并逐渐填满。
value.src: On the icon there are layout view of the weapon, its group number and also the ammunition in charger. After every shot the green bar which shows amount of ammunition in charger decreases. When the charger is empty the reload starts automatically and during it the shooting is impossible. You can reload at any moment (click R button for the default settings). During the reload the bar changes the color and gradually fills up.

value.cn: 此区域显示各种敌人的台词和消息。
value.src: Different enemies cues and messages are shown in this field

value.cn: 此处显示关于任务的重要消息。
value.src: Important messages about missions are shown here

value.cn: 屏幕正中央是准星。|当准星锁定车辆时，|准星上方会显示车辆名称|及其所属派系。标题颜色反|映该车辆与玩家的关系：|红色代表敌对，绿色代表友好。|准星左侧的绿色条显示敌|人的结构值，橙色条为装甲。|准星下方显示与敌人的距离。
value.src: In the middle of the screen there is Sight. If sight catch the vehicle above the sight appears Vehicle name and Group which it belongs to. The title color reflects the vehicle relation to player: red means hostile, green - friendly. Green bar to the left from the sight shows enemy Construction, orange bar is Armor. Below the sight there is a distance to the enemy.

value.cn: 只要卡车上装有一枚自导导弹，|敌方导航制导系统就会自动启动。|红色圆环填满时导弹就已完成制导。
value.src: Even if one self-guided missile mounted on the truck the navigation on enemy starts automatically guidance system. When the red circle fills out the missile is guided.

value.cn: 当货物图标出现时，|表示你可以按I键拾取箱|子中的物品。当喇叭图标出现时，|表示你已进入城镇范围，|按H键即可进入。
value.src: When Cargo icon appears it means that you can pick up items in the box by pushing I key. When Signal icon appears it means that you are in the city boundaries and can enter inside by pushing H key.

value.cn: 将鼠标光标移到元素标题上|即可查看其说明。
value.src: Point by mouse cursor on the element title to see information about it.

value.cn: 靠盗匪活动、赌博和与邻近村庄的贸易维生的大城市。
value.src: Very big city depends on banditism, gambling and trade with neighboring villages.

value.cn: 除了那个难念的名字，这座城市再没什么值得一提的特色。
value.src: Besides the name that is hard to pronounce there is no other remarkable features in this city.

value.cn: 城附近有赛车场，时常举办比赛。
value.src: Near the city there is racing track and sometime it holds competitions there.

value.cn: 被遗忘的美洲原住民保留地。
value.src: Forgotten reservation of indigenous inhabitants of America.

value.cn: 靠与过往流浪者贸易为生的村庄。
value.src: Village lives on trade with visitant vagrants.

value.cn: 人口稀少，村庄大部分区域被货物仓库占据。
value.src: The population is small main part of village territory is occupied by commodity warehouses.

value.cn: 由富裕农夫的住宅群组成的村庄。
value.src: Housing estate of substantial farmers form village.

value.cn: 大型且难以攻陷的城市。
开裂的 UFO 旁的奇异聚居地。
value.src: Strange settlement near the crack up UFO.
Potty little town lied up from all other world.

value.cn: 当地居民的商人聚居地。
工厂维护人员的临时居所。
value.src: Temporary settlement of plant service staff.

value.cn: 城墙坚固，能在下一波机器人进攻中幸存的城镇。
value.src: Well walled town which is able to survive in next robot attack.

value.cn: 优越的地理位置是这座城市免遭机器人彻底毁灭的唯一原因。
value.src: Good geographic location is the only thing that rescued city from total annihilation by robots.

value.cn: 努力求生的小型聚居地。
value.src: Small settlement which tries to survive.

value.cn: 密林将这座小镇藏在陌生人视线之外。
value.src: Impenetrable jungle hided this small town from strangers.

value.cn: 加油站。在这里可以加油和修理。
value.src: Fuel station. Here you can fuel and repair.

value.cn: 当地人对来访者常常抱有敌意
value.src: The locals are often hostile to the visitors

value.cn: 偏远的村庄，很少有外人造访
value.src: Distant village, rarely visited by foreigners

value.cn: 边境城镇，四周被田野环绕

value.src: Scientific centre of the new world

value.cn: 位于主要商道十字路口的桥头城镇，是世界上唯一卡车必须缴费通行的地方。许多派系都想征服它，但迄今无人成功。
value.src: Bridge town at the crossroads of the major trade roads is the only place in the world where the trucks must pay a fare. Many factions plan to conquer it, but so far no one succeed.

value.cn: 乍看只是个偏僻的村庄，实际上是西方秘密贸易的中心。
value.src: At first glance it is just a village lost in the middle of nowhere but it is actually the center of clandestine trade with the Occident.

value.cn: 自由贸易的堡垒，诚实贸易成就的典范。
value.src: It is a bastion of free trade and a model of honest trade achievements.

value.cn: 矿工们深挖矿井，只为找到一星半点的珍贵材料或文物。
value.src: The miners dig deep to find a slightest piece of precious materials or artifacts.

value.cn: 尽管地理位置优越，这个村庄却非常贫穷。也许是因为竞争不过大派系，又或者当地人就是懒。
value.src: In spite of favorable location, this village is very poor. Probably because it cannot compete with the large factions. Or its people are just lazy.

value.cn: 一个什么都不会发生的小村庄。
value.src: A tiny village where nothing ever happens.
The source of oil of the NPT.

value.cn: 这座古老军事基地的地下室里埋藏着大量古老武器。
value.src: Tons of ancient weapons are buried in the basement of this ancient military base.

value.cn: 这座贸易城镇是北路商人的重要财富来源。它为他们提供稀有商品，也带来了与当地人无休止的纷争。
value.src: This trade town is the North Path Traders’ important source of wealth. It provides them with rare merchandise and never-ending struggles with the locals.

value.cn: 独立城镇联邦的首都。其高墙之内酝酿着对抗猩红之晨的作战计划。
value.src: The capital of Commonwealth of Independent Towns. Within its walls strategic plans of battle against Crimson Dawn are born.

value.cn: 这座城镇为独立联邦军队提供主要的工业支持。
value.src: This town provides the main industrial support to the CIT army.

value.cn: 独立联邦的军事基地，数百名士兵在此待命以保卫家园。
value.src: CIT’s Military base, where hundreds of soldiers await orders to defend the native land.

value.cn: 这个聚居地经常遭到猩红之晨雇佣兵的袭击。
value.src: This settlement is often being attacked by CD’s mercenaries.

value.cn: 这个村庄的人愿意倾其所有来支持对抗猩红之晨的士兵。
value.src: People of this village are ready to give all they have to support the soldiers in the battle against the CD.

value.cn: 后勤是战争的重要环节，因此当地人努力工作以支援军队。
value.src: Logistics is an important part of the warfare, that’s why the locals work hard to help the army.

value.cn: 启蒙教会的总部。很少有外人能进去后全身而退。
value.src: Headquarters of the Church of Enlightenment. Few uninitiated actually visited it and returned.

value.cn: 恐惧的人们日夜不停地工作，为阿克塞尔的雇佣兵提供补给。
value.src: Scared people work here round the clock to provide supplies to the Axel’s mercenaries.

value.cn: 阿克塞尔的隐秘城镇。只有极少数最信任的人知道它的位置。它是猩红之晨的心脏。
value.src: Axel’s hidden town. Only a couple of most trusted men know its whereabouts. It is the heart of the Crimson Down.

value.cn: 坚不可摧的要塞，协调着阿尔根人这一大帮杀手的行动。
value.src: Unassailable fortress that coordinates the actions of a big gang of cutthroats that the people of Argen became.

value.cn: 边境聚居地。然而没人记得是什么的边境。
value.src: Boundary settlement. However nobody remembers what border it is about.

value.cn: 这个村庄的人经常遭到双方攻击。
value.src: The people of this village are often attacked by both sides.

value.cn: 德鲁伊的宏伟城镇，塔楼直指苍穹，宛如百年老橡树的枝干。
value.src: Grand town of the Druids raise its towers to the skies like the branches of a hundred-year-old oak.

value.cn: 森林深处的小聚居地。是躲避外界风暴的好去处。
value.src: Small settlement in the middle of the forest. A nice place to hide from the storms of the outer world.

value.cn: 铁之子，前德鲁伊，按照新信仰重建了他们的城镇。
value.src: Children of Iron, former druids, rebuilt their town according to the new beliefs.

value.cn: 神谕信徒在此举行仪式，期望能引起神谕的注意。
value.src: Oracle’s Disciples holds here their rites in hope to attract his attention.

value.cn: 曾经繁华的城镇在近几年几乎沦为废墟。不过仍保留着昔日辉煌的痕迹。
value.src: Once prosperous town has been reduced almost to rubble in the last few years. It preserved traces or the former greatness, though.

value.cn: 瓦哈特的首都，奥西亚真正的明珠。自古以来这座城镇就以无与伦比的枪匠和建筑师闻名。
value.src: The capital of Vahat is the true jewel of the Oasia. Since older days this town is well known for its unsurpassed gunsmiths and architects.

value.cn: 镇民为所有愿意参加的人组织精彩的赛车比赛。只不过愿意参加的人不多。
value.src: Townspeople organize spectacular races for everyone willing to participate. Not that there are too many people, however.

value.cn: 沙漠边缘的小镇，见证了许多离奇可怕的事件。
value.src: Small town on the edge of the desert has witnessed a lot of strange and terrible events.

value.cn: 死海之滨的古老港口。几十艘再也见不到大海的船只在此腐烂。
value.src: Ancient port at the shore of the dead sea. Dozens of ships that will never see the ocean again rot here.

value.cn: 不断遭受劫掠者袭击的聚居地。
value.src: Settlement, suffering from constant raider’s attacks.

value.cn: 在异星辐射源附近建立的科研聚居地。
value.src: Scientific settlement founded at near the source of alien radiation.

value.cn: 整个奥西亚都畏惧这个地方——数百名狂人聚集于此，准备发动下一轮袭击。
value.src: Whole Oasia dreads this place, where hundreds of madmen gather to start the next attack.

value.cn: 大型贸易城镇。它是稀有商品的来源，也与当地人有无休止的纷争。
value.src: Large trade town. It is a source of rare merchandise and never-ending struggle with the locals.

value.cn: 即便在沼泽边也能生存。
value.src: You can live even by the swamp.

value.cn: 这座偏远的德鲁伊村庄为厌倦战争的人们提供庇护。
value.src: This distant druids’ village serves as a refuge to the people who are tired from the war.

value.cn: 古老军事基地，被具有攻击性的狂人占据。能活着穿过的人寥寥无几。
value.src: Old military base, inhabited by the aggressive madmen. There are few people who passed through it alive.

value.cn: 不知为何这位睿智的德鲁伊离开了同伴，独自住在这里。
value.src: For some reason this sage druid left his brother and live here alone.

value.cn: 虽然这辆车看起来不起眼，但其性能相当出色。
value.src: Though this vehicle doesn’t look impressive, its stats are quite impressive.
A race car made of junk.
Member of the truck drivers union

value.cn: 任何拥有武装卡车的流浪汉都会获得此特长。
value.src: Every vagabond who has a truck with guns gets this perk.

value.cn: 任何取得 100 次击杀的战士都会获得此特长。
value.src: Every fighter who has 100 kills gets this perk.

value.cn: 赚到 100000 金币的商人会获得此特长。
value.src: A trader who earned $100000 gets this perk.

value.cn: 最精准的射手因连续两发命中敌方车辆要害而获得此特长。
value.src: The most accurate marksmen get this perk for two critical shots in the enemy's car in a row.

value.cn: 碾过 10 名平民的司机会获得此特长。
value.src: The driver who rode over 10 civilians gets this perk.

value.cn: 袭击 5 辆友好商人或流浪汉卡车的人会获得此特长。
value.src: A man gets this perk for assaulting 5 trucks of friendly traders or vagabonds.

value.cn: 在城市酒吧连续失败 5 次任务的人会获得此特长。
value.src: The perk is given to anyone who fails 5 tasks in city bars in a row.

value.cn: 在城市酒吧连续完成 5 次任务的司机会获得此特长。
value.src: The perk is given to the drivers who completed 5 tasks in city bars in a row.

value.cn: 帮助打击走私的体面公民会获得此特长作为奖励。
value.src: Respectable citizens who help fight smuggling get this perk as a reward.

value.cn: 与盗匪和走私者有交易的人会获得此特长。
value.src: Those who have deals with bandits and smugglers get this perk.

value.cn: 特兰斯是个好奇的男孩，|为此常受惩罚。有一次散步归来，|他被一件金属物体的光泽所吸引。|那是一个带孔和电线的钢制圆筒——|对任何德鲁伊而言都是大逆|不道之物。但特兰斯把它捡|起来藏在自己的小屋里。|他常常凝视圆筒表面映出的面容，|陷入幻想。|在春分那天，特兰斯终于明白了——|金属上的孔是耳朵和眼睛，|电线是血管和肌肉。|这一顿悟令他震惊，|他在森林里游荡了数日，|最终得出结论：孱弱的人类|不过是机械祖先拙劣的仿制品。|于是这个异端离开了德鲁伊，|去寻找失落的钢铁之神。|数月之后，他终于找到一个被碎|石堵住的洞穴。某种力量驱|使特兰斯搬开几块岩石，|很快他瞥见了泥土下的钢铁。|一只光亮如初的金属手正|等着有人将它挖出。|这位前德鲁伊独自花了数日|清理障碍物，但渐渐地，|人们被他充满激情的劳动所感召，|开始聚集在他身边。|铁之子便由此诞生。
value.src: Trans was a curious boy and he was often punished for this. Once returning from a walk he was attracted by the shine of some metal object. It was a steel cylinder with holes and wires, an abomination for any Druid. But Trans picked it up hid it in his cell. He used to watch the reflections of his face on the cylinder’s surface and dream.| In the day of equinox Trans finally understood that the holes in the metal were ears and eyes and the wires – veins and muscles. Shocked by this revelation, for several days he wandered in the forest and came up with the idea that weak humans are just bad copies of their mechanical ancestors. And the heretic left druids in quest for the lost steel gods.| Many months passed until he finally found a cave, blocked by a pile of stones. Something made Trans remove several pieces of rock and soon he caught a glimpse of steel underneath the dirt. A metal hand shiny as ever waited for someone to dig it out.| For days the former druid worked alone on removing the obstruction, but then people began to gather around him inspired by his passionate labor. That’s when the Children of Iron were born.

value.cn: 滔天巨浪席卷了整片大地。|六天后洪水退去，|留下了一个面目全非的世界。|沙漠之处长出了青草，|灌木之地生出了树林，|森林之中则拔起了前所未|见的参天巨树。大地成了乐园，|人们走入雨林，欣然合而为一。
value.src: A huge wave overwhelmed the whole earth and when 6 days later the water subsided, it left behind a changed world. Where the desert has been, there was grass. Where the bushes have been, woods appeared. Where the forests have been, giant trees, never seen before spread their branches. And the land became a paradise; people entered the rainforest and were happy to go united.

value.cn: 在一个遥远的国度，人们忘记了神，|开始崇拜金钱。他们沉溺于罪|恶之中，而邻人却在饥饿中死去。|上天的耐心是无限的，但也有尽头。|终于有一天，一个声音响起，|呼唤人们忏悔，却无人应答。|于是天门大开，天使的怒火|降临大地。野兽惊恐逃窜，|连草木都敬畏地泛红。|但人们对此视而不见。|于是神明白了——|人们已经惩罚了自己。|他们只能听见和看见自己，|除此之外什么也听不到看不见了。|这样的活着比任何酷刑都更可怕。|于是他召回了天使，|再也不将目光投向这片土地。|许多年过去了，但人类仍在世|间游荡，浑然不知自己的灵|魂早已死去。若你偶遇这样的人，|快逃命吧，并祈祷神从这般|可怕的命运中拯救你，|赐你一个痛快的了结。
value.src: People of one distant country forgot God and began worshipping the golden calf. They indulged in vices, while they neighbors were dying of hunger. The patience of the Heaven is immense, but has it limits. One day the voice was heard, calling people to repent, and no one answered the call. Then the heavens opened wide and the angels’ wrath fell upon the earth. The animals fled in fear, even the grass and trees turned red in awe. But people were blind to it.| Then God understood that people already punished themselves. They stopped hearing and seeing anything but themselves. And their lives are worse than any torments. So He called back the angels and never ever directed His eyes at this land.| Many years passed since then, but humans still wander the earth not knowing that their souls are dead. If you ever meet one of them, run for your life and pray for Him to save you from such terrible fate and give you a quick death.

value.cn: 在遥远的东方，越过崇山峻|岭和广袤平原，有一片无垠的沙海。|曾经那里是一片真正的海洋，|深邃而蔚蓝，快乐的人们在海|滨安居。但冥界的钻石嫉妒他们，|以全部的狂怒袭击了这片美|丽的土地。轰鸣声响彻四方，|天空变得通红，灼热的风开始呼啸。|数小时之内，大地布满裂缝，|火柱从中喷涌而出。|连水都开始沸腾、|变色，数周之后，|海洋萎缩成一个湖泊。|最终只剩下一片死寂的平原，|覆盖着干涸泥浆的硬壳。|这场浩劫的幸存者向东迁徙，|寻找新的家园。无人生还。|如今那片海底被称为死亡沙漠。
value.src: In the far east, beyond the high mountains and spacious plains, lies an immense ocean of sand. Once there was the real sea, deep and blue and happy people lived on its shore. But the diamond of the underworld envied them and attacked this beautiful place with all their rage. The loud rumble came all over, the skies grew red and the hot wind began to blow. In several hours the earth was covered with cracks belching pillar of flame. Even the water began to boil, changed color and in several weeks, the sea war reduced to the mere lake. Soon all that left was a lifeless plane covered with a crust of drying mud.| Survivors of this terrible incident went east in quest for new home. None of them returned. Now the bottom of the sea is called the Desert of the Death.

value.cn: 每隔四十年，天空就会被厚|重的乌云遮蔽，白昼如同阴|沉的黄昏。但落下的不是雨，|而是沉重的白色雪花。|数小时之内，一切都被厚|厚的雪层覆盖。屋顶被压塌，|大树像火柴一样折断。|任何在这天留在户外的人都会冻死。|这场灾难被称为"|雪"。|据说在遥远的北方，|有一个永恒寒冷的王国。|永不融化的积雪堆积如山，|黑色的秃树在重压下弯腰折腰。|寸草不生，只有饥饿的野|兽在永恒的觅食中徘徊。|但愿我们的世界没有这样一|片土地……
value.src: Every forty years the sky covers with the heavy dark clouds, so that the day starts looking like the gloomy twilight. But instead of rain, heavy white flakes begin to fall. In several hours they cover everything with a thick layer. The houses roofs collapse under its weight and high trees break like matches. Any person left outside at a day like this, freezes to death. This disaster is called “Snow”. |They say, somewhere in the far North lies the kingdom of the eternal cold. Huge piles of never melting “snow” raise high above the ground, black leafless trees bend under its weight. Not a blade of grass is seen, only hungry beasts prowl in the eternal quest for food.| Let us hope, that there is not such land in the world...

value.cn: 有人还在问我们为什么要戴面具。|答案很简单：为了活下去！|我们这个世界的空气充满毒素，|吸一口就能杀死最强壮的人。|在面具发明之前，|灾难夺去了许多人的生命。|所以曾经居住在我们星|球上的所有生灵中，|只有我们人类幸存了下来。|如今再没有蠢人会摘下防护|装备去呼吸致命空气了。|不过古时候确实有一些。|不用说，他们全死了。
value.src: Some people still ask why we are wearing masks. The answer is very simple: to live! The air of our world is poisoned so a single breath of it would kill the strongest person.| The catastrophe took lives of many, before the masks were invited. So of all the creatures formerly inhabiting our planet, only we, humans, managed to survive.| Now there are no fools who would take off the protective gear and inhale the deadly air. However there were some in the old days. Needless to say, they have all died.

value.cn: 萨迪班历险记 卷一

一个成功商人的生活开始让我厌倦。|这时有个陌生人来到我家，|要卖给我一张藏宝图。|要在一周前，我不会搭理他，|但那时正是开始冒险的恰当时机。|我欣然买下了那块只有奇怪|符号的破布。陌生人走了，|但我有一种预感，我们还会再见。|我雇了一队冒险者，做好了准备。|在拜访之后一个月，我们出发了。|旅途艰辛。在与当地蛮族的持|续冲突中，我们损失了几个|人和一辆补给卡车。|第十七天，我们到达了地|图上标注为通道的地方。|周围只有高山，但我的心已|经因即将发现的奇迹而颤抖。|翻越山脉比我想象的更难。|指定位置的隧道已经坍塌，|我们不得不绕路。|在某个地点我们放下了车开始步行。|经过六天不停的上坡下坡，|我们终于到达了利布里姆——|当地人是这么叫的。|这些善良的人找到了我们并帮|助我们恢复。他们就是我们在那片|远方土地上找到的唯一宝藏。
value.src: The live of a successful merchant began to bore me, when a stranger came to my house and offered to sell me some treasure map. A week ago, I wouldn’t listen to him, but then was the right time to begin an adventure. I gladly paid for a mere piece of cloth with strange symbols inscribed on it. The stranger left, but I had a feeling that we will meet again.| I hired a team of adventurous guys, got prepared to the adventure and a month after the visit, we set off. It was a hard journey. In constant skirmishes with the local barbarians we have lost several men and one truck with supplies. At the 17th day we arrived to the place, marked on the map as a passageway. There was nothing but high mountains around, but my heart already trembled in anticipation of wonders, we would find beyond.| It was harder than I expected to cross the mountains. The tunnel, than we found at the designated location had collapsed, so we had to go search for the detour.| At some point we left our vehicles and began to walk. After six days of constant climbing and descending we finally arrived to the Librium, as the locals call it. These kind people found us and helped to recover. They were the only treasure we found at the distant land.

value.cn: 萨迪班历险记 卷二

刚回到家，我又开始渴望冒险。|一天晚上，我坐在露台凝视天空，|看到一个火轮在火花云中缓|缓向北移动。我无法抗拒追|随奇迹的诱惑。我再次开始|准备远征。在第一次旅行的幸|存者和几个新伙伴的陪同下，|我出发了。|在遥远的北方，我们发现了一|片新大陆，以童话中的王国|命名为瓦特兰。|一部分同伴决定留下。|这里是沃土，曾是商道的十|字路口——至少看起来如此。|我们道别后继续向北行进。|很快路完全消失了，|火轮也不再出现为我指路。|探险队的士气一天天消退。|终于，我下令折返。|这个决定受到了队友们的欢呼。|所有人都疲惫不堪。|回到瓦特兰，我们高兴地发|现曾经的同伴们建起了一座|像样的城镇，我们决定留下。|如今我几乎忘了那个火轮。|或者那只是一个梦？……
value.src: Barely returning home, I started to thirst for adventures. One night when I was sitting at the terrace staring into the sky, I saw a fire wheel that slowly moved to the north in a cloud of sparks. I couldn’t resist the temptation to follow the miracle. Once again I began preparing for the voyage.  Accompanied by the survivors of the first travel and several new guys, I set off. Far in the north we found a new land and named it Vaterland after a fairy tale kingdom.|A part of my companions decided to stay. It was a fertile ground and a former crossroad of trade paths, or so it seemed. W said our goodbyes and continued to go farther north.| Soon the road was completely gone and the fire wheel appeared no more to guide me.  The morale of the expedition faded with every passing day. Finally, I ordered to turn back. This decision was greeted by happy yells of my team. Everybody was extremely tired.|Back in Vaterland we gladly discovered our former companions to build a decent town and we decided to stay with them. Now I almost forgot about the fire wheel. Or was it just a dream?..

value.cn: 世界上最强的战士将在竞技|场中搏杀。古老的废墟将再|次呈现最精彩的娱乐盛宴！|您可以观看殊死搏斗，|闻到橡胶燃烧的气味，|听到金属的摩擦声，|而您安然坐在安全的座位上。|绝对值得一看！

You can watch the mortal combat, feel the smell of burning rubber and hear the metal grinding, being at the safety of your seats. It's worth seeing!

And of course the admiration of the fans!

value.cn: 祖国处于危险之中！|无情的入侵者撕毁了和平条约，|背信弃义地袭击了我们的聚居地。|雇佣兵和匪徒为他们卖命。|敌人很强大，但我们同样强大！|我们为祖国而战！|我们捍卫民主理想和人权！|胜利将属于我们！|立即加入独立城镇联邦的军队！
value.src: The homeland is in danger! Heartless invaders broke peace treaty and traitorously attacked our settlements. The mercenaries and bandits fight on their side. The enemy is strong but so are we! We fight for our motherland! We defend the ideals of democracy and the human rights! The victory will be ours! Join the army of the Commonwealth of Independent Towns now!
The truth about the Crimson Dawn

value.cn: 多年来我们的人民和平共处，|贸易往来，交流技术。但好景不长。|经过几年的旱灾，饥荒开始了。|我们只有拒绝帮助邻人才能自保。|那是所有人的艰难时期。|这时一位名叫阿克塞尔的领|袖出现了。他拯救了许多阿尔根人，|自称是这片土地唯一的统治者。|他组建了猩红之晨这一军事组织，|如今计划在他的战士和雇佣|兵的帮助下征服利布里姆。
value.src: For years out peoples co-existed peacefully, traded, exchanged technologies. Bun nothing last long. After several years of drought, the famine started. We could only survive by refusing to help our neighbors. There were the hard times for all of us. Then a leader emerged by the name of Axel. He managed to save many people of the Argen and claimed himself the only ruler of the land. He formed the Crimson Dawn, military organization and now he plans to conquer the Librium with the help of his warriors and mercenaries.

value.cn: 伟大的阿克塞尔在饥荒中拯|救了我们，他将引领我们走向繁荣！|然而阴险的北方人嫉妒我们的幸福，|密谋对付我们！他们占据了沃|土和能源，拒绝合作！|谈判毫无用处。独立城镇联|邦想要的只是战争！|那就让他们见识我们的战力！|我们要推翻他们腐败的领袖，|在伟大的阿克塞尔的旗帜下|团结自由的人民！
value.src: Great Axel saved us in times of famine and he will lead us to the prosperity! However insidious northerners envy our happiness and plot against us! They took over fertile lands and the source of energy and refuse to cooperate! The negotiations were useless. All CIT wants is war! So we will show them how to fight! We shall overthrow their corrupted leaders and unite the free people under the banners of the Great Axel!

value.cn:
我试图分析灾难的原因，得出结论：|那是一次由未知力量触发的进|化飞跃。我不敢想象，|如果我们对那份礼物有所准备，|会变成什么样子。|无论赐予我们那份力量的是谁，|都来得太早了。
面具下|皮肤的转变过程几乎完成了，|但人们需要一个信仰的飞跃|来完成它。然而他们如此依|恋新世界，对未知的恐惧如此强烈，|以至于无法放手。|人们宁愿作为大地的子民而生，|作为大地的子民而死。|他们的人数不断减少。|幸存者固守着从前的生活，|尽管他们对人类生活应该是|什么样只有模糊的记忆。|当你不知道自己该做什么时，|过人类的生活并不容易。|于是他们试图重建城镇和政府，|投身于最原始的活动——|贸易和战争。|人们越是意识到自己的精神本质，|就越努力用令自己想起过去|生活的物品来包围自己。|因此他们对车辆的热爱——|那是始终陪伴你、|让你成为你自己的东西。|于是卡车成了现代人的一切。|它是他的家、他的身份、他的武器。|新世界的经济建立在卡车生产、|服务和加油之上。|钱只花在卡车升级上。|卡车成了新人类的图腾。|所有的希望和雄心都聚|焦在这个装着轮子的铁皮上……|当然还有一些别的情感，|但实际上那只是对情感的回忆。|你应该终结这种对生活的模仿……
value.src:
I tried to analyze the reasons of the catastrophe and came to the conclusion, that it was an evolutionary leap, triggered by an unknown power. I dread to think, what we would have turned into, had we been prepared for that gift. Whoever gave us that power, has done it before time.
The process of skin transformation under the mask was almost over, but the people needed a leap of faith to complete it. Yet they grew so attached to the new world and the fear of unknown was so strong, that they couldn’t let themselves go. People preferred to live and to die as children of the earth. Their numbers dwindled.|Those who remained were holding onto their former life, even though they had only a distant memory of what human life was like. It wasn’t easy to lead the life of a human, when you didn’t know what you were supposed to do. So, they tried to recreate towns and governments and engaged themselves in the most archaic activities – trade and war.|The more people realized their spiritual nature, the harder they tried to surround themselves with objects that reminded them of their former life. Hence their love for vehicles – the objects that are always with you and that let you be who you are. So, the truck becomes everything to the modern man. It’s his home, his identity and his weapon. The economy of the new world is based on truck production, service and refueling. The money is spent solely on the truck upgrades. The truck has become a fetish for the new man. All hopes and ambitions were now focused on the piece of metal on wheels... There remained some other emotions, of course, but these were in fact memories of emotions.|You should put an end to this imitation of life...

value.cn: 亲爱的同事们！|我想向各位讲述我几年来的研|究成果。我的叙述有时可能|显得混乱，但我向你们保证，|一切都基于我从可靠来源获|得的事实。|许多年前存在一个高等种族——|平衡守护者，他们统治宇宙，|并非作为最强大的种族，|而是作为最睿智和最公正的种族。|但有一天，他们受到了一|股更强大的力量的威胁……|他们将孩子们藏在一个遥|远的星球上，留下他们的助|手涅里照看孩子们。|年复一年，父母再也没有回来。|他们全部在与敌人的战斗中牺牲了。|但涅里出于对逝去朋友的敬意，|继续守护着这个星球及其居民。|另一个驱使他们坚持下去的原因是：|他们有机会恢复宇宙的平衡。|成为平衡守护者的过程相当复杂，|包括几个阶段——|因为在拥有无限力量之前，|你必须拥有无限的责任感。|因此准守护者必须经历完|整的进化周期：从单细胞生|物到精神存在。可以说，|守护者是任何生命进化的最终阶段。|地球成为了守护者后代们的家|园和幼儿园，繁荣发展。|然而没有成年人引导的孩|子们忘记了自己的使命，|过着普通人的生活。|少数人成为了先知。|涅里在此无法帮助他们，|因为他们无法超越物质世界|成为创造者。他们能做的只|是看护孩子们的身体健康，|并遵循守护者留下的指示：|等待既定的时刻，|在时机到来时帮助孩子们展翅高飞。|然而守护者有一个弱点。|他们无法自行完成最终的转变。|最终转变需要一种特定的信|息能量场，通常由父母创造。|如果父母不在，这种场可以由|一种特殊装置来模拟。|所有涅里的飞船都配|备了这样的装置，|以免错过转变的时刻。|至少有一艘飞船必须始终|留在地球轨道上。|你们都急着去哪儿？|我还没告诉你们最重要的事情呢！|你们就是不相信我，对吧？|录音结束。
value.src: Dear colleagues!|I would like to speak to you about the results of my research of several years. My story may be muddled at times, but I assure you that all of it is based on facts I received from reliable sources.|Many years ago there existed a Higher race, the Balance Keepers, who ruled the Universe, not as the most powerful race, but as the wisest and the most just one. But once they were threatened by a far greater force...|They hid their children in a distant planet and left their assistants Njeri to watch over them. Years passed by, but the parents never came back. All of them died in the battle with the Enemy. But Njeri kept their guard over the planet and its inhabitants as a tribute to their gone friends. Another reason that kept them going was the fact that they had chance to restore the balance in the Universe.|The process of becoming a Balance Keeper is rather complicated and includes several stages, for before you can possess unlimited powers, you should possess unlimited sense of responsibility. So, Keepers-to-be had to undergo the complete cycle of evolution: from the protozoan to spiritual beings. You can say, that a Keeper is the final stage of evolution of any life.|Planet Earth, which has become a home and a kindergarten for the descendants of the Keepers, thrived. Yet, the children without the adults forgot their mission and lead the life of ordinary humans. Few of them became prophets. Njeri could not help them there, for they couldn’t soar over the material world and become the creators. All they could do was watch the physical health of the children and follow the instructions, left by the Keepers, which said: wait for the set hour and help the children spread their wings when the time comes.|The Keepers had a weak spot, though. They could not complete the final transformation on their own. The final transformation required a certain information-energy field, which was normally created by the parents. If the parents were missing, the field could be emulated by a special device.|All Njeri’s ships were equipped with such devices so as not to miss the moment of transformation. At least one ship always had to stay in Earth’s orbit. |Where are you all going? I haven’t told you the most important thing yet! You just don’t believe me, do you?|The recording ends.

value.src: Robot tale. | So came the turn of the younger son to watch over the field. He clayed himself as Bob the technician taught him and kept on waiting. Their eyes were red, claws were chippy, they have wheels with deep tread and all covered with steel alloy. The monsters begin to take to pieces water sprinkling system, root up the rod posts and rumple potatoes. | Jim straightened and thought, 'if they notice me I rush away down the hill. Whatever drive gear the monsters have they won't risk chasing me over the flank'. But the monsters didn't notice Jim and he understood that Bob the technician was right and the monsters' temperature-sensing elements didn't work when a man is clayed. Jim came courageously to the metal creature and luted the air inlets of the first monster by magic cement that Bob the technician had given him. At the same moment monster smokes, sparks and fritzs. Two other monsters turned to Jim caught him and tore into fourty five pieces. | And all this because of although clay protects from temperature-sensing elements but video cameras in night mode see everything. But Jim forgot to ask Bob the technician about video cameras. The tag of the tale is that enemy military characteristics should be learned thoroughly. || Johnny and Mechanic monster. | Brave boy Johnny lived in a forest hamlet. He was a good and kind boy. Johnny was a brave boy that is why he took a heavy stone and threw it into Mechanic monster. | In the morning there was not a whisper of the hamlet. value.src: The first and only verse from Jacob. | About Black Kraz. | Listen attentively to the pulsation of the World. | One who able to hear will hear; the heard be aware that | the dash of Black Kraz is furious his power is the devil of the World's energy. His sides look like impenetrable darkness, the varnish blinking like sparkling stars which cut the deepness of the gloom. His exhaustion like black coat covers the whole sky and the air behind him twists in typhoons because the Black Kraz power is great. His marker lights like faraway flashing sheet lightning beyond the horizon of creation. The light of his headlights like ruthless star cuts the twilight of the world, lightens the battlefield. The roar of his engine deafens and the Universe quakes from the boom of his wheels. | Millions of roads stretch in each of the worlds and worlds are numerous. value.cn: 石头上的铭文讲述着早已消|逝的文明的故事。
value.src: The inscriptions on the stones tell the story of the long gone civilization.

value.cn: 桶中酒的品质差强人意，|但在其他村庄你根本找不到。
value.src: The quality of barrels' content leaves much to be desired but in other villages you can't find it.

value.cn: 每位司机出行都应带上十几|罐罐头食品。唯一不便的是你永|远不知道罐头里究竟装的是什么。
value.src: Every driver should take dozen of tins with canned food for the journey. The only inconvenience is that you never know that in fact inside these tins.

value.cn: 土豆就是土豆。没什么可补充的。|它是所有人赖以生存的主要|食物来源。

value.cn: 有时从残骸中能拼出不错的卡|车零件。据说有人学会了把锈|金属重熔成锭。你可以用此商|品少量恢复车辆装甲。|按住[Ctrl]并左键点|击此商品。
value.src: From the wreckage sometimes one may manage to make not bad details for the truck. The story runs that somebody has learnt how to remelt the rusty metal into ingots. You can use this commodity for small recovering of armor on your vehicle. Hold [Ctrl] and left mouse click on this commodity.

value.src: @FF9B2828You can use the item to restore your truck armor by %1d (but not higer than the max) Hold [Ctrl] and click left mouse button on the item.

value.cn: 木材一直被用作热源、|柴火和廉价建材。
value.src: Wood was always used as heat source, firewood and cheap building material.

value.cn: 控制石油的人就控制了整个货运。|这就是为何这一贵重商品周|围有那么多阴谋。
value.src: The one who controls the oil controls the whole cargo traffic. That is why there are so many machinations around this valuable commodity.

value.cn: 机械的替换零件，|没有哪个机械师离得开它。
value.src: Change parts for the mechanisms no one mechanic can do without it.

value.cn: 用废弃玻璃做的饰品能带来|好运和招财。玻璃块越大饰|品越贵重。
value.src: Adornments from end-of-day glass bring good luck and attract money. The bigger glass piece is the more valuable the adornment.

value.cn: 高辛烷值燃料极难寻觅且价格不菲。|你可以用此商品为车辆补充燃料。|按住[Ctrl]并左键点|击此商品。
value.src: High-octane fuel is very hard to find and it costs a lot. You can use this commodity to add some fuel into your vehicle. Hold [Ctrl] and left mouse click on this commodity.

value.src: @FF9B2828You can use the item to refuel your gas tank by %1d (but not higer than the max) Hold Ctrl and click left mouse button on the item.

value.cn: 用再生木料建造的房屋比茅|屋和木棚更坚固保暖。
value.src: Houses made from recycled wood are more robust and warmer than wattle houses and cottages.

value.cn: 各种用于机械维修的零散零件。|你可以用此商品对车辆结构|进行轻度修理。按住|[Ctrl]并左键点击此商品。
value.src: Various loose parts for machinery repair. You can use this commodity for light repair of your vehicle structure. Hold [Ctrl] and left mouse click on this commodity.

value.src: @FF9B2828You can use the item to restore your truck structure by %1d (but not higer than the max) Hold [Ctrl] and click left mouse button on the item.

value.cn: 无人知晓这些臭棍子曾用于何事，|但如今它是毒品的广泛成分。
value.src: It is unknown what were these stinking sticks used for but today it is vast spread ingredient for drugs.

value.cn: 古董书籍。如今识字的人寥寥，|但识字者愿意为泛黄书页中|蕴藏的世纪智慧付好价钱。
value.src: Antique books. Today few people can read but those who can are ready to pay reasonably good money for wisdom of the centuries hidden among the yellowed pages.

value.cn: 最先进的设备型号需要精|密的高科技材料。|很难想象电子原料耗尽时会怎样。
value.src: The most advanced models of equipment need slim hi-tech stuff. One can hardly imagine what can happen when the electronics minefield run low.

value.cn: @FF9B2828你可以用此物品恢复 |%1d 卡车装甲（但不|超过上限）。按住|[Ctrl]并左键点击此物品。
value.src: @FF9B2828You can use the item to restore your truck armor by %1d (but not higer than the max) Hold [Ctrl] and click left mouse button on the item.

value.cn: 此武器命中时传递的电荷会|切断敌方引擎，其车辆停下，|无法逃脱。
value.src: Electric charge transmitted by this weapon on successful hit cut off the enemy engine his vehicle stops it he can't run away from you.

value.cn: 火焰喷射器是对付大量近距|敌群的完美武器。
value.src: Flame gun is perfect weapon to fight with numerous enemy groups at short range.

value.cn: 这不是普通的火焰喷射器，|而是能当着你的面熔化敌方|车辆的大规模杀伤性武器。
value.src: It is not a simple flame gun it is weapon of mass destruction which can melt the enemy vehicle right before your eyes.

value.cn: 5.56口径多管机枪向敌|人倾泻弹雨。说实话其后坐力极大，|甚至能掀翻小车。
value.src: Multi-barrelled machine gun 5.56 caliber fires in enemy the storm of bullets. To tell the truth it has powerful blow-back it can even turn up small car.

value.cn: 5.45口径机枪，|是可安装在卡车上的初级自动武器。
value.src: Machine gun 5.45 caliber this is first-degree automatic weapon, which can be mounted on the truck.

value.cn: 5.45口径双管机枪。|两个枪管和短装填时间使其几|乎可以持续射击。
value.src: Coaxial machine gun 5.45 caliber. Two barrels and short reload time allows to fire almost continuously.

value.cn: 7.62口径机枪。|有了它你可以放心地去不远的旅程。
value.src: Machine gun 7.62 caliber.  With this weapon you can with no fear go to the not far away journey.

value.cn: 12.7口径机枪是对付盗|匪的利器。
value.src: Machine gun 12.7 caliber is a worthy weapon for fighter with bandits.

value.cn: 小口径火炮，新手旅行者的好选择。
value.src: Small caliber cannon is a good choice for rookie traveller.

value.cn: 小型脉冲激光器，|功率虽小却能烧穿几乎所有装甲。
value.src: Small pulse laser despite small power burns through almost any armor.

value.cn: 23毫米远程火炮，|在熟练者手中是件厉害武器。
value.src: Long-range cannon caliber 23 mm is a serious weapon in skilful hands.

value.cn: 霰弹枪在近距离造成巨大伤害。
value.src: Shotgun inflicts heavy damage at short range.

value.cn: 此武器发射的等离子弹飞行缓慢，|但命中好能直接把敌人烧成灰。
value.src: Plasma blast shot by this weapon fly slowly but on good hit can literally cinder the enemy.

value.cn: 14.5口径机枪是真正的怪物，|薄装甲在它面前如纸一般。
value.src: Machine gun 14.5 caliber is a real monster broaches out thin armor like paper.

value.cn: 20毫米速射炮是猎杀两足|野兽的绝佳选择。
value.src: Quick-firing cannon caliber 20 mm is a perfect choice for biped animal hunting.

value.cn: 23毫米速射炮适合射击低飞飞机。|由于现代世界连一架飞机都没有，|它被改装用于地面目标。
value.src: Quick-firing cannon caliber 23 mm is good for shooting at low-flying aircrafts. Because there is no even one aircraft in the modern world it was reequip for ground targets.

value.cn: 37毫米远程火炮，|远距摧毁敌人的强力致命武器。
value.src: Long-range cannon caliber 37 mm is a powerful lethal weapon to destroy enemy on long-distance.

value.cn: 全速摧毁大片区域，|将助诚实的商人对付盗匪团伙。
value.src: Destruction of large territory at full speed it will serve the honest merchant in struggles with bandits' gang.

value.cn: 相当不错的等离子炮。|反正敌人也没有机会抱怨。
value.src: Very worthy plasma gun. Anyway nobody from the enemies complains.

value.cn: 重型霰弹枪，让敌人远离你车|辆的有力理由。
value.src: Heavy shotgun is a strong reason for enemies to keep away from your vehicle.

value.cn: 此导弹发射器发射的导弹爆|炸威力小，但发射数量多。
value.src: This missile launcher shots missiles with small blast but it shots plenty of them.

value.cn: 此导弹发射器能以一次齐射|同时覆盖多个敌人。
value.src: This missile launcher allows to straddle by one barrage several enemies at once.

value.cn: 名副其实，此发射器能在战|场上制造真正的火雨风暴。
value.src: Justify its name this launcher can cause real fire storm at the battle field.

value.cn: 在紧急情况下用于随机摧毁|车辆周围的敌人。仅限地面目标。
value.src: Use it in emergency situation for random destruction of enemies around the vehicle. For ground target only.

value.cn: 战场上的终极王牌。|一击可将中型卡车化为灰烬。
value.src: Final argument in battle. Single hit is enough to vaporize the medium-sized truck.

value.cn: 此武器无需高炉就能熔化敌方车辆。
value.src: This weapon meltdowns your enemy vehicle without any blast-furnace.

value.cn: 如果敌人不拼技巧只拼数量，|这门炮就是为你准备的。
value.src: If enemy tries to fight not using skills but outnumbers you this cannon is just for you.

value.cn: 此导弹的打击让敌人毫无机会，|甚至连被埋葬的机会都没有。
value.src: This missile hit leave enemy no chances even chance to be buried.

value.cn: 这些导弹可用两个词概括：|迅捷与致命。而敌人结|识它们后也用两个词概括：|安静与死亡。
value.src: These missiles are defined by two words: swift and lethal. And enemy after acquaintance with them is defined by words: quiet and dead.

value.cn: 闪电击毁近距离的敌方车辆。
value.src: Lightning kills enemies' vehicles at close range.

value.cn: 用爆裂弹幕摧毁卡车左右两|侧的所有车辆。
value.src: Destroy all vehicles to the left and right from your truck by barrage of bursting shells.

value.cn: 玩家车辆在5秒内加速1.5倍。
value.src: Player's vehicle accelerates 1.5 times in 5 seconds.

value.cn: 此工具迫使敌人暂时从战斗|转向车辆控制。
value.src: This tool forces to switch for a while enemy's attention from battle on vehicle control.

value.cn: 此工具帮敌人摆脱轮胎，|也帮你摆脱敌人。|扎破的轮胎能让敌人瘫痪几秒。
value.src: This tool helps your enemy get rid of the tires and you to get rid of the enemy. Punctured tires are a good way to immobilize your enemy for couple of seconds.

value.cn: 远距摧毁敌人，但威力不如所愿。
value.src: Destroy enemy on a long range but not so much as one may wish.

value.cn: 更大的活性材料舱和改进的外|壳使这台布雷器的地雷真正危险。
value.src: The bigger reservoir for active material and advanced cover make shells of this mine placing machine real dangerous.

value.cn: 内置传感器和起爆控制系统|使此地雷能选择最佳时|间和地点攻击，对敌人造成|最大伤害。
value.src: Built-in sensor and detonation control system allows this landmine to choose the optimal time and place for attack to inflict enemy maximum damage.

value.cn: 甲壳轻微改装的驾驶室。
普通鲜奶罐车驾驶室。|朴素无华，无武器槽。
value.src: Regular Milk tanker cabin. Unpretending and without weapon slots.

value.cn: 标准驾驶室的升级型号。
升级驾驶室，有武器槽和几个|吓人的尖刺。
value.src: Upgraded cabin which has weapon slots and several awesome pins.

value.cn: 为商人改装的驾驶室。|因火力减弱而降价。
value.src: Cabin modification for merchants. Price is low at the expense of light weapon.

value.cn: 商人改良版。可以装上|像样的火炮了。
value.src: Advanced modification for merchants. Serious cannon should be mounted.

value.cn: 标准作战驾驶室。|装甲加强。两个武器槽。
value.src: Standard cabin for combat. Improved armor. Two weapon slots.

value.cn: 此驾驶室改装最多。|装甲、武器、马力、速度一应俱全。
value.src: This cabin is most often modified. Armor, weapon, power, speed.

value.cn: 贝拉斯最便宜最简易的驾驶室。|可装一门小炮和几个配件。
value.src: The cheapest and simplest Belaz cabin. There are slots for small cannon and some upgrades.

value.cn: 热衷贸易的贝拉斯司机的好选择。
value.src: Good choice for Belaz drivers how keen on trade.

value.cn: 此驾驶室专为不仅看重马力、|也注重安全的商人设计。
value.src: This cabin is made for merchants who care not only about engine power but security also.

value.cn: 兼顾出色行驶性能与强大火|力的驾驶室。
value.src: This cabin combines excellent running characteristics and fine fire power.

value.cn: 和平使的初始驾驶室。|即便最简陋的驾驶室也具|备非凡的行驶与战斗性能。
value.src: First level cabin for Peacemaker. Even the simplest cabin has extraordinary running and combat characteristics.

value.cn: 初始型号的升级版。|关键参数全面提升。
value.src: Upgraded first level cabin. All base characteristics are improved.

value.cn: 此版驾驶室可安装两门大炮。

value.cn: '儿子，如果你读到这封信，|说明我没能回来亲自把你抚养成人。|我知道彼得能出色完成这个任务。|看着你如此年轻充满活力，|我心如刀绞。我责备自|己在你成长时缺席。|这是我的惨痛惩罚。|但你应该知道我别无选择。|我面临着一生的任务。|只有完成它我才能重新觉得|自己是个男人。如果我失败……|那说明我不配活着。|这封信是一个借口。|能原谅我吗？你永远在我心中。'
value.src: 'Son if you read this letter that means I couldn't return and bring you up myself. I know that Peter excellent get through this task. I see you so young and full of energy and my heart bleeds. I blame myself for the fact that I was absent when you were growing. And this is my terrible punishment. But you should know that I couldn't act otherwise. I'm in front of the life-time task. Only after accomplishing it I can feel myself man again. If I fail ... it means that I'm not deserve to live. This letter is an excuse. Forgive me if you can. You are always in my heart.'
